meta.title: How DMSO Heals The Nerves and Eliminates Neuropathic Pain
meta.description: Why a single agent, through its forgotten biophysical effects, can reverse an improbable range of \"incurable\" neurological conditions.

content.en: Why a single agent, through its forgotten biophysical effects, can reverse an improbable range of "incurable" neurological conditions.
content.cn: 为什么一种单一药物，通过其被忽视的生物物理效应，能够逆转一系列看似难以治愈的神经系统疾病？

content.en: **Story at a Glance:故事概要：**

- **DMSO is an “umbrella remedy” whose combination of therapeutic properties (improving circulation, reducing inflammation, protecting cells, and reviving dying ones) makes it uniquely suited to treat a variety of conditions, particularly “incurable” neurological disorders and the chronic pain that accompanies them.
- **Through its actions on water, DMSO temporarily shifts the phase of cell membranes and cytoskeletons, after which they reform in a strengthened configuration, facilitating DMSO’s prized ability to transport substances across biological barriers without damaging them and creating a cellular reset that can resolve dysfunctional circuits giving rise to a variety of neurological disorders.
- **DMSO selectively blocks the small nerve fibers responsible for chronic pain transmission while not affecting larger fibers, safely eliminating pain other medications cannot reduce. Hundreds of readers have reported it transforming chronic neuropathic pain, migraines, fibromyalgia, and nerve damage from diabetes, chemotherapy, vaccines, and surgery, often after years of failed conventional treatments.
- **DMSO promotes peripheral nerve regeneration and addresses the root causes of pain through multiple converging mechanisms, with readers reporting return of sensation and motor function in nerves damaged for years or even decades.
- **DMSO has been extensively used in clinical practice for peripheral neuropathies, with Level 1 evidence for complex regional pain syndrome (CRPS) and demonstrated benefit for facial nerve palsy, trigeminal neuralgia, post-herpetic neuralgia, compression neuropathies, diabetic neuropathy, and fibromyalgia, while its unique interactions with the opioid system suggest broader implications for the chronic pain crisis.
- **This article summarizes the extensive data demonstrating DMSO’s efficacy for peripheral neurological conditions (approximately 600 studies and 400 pertinent reader testimonials), and concludes with practical guidance on DMSO protocols and the most potent DMSO pain formulation.
content.cn:
二甲基亚砜（DMSO）是一种“万能疗法”，其综合疗效（改善血液循环、减轻炎症、保护细胞以及挽救濒死细胞）使其特别适合治疗多种疾病，尤其是那些“无法治愈”的神经系统疾病及其伴随的慢性疼痛。**
通过其对水的作用，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）会暂时改变细胞膜和细胞骨架的相态，随后它们会以更强韧的结构重新形成，这有助于DMSO发挥其备受推崇的特性——在不损伤生物屏障的情况下将物质运输穿过这些屏障，并实现细胞重置，从而修复导致各种神经系统疾病的功能失调回路。**

二甲基亚砜（DMSO）通过多种相互作用的机制促进周围神经再生并从根本上缓解疼痛，有读者反馈称，受损多年甚至数十年的神经已恢复感觉和运动功能。**
二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在临床实践中已被广泛用于治疗周围神经病变，针对复杂性区域疼痛综合征（CRPS）具有1级证据，且在面神经麻痹、三叉神经痛、带状疱疹后神经痛、压迫性神经病变、糖尿病神经病变和纤维肌痛方面均显示出疗效；同时，其与阿片系统之间的独特相互作用表明，该药物对应对慢性疼痛危机具有更广泛的意义。**
本文总结了大量证明二甲基亚砜（DMSO）对周围神经系统疾病疗效的数据（约600项研究和400则相关读者反馈），并在结尾部分提供了关于DMSO治疗方案以及最有效的DMSO止痛制剂的实用指导。**

content.en: Nonetheless, all of this has provoked an understandable degree of skepticism—something being able to do this goes against many of the precepts modern medicine revolved around as it chooses to follow a biochemical model where change is created by affecting specific molecular targets rather (with a discrete number of effects), a choice I believe arose because this framework allows a nearly infinite number of patentable (narrowly focused) drugs to be made. In contrast, other marginalized models of medicine, such as the biophysical framework exist which provide a means for agents to affect a large number of diseases (and in many cases, unlike biochemical agents, address their root causes).
content.cn: 尽管如此，这一切还是引发了一定程度的怀疑，这也是可以理解的——因为这种做法违背了现代医学所遵循的许多基本原则。现代医学选择遵循一种生化模型，该模型通过作用于特定的分子靶点来产生变化（且效果有限），而我认为这种选择的产生，是因为该框架允许制造出数量近乎无限的可申请专利的（针对性极强的）药物。 相比之下，其他被边缘化的医学模型，例如生物物理学框架，则为药物提供了影响大量疾病的方法（而且在许多情况下，与生化药物不同，它们能从根本上解决病因）。

content.en: Because of this, I have tried to detail the evidence for every known mechanism of action of DMSO. Some of these include:

- Blocking pain transmission, relaxing muscles, and inhibiting acetylcholinesterase.<sup data-ref="1">1</sup>
- Acting as a highly potent anti-inflammatory and free radical scavenging agent.<sup data-ref="2">2</sup>, <sup data-ref="3">3</sup>

content.en: These mechanisms partly explain the effects DMSO is repeatedly observed to create (e.g., its free radical scavenging and facilitation of DNA repair play a major role in protecting cells from otherwise lethal stressors like radiation, and its microcirculatory effects play a major role in its non-specific enhancement of immunity), while other therapeutic properties still lack any explanation (e.g., DMSO differentiating cells, including cancer cells, or reviving dying cells <sup data-ref="6">6</sup>, <sup data-ref="5">5</sup>).
content.cn: 这些机制部分解释了二甲基亚砜（DMSO）反复被观察到的作用（例如，其清除自由基和促进DNA修复的作用，在保护细胞免受辐射等原本致命的应激因素侵害方面起着重要作用；其对微循环的影响，在非特异性增强免疫力方面起着重要作用），而其他治疗特性目前仍无法得到解释（例如， 二甲基亚砜能使细胞（包括癌细胞）分化，或使濒死细胞复苏 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> ）。

content.en: However, once effects this broad are observed (affecting almost every part of the body), biophysical rather than biochemical means are typically needed to explain them, and I’ve hence tried to put forward those I believe best do so (e.g., to explain how DMSO produces remarkable results for a wide range of complex neurological and psychiatric illnesses I recently showed how DMSO directly separates blood cells by neutralizing the factors which cause them to clump together, thereby greatly increasing critical microcirculation throughout the body).
content.cn: 然而，一旦观察到如此广泛的影响（几乎波及身体的每个部位）， 通常需要借助生物物理学而非生物化学的方法来解释这些现象，因此我尝试提出了我认为最能解释这些现象的理论（例如，为了解释二甲基亚砜（DMSO）为何能对各种复杂的神经系统和精神疾病产生显著疗效，我最近展示了DMSO如何通过中和导致血细胞凝集的因子来直接分离血细胞，从而极大地增强了全身的关键微循环）。

content.en: In this article, I will attempt to show how the same biophysical effects that produce DMSO’s two most well known effects—allowing substances to travel through cell membranes without damaging them and making cells able to survive being frozen—also underlie many of its other remarkable therapeutic properties and focus on their profound implications for the peripheral nervous system.
content.cn: 在本文中，我将尝试阐明：导致二甲基亚砜（DMSO）产生其两大最著名效应——即允许物质穿过细胞膜而不对其造成损伤，以及使细胞能够在冷冻条件下存活——的那些相同的生物物理效应，同样也是其许多其他非凡治疗特性的基础；并重点探讨这些效应对周围神经系统产生的深远影响。

content.en: When polar solvents (e.g., [DMSO or water](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2865192/)) are placed near a polar surface and provided with a radiant energy source (particularly infrared light), they will **spontaneously** form an aggregate that excludes particles or solutes from entering it, with water most effectively performing this transformation (becoming a gel-like liquid crystal). This was first observed by early biologists who saw this viscous liquid inside cells, and associating it with the fundamental substance of life, named it the “protoplasm,” then in the 1960s-1970s it was named “vicinal water” (because it formed in the vicinity of surfaces), after which it became known as interfacial water (a term that is routinely cited in the scientific literature).
content.cn: 当极性溶剂（例如二甲基亚砜或水）置于极性表面附近并受到辐射能量源（特别是红外光）照射时，它们会自发形成一种聚集体，阻止颗粒或溶质进入其中，其中水表现出最显著的这种转变（转变为凝胶状液晶）。 这一现象最早由早期生物学家观察到，他们发现细胞内存在这种粘稠液体，并将其与生命的基本物质联系起来，命名为“原生质”；随后在20世纪60至70年代，它被命名为“邻近水”（因其形成于表面附近），此后则被称为“界面水”（该术语在科学文献中被广泛引用）。

content.en:
Gerald Pollack, after concluding that water gels and their phase shifts to unstructured water were vital to physiology, realized this “liquid crystalline” state was a layered lattice of H <sub>3</sub> O <sub>2</sub> surrounded by a layer of (displaced) H <sup>+</sup> protons, and that in addition to it creating an “exclusion zone,” things could not pass through, was vital to physiology. Structurally, it effectively lubricated adjacent surfaces, protected linings (e.g., blood vessels) from damage, maintained the separation of suspended particles and served as the non-compressible units which provide the resilience and tensegrity (stability) of the body. Likewise, since this process creates a charge separation (H <sub>3</sub> O <sub>2</sub> <sup>-</sup> and H <sup>+</sup>) numerous energy gradients are created that biology can harvest (e.g., the charge separation creates a biological battery, and circulatory vessels both in animals and plants are structured so that the expelled protons, through mutual repulsion spontaneously drive fluid flow throughout the body). As such, a real case can be made that H <sub>3</sub> O <sub>2</sub> <sup>-</sup> is the perpetual motion machine which drives (and protects) biology because it will continually reform whenever it is broken down.
*
Note: I think about the above a lot due to its profound implications for biology—much of which I discuss [here](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-hidden-powers-of-water-that-shape).
content.cn:
杰拉尔德·波拉克在得出“水凝胶及其向无序水相的相变对生理学至关重要”这一结论后，意识到这种“液晶”状态是由H <sub>3</sub> O <sub>2</sub> 构成的层状晶格，周围环绕着一层（位移的）H <sup>+</sup> 质子；并且，除了形成“排斥区”外， 使物质无法穿过，还对生理学至关重要。从结构上讲，它能有效润滑相邻表面，保护内壁（如血管）免受损伤，维持悬浮颗粒的分离，并作为不可压缩的单元，为身体提供韧性和张力结构（稳定性）。同样， 由于这一过程产生了电荷分离（H <sub>3</sub> O <sub>2</sub> <sup>-</sup> 与 H <sup>+</sup> ），从而形成了生物体可利用的众多能量梯度（例如，电荷分离构成了生物电池；动物和植物的循环血管结构设计使得被排出的质子通过相互排斥，自发地驱动体液在全身流动）。 因此，完全有理由认为 H <sub>3</sub> O <sub>2</sub> <sup>-</sup> 就是驱动（并保护）生物体的永动机，因为它无论何时被分解，都会不断重新形成。
注：我经常思考上述内容，因为它对生物学有着深远的影响——其中大部分内容我将在本文中进行讨论。*

content.en: Gerald Pollack also believed it explained how nerves fired (action potentials) as:
content.cn: 杰拉尔德·波拉克还认为，这一理论解释了神经元如何产生动作电位：

content.en:
•Biological systems use the gel-to-sol (H <sub>3</sub> O <sub>2</sub> <sup>-</sup> to H <sub>2</sub> O) phase transition to create energy and drive motion ([after which H <sub>3</sub> O <sub>2</sub> <sup>-</sup> is restored](https://www.westonaprice.org/podcast/build-the-4th-phase-of-water-in-the-body)). For example, when various anions were tested inside perfused axons, their ability to restore or destroy action potentials followed the Hofmeister series exactly: gel-stabilizing ions restored excitability (being ready to fire) while gel-solubilizing ions destroyed it.<sup data-ref="7">7</sup>
*Note: every gel has a transition temperature where it will “melt” into a liquid. Since certain ions (e.g., calcium) can drop this temperature to below body temperature, the body’s targeted releases of Ca <sup>2</sup> disperse the gels. Pollack originally argued this was due to calcium tightly binding together the biological polymers that gels otherwise formed around, but after discovering H <sub>3</sub> O <sub>2</sub> <sup>-</sup> switched to focusing on Ca <sup>2+</sup> ’s Hofmeister effects (which I have also focused on too since the Hofmeister series strongly correlates with [how ions affect zeta potential](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/what-makes-all-vaccines-so-dangerous)).
content.cn:
•生物系统利用凝胶-溶胶（H <sub>3</sub> O <sub>2</sub> <sup>-</sup> 向 H <sub>2</sub> O）相变来产生能量并驱动运动（此后 H <sub>3</sub> O <sub>2</sub> <sup>-</sup> 恢复）。 例如，当在灌注的轴突内测试各种阴离子时，它们恢复或破坏动作电位的能力完全符合霍夫迈斯特序列：凝胶稳定离子恢复了兴奋性（即准备放电的状态），而凝胶溶解离子则破坏了兴奋性。 <sup>1</sup>
注：每种凝胶都有一个转变温度，在此温度下它会“熔化”成液体。由于某些离子（例如钙离子）能将该温度降至低于体温，因此人体有针对性地释放钙离子 <sup>2</sup> 可使凝胶分散。 波拉克最初认为，这是因为钙将凝胶原本包裹在周围的生物聚合物紧密结合在一起，但在发现 H <sub>3</sub> O <sub>2</sub> <sup>-</sup> 之后，他转而关注 Ca <sup>2+</sup> 的霍夫迈斯特效应（我也一直关注这一点，因为霍夫迈斯特系列与离子对ζ电位的影響存在很强的相关性）。*

content.en: •A largely forgotten line of research by Tasaki <sup data-ref="8">8</sup>, <sup data-ref="9">9</sup> and Matsumoto <sup data-ref="10">10</sup>, <sup data-ref="11">11</sup> made the case that action potentials (nerve discharges) are not purely an ion channel event but a propagating phase transition in the peripheral cytoskeleton (the dense shell of actin and microtubules lining the inner membrane). The resting nerve maintains this gel in a compact, calcium-cross-linked state; stimulation triggers an abrupt swelling (as sodium displaces calcium and water rushes in), producing the electrical spike, after which the gel collapses back. In turn, dissolving the peripheral microtubules eliminated excitability; repolymerizing them restored it while stabilizing the cytoskeleton **with DMSO** or Taxol (at lower concentrations) enhanced excitability, indicating that nerve firing was directly linked to the phase of their cytoskeleton.
content.cn: •Tasaki <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 和 Matsumoto <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 提出的一项已被广泛遗忘的研究指出，动作电位（神经放电）并非纯粹的离子通道事件，而是外周细胞骨架（即衬在内膜内侧的由肌动蛋白和微管构成的致密壳层）中的一种传播性相变。 静息状态下的神经将这种凝胶维持在紧凑的、钙交联状态；刺激会引发凝胶的突然膨胀（因钠离子置换钙离子，水迅速涌入），从而产生电尖峰，随后凝胶又恢复原状。 反过来，溶解外周微管会消除神经元的兴奋性；而使其重新聚合则能恢复兴奋性；同时，使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）或紫杉醇（低浓度）稳定细胞骨架则会增强兴奋性，这表明神经元放电与其细胞骨架的相态直接相关。

content.en: •The tendency of structured (liquid crystalline) H <sub>3</sub> O <sub>2</sub> <sup>-</sup> water to exclude solutes helps establish the cellular sodium-potassium balance. Structured water preferentially excludes sodium (because of its larger hydrated diameter) while better accommodating potassium. During the action potential, a phase transition causes the peripheral cytoskeletal gel to expand and hydrate. This breaks down the exclusion, allowing sodium to flood inward. As the gel later returns to its condensed state, potassium flows outward down its concentration gradient, completing the cycle.
content.cn: •具有结构化（液晶）特性的 H <sub>3</sub> O <sub>2</sub> <sup>-</sup> 水排斥溶质的倾向有助于维持细胞内的钠-钾平衡。 有序水会优先排斥钠离子（因其水合直径较大），同时更易容纳钾离子。在动作电位期间，相变会导致外围细胞骨架凝胶膨胀并水合。这打破了排斥作用，使钠离子大量涌入细胞内。随后，当凝胶恢复至凝缩状态时，钾离子顺着浓度梯度向外流动，从而完成这一循环。

• [In one study](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/27054588/), he showed that local and gas anesthetics (which pause nerve function) at minute concentrations enlarge the liquid crystallayer, whereas at higher (standard) concentrations they eliminate it, with bupivacaine being 4.5 times as effective as doing this as lidocaine (mirroring it being 4 times as potent an anesthetic as lidocaine).
*Note: Pollack emphasized that the initial increase mirrors the excitation seen with general anesthesia prior to sedation, whereas I focused on the gel present, which reforms after the initial breakdown and is stabilized by residual lidocaine present.

• 在一项研究中，他证明了局部麻醉药和吸入麻醉药（可暂时阻断神经功能）在极低浓度下会使液晶层变厚，而在较高（标准）浓度下则会消除该液晶层；其中，布比卡因在此方面的效果是利多卡因的4.5倍（这与布比卡因作为麻醉药的效力是利多卡因的4倍这一事实相吻合）。
注：波拉克强调，这种初始升高与镇静前全身麻醉时观察到的兴奋现象一致，而我则关注的是存在的凝胶——该凝胶在初始分解后会重新形成，并由残留的利多卡因稳定。*

content.en:
Pollack’s observation and sensitive patients sharing that neural therapy injections seemed to unleash tiny rushes of fluid in their body (“it was as though a dam was opened”) eventually led me to postulate their actual mechanism of action was due to them dispersing pathologic accumulations of fluids within neurons (thereby restoring their normal firing thresholds) and outside cells (allowing blocked circulations, likely within the interstitial space) to resume. Furthermore, countless bodyworkers have observed that “trauma is stored within the fascia” ([a structure that forms significant amounts of liquid crystalline water on the surface](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/where-does-the-bodys-vitality-come-1cc)) and that releasing the fascia will cause emotional trauma to be released into the body—so I’ve come to wonder if pathologic configurations of liquid crystalline water can create both physical and psychiatric issues (particularly since neural therapy can sometimes profoundly change trauma patterns).
*Note: One of the deepest unsolved problems in science is the origin of subjective consciousness — the “hard problem.” A controversial but increasingly considered theory proposes that quantum computations inside neuronal microtubules (which are directly affected by the cell’s gel-like phase) play a key role in generating conscious moments. The model notes that healthy neurons contain specialized microtubule-associated proteins that stabilize these polymers, potentially allowing the coherence required for such quantum processes.
content.cn:
波拉克的观察，以及一些敏感患者反映神经疗法注射似乎会在体内引发微小的液体涌动（“就像大坝被打开了一样”），最终使我推测其实际作用机制在于：这些注射能分散神经元内部（从而恢复其正常放电阈值）和细胞外部（使受阻的循环——很可能是在间质空间内——得以恢复）的病理性液体积聚。 此外，无数身体治疗师都观察到“创伤储存在筋膜中”（筋膜表面会形成大量液晶态水），而松解筋膜会导致情感创伤释放到身体中——因此我不禁思考，液晶态水的病理性构型是否会同时引发躯体和精神问题（尤其是考虑到神经疗法有时能深刻改变创伤模式）。
注：科学界最深奥的未解之谜之一便是主观意识的起源——即“硬问题”。 一种虽具争议但日益受到重视的理论提出，神经元微管内部的量子计算（其直接受细胞凝胶状相的影响）在产生意识瞬间的过程中起着关键作用。该模型指出，健康的神经元中含有特殊的微管相关蛋白，这些蛋白质能稳定这些聚合物，从而可能为这类量子过程提供所需的相干性。*

content.en: Given all of this, it immediately caught my eye that [many of the DMSO studies I saw](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-heals-the-spine-and-reverses) noted it stabilized microtubules, actin filaments, and cell membranes, particularly since the effects are reversible and DMSO (due to its permeability) rapidly washes out of cells, ensuring the change amounts to a temporary “reset” of cellular structure that could potentially restore cells to a healthy organized state. Likewise, I spent a while trying to understand how these stabilizing effects could occur concurrently with DMSO also temporarily fluidizing the membrane and increasing cell permeability, since these descriptions appear contradictory. However, they are actually complementary, reflecting concentration-dependent actions of the same molecule on the same structure.
content.cn: 鉴于以上种种，我注意到许多关于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的研究都指出它能稳定微管、肌动蛋白丝和细胞膜，这一点立刻引起了我的注意——尤其是因为这些效应是可逆的，而且DMSO（由于其渗透性）会迅速从细胞中洗出，这确保了这种变化相当于对细胞结构的暂时“重置”，从而有可能使细胞恢复到健康有序的状态。 同样，我花了一段时间试图理解，这些稳定作用如何能与二甲基亚砜暂时软化细胞膜并增加细胞通透性的作用同时发生，因为这些描述看似相互矛盾。然而，它们实际上是互补的，反映了同一分子对同一结构产生的浓度依赖性作用。

content.en: How DMSO Affects Cellular Structure
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）如何影响细胞结构

content.en: *Note: this section is a bit technical, and not critical to understand if you’ve read the preceding paragraph so you may want to skim it. I am including it mostly because I spent a long time trying to figure this out and I know a subset of readers will be very interested in it too.
content.cn: 注：本节内容稍显技术性，但如果你已经阅读了前一段，理解这些内容并非必要，因此你可以略读。我之所以将其纳入，主要是因为我曾花了很多时间来研究这个问题，而且我知道部分读者对此也会非常感兴趣。*

content.en: At the molecular level, DMSO forms strong hydrogen bonds with water (the DMSO-water interaction is stronger than water-water bonding <sup data-ref="12">12</sup>), and at 37-45%, DMSO creates chain-like molecular associations with water that enhance local hydrophobicity,<sup data-ref="13">13</sup> while at higher concentrations it can induce liquid-liquid phase separation in water itself, producing regions with structurally distinct water configurations.<sup data-ref="14">14</sup> Likewise, [DMSO is inherently viscous](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0144861799000788) (thick) and increases the viscosity of water by structuring it,<sup data-ref="15">15</sup>, <sup data-ref="16">16</sup>, <sup data-ref="17">17</sup> which can be seen when the two mix together (and is why DMSO will exothermically create heat when it mixes with water).
content.cn: 在分子层面，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）与水形成强氢键（DMSO与水的相互作用强于水-水键 <sup>1</sup> ），当浓度在37%-45%时，DMSO会与水形成链状分子聚集，从而增强局部疏水性， <sup>1</sup> 而在更高浓度下，它可在水体系中诱导液-液相分离，形成具有结构上截然不同水构型的区域。 <sup>1</sup> 同样，DMSO本身具有粘性（浓稠），并通过重构水分子结构来提高水的粘度， <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> 这一点在两者混合时可以观察到（这也是DMSO与水混合时会放热的原因）。

content.path: videos/DMSO 倒入水的凝胶实验（行127）.mp4
content.label: DMSO 倒入水的凝胶实验

content.en: When DMSO is poured into water, the two liquids do not simply mix. Instead, as this video shows, the combination produces slow, viscous, gel-like flows with persistent boundaries and transient ordered regions that bear a remarkable resemblance to the “protoplasm” early biologists observed inside living cells (we hence found ourselves unable to stop watching, eventually adding a dye to make the structured phases easier to see). That said, I’m still not sure if this macroscopic phenomenon is a direct representation of the microscopic clustering that occurs when DMSO mixes with water, but regardless, it provides an excellent visual metaphor to understand what will be described in the sections that follow.
content.cn: 当二甲基亚砜（DMSO）倒入水中时，这两种液体并不会简单地混合。相反，正如这段视频所示，它们混合后会产生缓慢、粘稠、类似凝胶的流动，其中既有持久的边界，也有短暂的有序区域，这与早期生物学家在活细胞内观察到的“原生质”极为相似（因此我们看得入迷，最终还添加了染料，以便更清楚地观察这些有结构的相）。 话虽如此，我仍然不确定这种宏观现象是否直接反映了二甲基亚砜与水混合时发生的微观聚集现象，但无论如何，它为理解后续章节将要描述的内容提供了一个绝佳的视觉隐喻。

content.en: Opening or Solidifying the Cell Membrane
content.cn: 打开或固化细胞膜

content.en: One of DMSO’s most unique properties is that it passes through biological membranes without damaging them (including the blood-brain barrier) <sup data-ref="18">18</sup>, <sup data-ref="19">19</sup>, <sup data-ref="20">20</sup> and ***temporarily*** increases the permeability of organic membranes to other substances. This appears to result from how DMSO shifts the water within the cell membrane (**which then reverts once DMSO readily diffuses away**).
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）最独特的性质之一在于，它能够穿过生物膜（包括血脑屏障）而不对其造成损伤 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> ，并暂时提高有机膜对其他物质的通透性。这似乎是由于DMSO改变了细胞膜内水分的分布所致（一旦DMSO迅速扩散离开，这种变化便会恢复原状）。

content.en:
At low-to-moderate concentrations (roughly 1–10%), DMSO acts as a kosmotrope (a water-structuring agent) that dehydrates phospholipid headgroups by displacing approximately 45% of the surface water layer, compresses inter-bilayer water layers,<sup data-ref="21">21</sup>, <sup data-ref="22">22</sup>, <sup data-ref="23">23</sup>, <sup data-ref="24">24</sup>, <sup data-ref="25">25</sup> raises phase-transition temperatures,<sup data-ref="26">26</sup>, <sup data-ref="27">27</sup>, <sup data-ref="28">28</sup>, <sup data-ref="29">29</sup>80015-9), <sup data-ref="30">30</sup>, <sup data-ref="31">31</sup>, <sup data-ref="32">32</sup> and stabilizes tightly packed gel phases at the expense of looser fluid phases.<sup data-ref="26">26</sup>, <sup data-ref="27">27</sup> Finally, at higher concentrations (e.g., 44%), this dehydration becomes complete, with neighboring DPPC bilayers fully pressed together and no intermembrane water layer remaining.<sup data-ref="24">24</sup>  
在低至中等浓度（约1%–10%）下， DMSO 作为一种水结构调节剂（kosmotrope），通过置换约 45% 的表面水层来脱水磷脂头基，压缩双层间水层， <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> <sup>5</sup> 提高相变温度， <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> <sup>5</sup> <sup>6</sup> <sup>7</sup> 并以牺牲较松散的流体相为代价，稳定了紧密堆积的凝胶相。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 最后，在较高浓度下（例如 44%），这种脱水过程将完全完成，相邻的 DPPC 双分子层会完全压紧在一起，且不再存在膜间水层。 <sup>1</sup>
content.cn: X射线衍射研究表明，这种压缩并非由二甲基亚砜（DMSO）渗入膜内所驱动，而是由DMSO在膜表面与水分子形成簇所致。由于DMSO与体相水的相互作用比与膜的相互作用更强，这些簇通过渗透作用将水从脂质中拉走，从而压缩膜，迫使脂质链更紧密地堆积并更垂直地排列。 <sup data-ref="24">24</sup> <sup data-ref="27">27</sup> <sup data-ref="28">28</sup> <sup data-ref="29">29</sup> 佐证这一结论的是，DMSO将哺乳动物细胞膜的水通透性降低了约一半， <sup data-ref="24">24</sup> 且在皮秒时间尺度上，低浓度的DMSO不仅减缓了脂质的运动，还在脂质-水界面形成了动态有序性更强的双层膜。 <sup data-ref="24">24</sup>

content.en: X-ray diffraction studies showed that this compression is not driven by DMSO penetrating into the membrane, but rather by DMSO forming clusters with water molecules at the membrane surface. Because DMSO interacts more strongly with bulk water than with the membrane, these clusters osmotically pull water away from the lipids, compressing the membrane and forcing the lipid chains to pack more tightly and stand more vertically.<sup data-ref="33">33</sup>, <sup data-ref="34">34</sup>, <sup data-ref="35">35</sup>, <sup data-ref="36">36</sup> Corroborating this, DMSO reduced water permeability across mammalian cell membranes by about half,<sup data-ref="37">37</sup> and at the picosecond scale, low concentrations slowed lipid motions while creating a more dynamically ordered bilayer at the lipid-water interface.<sup data-ref="38">38</sup>

Overhauser dynamic nuclear polarization also confirmed this surface-level action: below 30%, DMSO exclusively weakened the water network at the membrane interface without altering bilayer thickness or headgroup mobility,<sup data-ref="39">39</sup>00593-7) decreasing the repulsive forces between bilayers (allowing them to approach much more closely).<sup data-ref="39">39</sup>00593-7),<sup data-ref="40">40</sup> Furthermore, since each DMSO molecule was similar in size to a membrane lipid headgroup (480 Å³), low DMSO concentrations could effectively compete for headgroup hydration water (and dehydrate the membrane).<sup data-ref="41">41</sup>
content.cn: 奥弗豪泽动态核极化实验也证实了这种表面层作用：当浓度低于30%时，DMSO仅削弱了膜界面处的水网络，而未改变双分子层的厚度或头基的移动性， <sup>1</sup> 从而降低了双分子层之间的排斥力（使其能够更紧密地靠近）。 <sup>1</sup> ， <sup>2</sup> 此外，由于每个DMSO分子的体积与膜脂质头基（480 Å³）相当，低浓度的DMSO能够有效地与头基水合水竞争（从而导致膜脱水）。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en:
In short, the overall membrane bilayer remains intact, its basic architecture is protected against stress, and the membrane becomes noticeably less permeable. Numerous studies support this picture,<sup data-ref="42">42</sup>, <sup data-ref="43">43</sup>, <sup data-ref="44">44</sup>, <sup data-ref="45">45</sup>, <sup data-ref="46">46</sup>, <sup data-ref="47">47</sup>, <sup data-ref="48">48</sup>, <sup data-ref="49">49</sup>, <sup data-ref="50">50</sup> and the same stabilizing effect has been consistently observed across the major components of cell membranes — including phosphatidylcholines,<sup data-ref="26">26</sup>, <sup data-ref="29">29</sup>80015-9) phosphatidylethanolamines,<sup data-ref="28">28</sup>, <sup data-ref="51">51</sup>, <sup data-ref="52">52</sup>, <sup data-ref="53">53</sup> sphingomyelins,<sup data-ref="42">42</sup>, <sup data-ref="46">46</sup> and mixed lipid systems that more closely resemble real cell membranes.<sup data-ref="54">54</sup>, <sup data-ref="45">45</sup>  
简而言之，膜的双分子层整体保持完整，其基本结构在应激作用下得以保护，且膜的通透性明显降低。 大量研究支持这一观点， <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> <sup>5</sup> <sup>6</sup> <sup>7</sup> <sup>8</sup> <sup>9</sup> 且在细胞膜的主要成分中——包括磷脂酰胆碱、 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 磷脂酰乙醇胺、 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> 鞘磷脂， <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 以及更接近真实细胞膜的混合脂质体系。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup>  
*Note: this stabilizing effect has also been shown to reduce the ability of pathogens [like Toxoplasma](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/7233538/) to penetrate and infect cells.  
注：研究还表明，这种稳定作用还能降低弓形虫等病原体侵入和感染细胞的能力。*
content.cn: 当局部浓度略高时，情况便发生了变化。 <sup data-ref="54">54</sup> <sup data-ref="45">45</sup> <sup data-ref="52">52</sup> <sup data-ref="53">53</sup> <sup data-ref="46">46</sup> <sup data-ref="47">47</sup> 对含胆固醇的膜和活细胞的研究确定了三个不同的阶段。 当浓度为10%或以下时，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）会渗入头基区域，使双分子层变薄，使脂质分子间距增大，并松弛其脂肪尾，从而产生可见的涟漪，但不会形成稳定的孔隙。在15%至20%之间，会形成稳定的充满水的孔隙（贯穿双分子层全厚度的结构缺陷），允许离子进入并导致细胞肿胀。 当浓度超过20–30%时，会出现多个孔隙，膜产生剧烈起伏，最终（在高于医疗用DMSO可承受的浓度下）开始破裂。 <sup data-ref="54">54</sup> <sup data-ref="45">45</sup> <sup data-ref="52">52</sup> 原子尺度模拟证实了这三个阶段。 <sup data-ref="54">54</sup> <sup data-ref="45">45</sup> <sup data-ref="52">52</sup>

content.en: At somewhat higher local concentrations, the picture shifts.<sup data-ref="55">55</sup>, <sup data-ref="56">56</sup>, <sup data-ref="57">57</sup>, <sup data-ref="58">58</sup>, <sup data-ref="56">56</sup>, <sup data-ref="59">59</sup> Studies on cholesterol-containing membranes and live cells have identified three distinct stages. At 10% or below, DMSO inserts into the headgroup region, thins the bilayer, spreads lipid molecules farther apart, and loosens their fatty tails, creating visible ripples but no stable pores. Between 15–20%, stable water-filled pores form (structural defects spanning the full thickness of the bilayer), allowing ions to enter and causing cell swelling. Above 20–30%, multiple pores appear, the membrane develops extreme undulations, and eventually (at higher concentrations than can be sustained with medical DMSO applications) begins to break apart.<sup data-ref="54">54</sup>, <sup data-ref="59">59</sup>, <sup data-ref="60">60</sup>77678-7) Atomic-scale simulations confirmed the same three stages.<sup data-ref="55">55</sup>, <sup data-ref="56">56</sup>, <sup data-ref="61">61</sup>

These pores have been confirmed in live cells at concentrations as low as 0.1% (using fluorescence imaging of thallium and calcium influx), with visible membrane blebbing appearing at 2%. The pores are non-selective — both positive and negative ions can pass through freely — and they are not blocked by conventional ion channel inhibitors, showing they are physical gaps in the lipid bilayer itself rather than normal protein channels.<sup data-ref="62">62</sup>
content.cn: 已在活细胞中证实，这些孔道在低至0.1%的浓度下即可形成（通过铊和钙离子内流的荧光成像技术检测），当浓度达到2%时，可观察到明显的膜泡形成。这些孔道是非选择性的——正离子和负离子均可自由通过——且不会被常规离子通道抑制剂阻断，这表明它们是脂质双层本身中的物理间隙，而非正常的蛋白质通道。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: Lastly, DMSO was also found to shift the stereoisomeric conformation of membrane fatty acids from cis to trans forms, potentially creating micropores through a mechanism distinct from the pore-formation pathway described above.<sup data-ref="63">63</sup>
content.cn: 最后，研究还发现二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能将膜脂肪酸的立体异构体构象从顺式转变为反式，这可能通过一种与上述孔形成途径不同的机制形成微孔。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: *Note: DMSO’s permeabilizing effect also extends to intracellular membranes. For example, [DMSO (5–25%)](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/0005273671902501) progressively increased lysosomal membrane permeability in a concentration-dependent manner (allowing sequestered enzymes to access and eliminate degenerative cellular waste products)—providing another mechanism for how DMSO treats neurodegenerative disorders.
content.cn: 注：DMSO的通透化作用也延伸至细胞内膜。例如，DMSO（5%–25%）会以浓度依赖性方式逐渐增加溶酶体膜的通透性（使被封存的酶能够接触并清除退行性细胞代谢废物）——这为DMSO治疗神经退行性疾病提供了另一种机制。*

content.en: These temporary dose-dependent biphasic effects are also seen in a variety of lipids and (phospholipid) cellular membranes:
content.cn: 在各种脂质和（磷脂）细胞膜中，也观察到了这些暂时的、剂量依赖性的双相效应：

content.en: •In ceramides (the predominant lipid in the outermost layer of the skin), below roughly 60%, DMSO accumulated at the ceramide-water interface, displacing water and forming hydrogen bonds with ceramide headgroups while leaving the gel-phase bilayer structure intact. Above roughly 70%, DMSO integration into the headgroup region replaced ceramide-ceramide hydrogen bonds (reducing them from 2.8 to approximately 1.1 per molecule), destroying the lateral hydrogen-bonding network that gives skin its barrier rigidity and **triggering a complete phase transition from an ordered gel phase to a permeable liquid-crystalline phase**.<sup data-ref="64">64</sup>71460-1), <sup data-ref="65">65</sup>, <sup data-ref="66">66</sup>, <sup data-ref="67">67</sup>, <sup data-ref="68">68</sup>
content.cn: •在神经酰胺（皮肤最外层的主要脂质）中，当DMSO含量低于约60%时，DMSO会积聚在神经酰胺与水的界面处，置换水分并与神经酰胺头基形成氢键，同时保持凝胶相双分子层结构的完整。 当含量高于约70%时，DMSO渗入头基区域，取代了神经酰胺之间的氢键（使每分子上的氢键数从2.8减少到约1.1），破坏了赋予皮肤屏障刚性的侧向氢键网络，并引发了从有序凝胶相到可渗透液晶相的完全相变。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> <sup>5</sup>

content.en:
•In muscles, DMSO at 5–10% induced extensive true membrane fusion in sarcoplasmic reticulum vesicles (individual vesicles flattened, established contact, and merged into continuous bilayer sheets), while 25% paradoxically prevented fusion by inducing initial rigidity, and overnight exposure at 10–25% destroyed fused structures entirely, revealing a narrow structural window for productive fusion.<sup data-ref="69">69</sup>, <sup data-ref="70">70</sup>
•In phospholipid vesicles, electron microscopy showed DMSO promoted whole-membrane fusion (as opposed to simple lipid exchange).<sup data-ref="71">71</sup>, <sup data-ref="72">72</sup> This fusion-modulating effect extends to neurotransmitter release: at the single-vesicle level, 0.6% DMSO increased the fraction of catecholamine released per exocytotic event from approximately 53% to 92% and accelerated release kinetics <sup data-ref="73">73</sup> —likely by causing pores to open more fully or remain open longer, providing an additional mechanism by which DMSO treats neurological disorders (such as myasthenia gravis).
content.cn:
•在肌肉中，5%–10%的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可在肌浆网囊泡中诱导广泛的真正膜融合（单个囊泡变平、建立接触并融合成连续的双层膜片），而25%的DMSO却因诱导初始刚性而悖论性地阻止了融合；此外，10%–25%浓度的DMSO经过夜处理会完全破坏已融合的结构，这表明有效融合的结构窗口非常狭窄。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup>
•在磷脂囊泡中，电子显微镜观察表明，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）促进了全膜融合（而非简单的脂质交换）。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 这种调节融合的作用还延伸至神经递质释放：在单个囊泡水平上，0.6%的DMSO将每次胞吐事件中释放的儿茶酚胺比例从约53%提高到92%，并加速了释放动力学 <sup>1</sup> ——这很可能是通过促使孔道更充分地打开或保持更长时间的开放状态来实现的，从而为二甲基亚砜治疗神经系统疾病（如重症肌无力）提供了另一种机制。

content.en:
•In human red blood cells, DMSO protects against hypotonic hemolysis by increasing the critical volume the cells can swell to before bursting, with this protective effect increasing with DMSO concentration up to 23–25% (beyond which hemolysis occurs instead).<sup data-ref="74">74</sup> In a separate study on membrane mechanics, 1% DMSO increased the RBC bending modulus (stiffening) by approximately 37%, 5% DMSO softened it, and 10% DMSO produced only weak, transient effects.<sup data-ref="75">75</sup>30482-3)
*Note: the authors of one of those studies highlighted that DMSO’s membrane actions resembled those of anesthetics—an observation corroborated by fifty years of subsequent research (and potentially another way in which DMSO reduces pain).<sup data-ref="74">74</sup>
content.cn:
•在人类红细胞中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）通过增加细胞在破裂前可膨胀到的临界体积，从而防止低渗性溶血；这种保护作用会随着DMSO浓度的增加而增强，直至23%–25%（超过该浓度则反而会发生溶血）。 <sup>1</sup> 在另一项关于膜力学的研究中，1%的DMSO使红细胞的弯曲模量（刚度）增加了约37%，5%的DMSO使其变软，而10%的DMSO仅产生微弱且短暂的影响。 <sup>1</sup>
注：其中一项研究的作者指出，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）对细胞膜的作用与麻醉剂相似——这一观察结果得到了此后五十年研究的印证（这也可能是DMSO缓解疼痛的另一种机制）。 <sup>1</sup>*

content.en: •In intestinal cells DMSO initially raised polarization (decreased fluidity) but then induced a transient fluid phase before returning to baseline, a temporal sequence consistent with the reset model.<sup data-ref="76">76</sup>
content.cn: •在肠细胞中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）最初会提高极化程度（降低流动性），但随后会诱导出一个短暂的流体相，之后才恢复至基线水平，这一时间序列与“重置模型”一致。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: •In yeast cells, approximately 10% DMSO enhanced DNA transformation efficiency 25-fold by transiently permeabilizing the plasma membrane without reducing cell viability.<sup data-ref="77">77</sup>, <sup data-ref="78">78</sup>
content.cn: •在酵母细胞中，约10%的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）通过暂时使质膜通透，在不降低细胞存活率的情况下，将DNA转化效率提高了25倍。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup>

content.en: This permeability-enhancing effect is not universal at low concentrations, however: in barnacle cells very low concentrations did not change membrane permeability,<sup data-ref="79">79</sup> while in E. Coli membranes, 7.8% DMSO reduced rather than increased permeability.<sup data-ref="80">80</sup>
content.cn: 然而，这种提高通透性的作用在低浓度下并非普遍存在：在藤壶细胞中，极低浓度的DMSO并未改变膜通透性， <sup>1</sup> 而在大肠杆菌膜中，7.8%的DMSO反而降低了通透性，而非提高通透性。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en:
Lastly, the specific structural effects DMSO produces on membranes depend on lipid composition (and phase [as DMSO preferentially interacts with membranes in the fluid phase](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/000629527190178X)). Membranes made from unsaturated lipids (DOPC) are significantly more resistant to DMSO’s structural disruption than those from saturated lipids (DPPC),<sup data-ref="81">81</sup> and negatively charged headgroups (DMPG) are less affected than zwitterionic ones (DMPC, DPPC), suggesting DMSO preferentially interacts with the positively charged choline moiety.<sup data-ref="82">82</sup> These compositional dependencies mean DMSO’s effects in living tissues will be heterogeneous and cell-type-specific <sup data-ref="83">83</sup>, <sup data-ref="84">84</sup> (as the above examples show), which may contribute to its selective normalization of pathological states rather than uniform disruption.
Note: individuals who adopt seed oil free diets (e.g., carnivore) frequently report improved skin tolerance to sun, indicating that a membrane change has occurred. Likewise, some DMSO users report that once they clean up their diet and detoxify their bodies, their DMSO odor (which only affects a portion of users) improves. This suggests that diet-induced lipid changes can either make DMSO more effective or reduce its odor: greater membrane permeability would help DMSO reach hepatocyte microsomes, where it is oxidized to the odorless DMSO <sup><sub>2</sub></sup>, whereas a higher PUFA intake would work against this and furthermore would promote inflammatory gut dysbiosis and a rise in species that reduce DMSO to the odor-producing DMS. Other approaches for reducing DMSO’s odor are discussed [here](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/why-does-dmso-make-some-people-smell).
content.cn:
最后，DMSO 对膜产生的具体结构效应取决于脂质组成（以及相态，因为 DMSO 更倾向于与流体相中的膜相互作用）。 由不饱和脂质（DOPC）构成的膜比由饱和脂质（DPPC）构成的膜更能抵抗DMSO的结构破坏， <sup>1</sup> 且带负电荷的头基（DMPG）所受的影响小于两性离子头基（DMPC、DPPC），这表明DMSO更倾向于与带正电荷的胆碱基团相互作用。 <sup>1</sup> 这些成分依赖性意味着DMSO在活体组织中的作用将呈现异质性且具有细胞类型特异性 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> （如上述例子所示），这可能促使其对病理状态进行选择性正常化，而非造成统一的破坏。*
注：采用无种子油饮食（例如肉食主义）的人士经常反映皮肤对阳光的耐受性有所提高，这表明细胞膜发生了变化。同样，一些二甲基亚砜（DMSO）使用者反映，一旦他们调整饮食并进行身体排毒，DMSO的气味（仅影响部分使用者）就会有所改善。 这表明，饮食引起的脂质变化既可能增强二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的功效，也可能减轻其气味：细胞膜通透性的提高有助于DMSO进入肝细胞微粒体，在那里被氧化为无味的DMSO <sup><sub>2</sub></sup> ；而多不饱和脂肪酸（PUFA）摄入量的增加则会阻碍这一过程，并进一步促进肠道炎症性菌群失调，导致将DMSO还原为产生气味的DMS的菌种数量增加。 本文还讨论了其他减少二甲基亚砜气味的方法。*

content.en: Resetting the Cytoskeleton
content.cn: 重置细胞骨架

content.en: By temporarily shifting cell membranes into a more fluid (sol) state, DMSO enables them to reorganize and reform in a healthier configuration. For example, in pure water at room temperature, DHPC membranes form an atypical interdigitated gel phase (where the fatty tails from opposing membrane layers poke into each other). DMSO (12%) [reversed this non-physiological state](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0005273600002376) to the normal bilayer gel phase while stabilizing it by raising its melting temperature — actively favoring the physiologic configuration that supports normal membrane function.
content.cn: 通过将细胞膜暂时转变为更流体（溶胶）的状态，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）使其能够重新组织并以更健康的构型重构。例如，在室温下的纯水中，DHPC膜会形成一种非典型的交指状凝胶相（即相邻膜层的脂肪尾相互穿插）。 DMSO（12%）将这种非生理状态逆转为正常的双层凝胶相，同时通过提高其熔点来稳定该相——从而积极促进了支持正常膜功能的生理构型。

content.en: In the case of the cytoskeleton (which primarily shapes the entire cell), while DMSO consistently stabilizes key structural components — microtubules along with the vimentin-based intermediate filament network (preventing its breakdown under cyclic hydrostatic pressure *<sup data-ref="85">85</sup>*) — it readily diffuses after creating that stabilization, also providing a reversible, cyclic reset for actin, the most abundant cytoskeletal protein (which is responsible for cell shape, motility, adhesion, and mechanical tension).
content.cn: 就细胞骨架而言（其主要负责塑造整个细胞的形态），虽然二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能持续稳定关键结构组分——微管以及以波形蛋白为基础的中间丝网络（防止其在周期性静水压力下发生降解 <sup>1</sup> ）——但在实现这种稳定化后，它会迅速扩散，从而为肌动蛋白（作为最丰富的细胞骨架蛋白，负责细胞形态、运动、粘附和机械张力）提供一种可逆的、 周期性重置作用，该作用针对肌动蛋白——这种最丰富的细胞骨架蛋白（负责细胞形态、运动、粘附和机械张力）。

content.en: In a series of studies spanning slime molds, human HeLa cells, rat fibroblasts, kidney cells, and cultured hippocampal neurons, DMSO (typically at 5–10%) was shown to rapidly dissolve cytoplasmic actin stress fibers and simultaneously drive the released actin into the nucleus, where it reorganized into massive, ordered filamentous bundles.**<sup data-ref="86">86</sup>, <sup data-ref="87">87</sup>, <sup data-ref="88">88</sup>,  <sup data-ref="89">89</sup>, <sup data-ref="90">90</sup>, <sup data-ref="91">91</sup>, <sup data-ref="92">92</sup>, <sup data-ref="93">93</sup>, <sup data-ref="94">94</sup>, <sup data-ref="95">95</sup>, <sup data-ref="96">96</sup>, <sup data-ref="97">97</sup>, <sup data-ref="98">98</sup>**
content.cn: 在一系列涉及黏菌、人类HeLa细胞、大鼠成纤维细胞、肾细胞以及培养的海马神经元的研究中，结果表明二甲基亚砜（DMSO，通常浓度为5%–10%）能够迅速溶解细胞质中的肌动蛋白应力纤维，同时将释放出的肌动蛋白驱入细胞核，在那里重新组织成庞大且有序的丝状束。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>,</sup> <sup>4</sup> <sup>5</sup> <sup>6</sup> <sup>7</sup> <sup>8</sup> <sup>9</sup> <sup>10</sup> <sup>11</sup> <sup>12</sup> <sup>13</sup>

content.en:
These **reversible** changes are also tightly controlled. Nuclear actin bundles appear within 20–30 minutes of DMSO exposure, and upon DMSO removal (as DMSO freely diffuses out of cells), they disappear within 5 minutes, with complete restoration of cytoplasmic stress fibers and normal cell shape within 1–2 hours.<sup data-ref="93">93</sup>, <sup data-ref="99">99</sup> The effect requires concentrations of at least 3% (below which no cytoskeletal changes occur <sup data-ref="95">95</sup>), is optimal at 5–10%, and becomes irreversible above 20% (where cells appear fixed and disorganized with no paracrystal formation).<sup data-ref="96">96</sup> Fluorescent skeletal muscle myosin light chains incorporated into live nonmuscle stress fibers also showed the same dynamic reset: DMSO dispersed them into the cytoplasm, and removal triggered their reformation within 45 min.<sup data-ref="100">100</sup> *Note: the last study provides an alternative mechanism to explain how DMSO relaxes muscles, particularly persistent contractures.*
Furthermore:此外：
content.cn: 这些可逆性变化也受到严格调控。在接触二甲基亚砜（DMSO）后20–30分钟内，细胞核内会出现肌动蛋白束；当去除DMSO后（随着DMSO自由扩散出细胞），这些肌动蛋白束会在5分钟内消失，细胞质应力纤维和正常细胞形态将在1–2小时内完全恢复。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 该效应需要至少3%的浓度（低于此浓度不会发生细胞骨架变化 <sup>1</sup> ），在5–10%时效果最佳，而超过20%时则变得不可逆（此时细胞呈现固定且无序的状态，且不形成准晶体）。 <sup>1</sup> 融入活体非肌肉张力纤维中的荧光骨骼肌肌球蛋白轻链也表现出相同的动态重置现象：DMSO 将其分散到细胞质中，而去除 DMSO 则会在 45 分钟内触发其重新形成。 <sup>1</sup> 注：最后一项研究提供了一种替代机制，用以解释 DMSO 如何放松肌肉，尤其是持续性挛缩。

content.en: •Fluorescent actin microinjection directly proved the translocation pathway: labeled actin incorporated into stress fibers, then upon DMSO addition the fluorescent fibers dissolved and fluorescent inclusions appeared in the nucleus, with complete reversal on washout.<sup data-ref="92">92</sup>
content.cn: •荧光肌动蛋白微注射法直接证实了转位途径：标记的肌动蛋白被整合到应力纤维中，随后在加入二甲基亚砜（DMSO）后，荧光纤维溶解，细胞核内出现荧光包涵体，经洗涤后该现象完全逆转。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: •This translocation is molecularly specific. Tropomyosin, alpha-actinin, and myosin (the other major stress fiber components) remain in the cytoplasm,<sup data-ref="92">92</sup>, <sup data-ref="96">96</sup> while actin translocates to the nucleus (along with cofilin and actin depolymerizing factor—which co-localize with actin to form intranuclear rods).<sup data-ref="101">101</sup>, <sup data-ref="102">102</sup>, <sup data-ref="103">103</sup>, <sup data-ref="104">104</sup>
content.cn: •这种转位具有分子特异性。肌动蛋白、α-肌动蛋白和肌球蛋白（其他主要的应力纤维成分）仍留在细胞质中， <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 而肌动蛋白则转位至细胞核（同时伴随肌动蛋白解聚因子和肌动蛋白解聚因子——它们与肌动蛋白共定位，形成核内棒状结构）。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup>

content.en: •This effect is seen in a wide range of species (e.g., amoebae, slime molds, Tetrahymena, rat kangaroo cells and human cells <sup data-ref="90">90</sup>, <sup data-ref="91">91</sup>, <sup data-ref="89">89</sup>, <sup data-ref="103">103</sup>)indicating DMSO acts on a fundamental property of actin itself rather than a specific molecular target. Likewise, the process does not require new protein synthesis or energy to maintain (bundles persist even under ATP depletion)—though initial formation does require ATP—pointing to a direct physicochemical action of DMSO on actin rather than a gene-expression-mediated process.<sup data-ref="105">105</sup>, <sup data-ref="93">93</sup>
content.cn: •这一效应在多种物种中均有观察到（例如，变形虫、黏菌、四膜虫、大鼠袋鼠细胞和人类细胞 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> ），表明二甲基亚砜（DMSO）作用于肌动蛋白本身的根本性质，而非特定的分子靶点。 同样，该过程无需新蛋白质的合成或能量来维持（即使在ATP耗竭的情况下，肌动蛋白束仍能持续存在）——尽管初始形成确实需要ATP——这表明DMSO对肌动蛋白起的是直接的物理化学作用，而非通过基因表达介导的过程。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup>

content.en: DMSO’s temporary remodeling also caused a variety of other similar changes in cytoskeletons:
content.cn: DMSO引起的暂时性重塑还导致细胞骨架发生了其他多种类似的变化：

content.en: • In rat embryo fibroblasts, 3–10% DMSO rapidly disrupted organized actin cables into a diffuse distribution and caused cell retraction (73% of cells at 10% DMSO within 15 min). Upon washout, 91–97% of cells fully respread and reformed actin cables within one hour.<sup data-ref="95">95</sup>
content.cn: • 在大鼠胚胎成纤维细胞中，3%–10%的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）会迅速破坏有序的肌动蛋白缆，使其呈弥散分布，并导致细胞收缩（在10% DMSO浓度下，15分钟内有73%的细胞发生收缩）。经洗涤后，91%–97%的细胞在一小时内完全重新铺展并重新形成了肌动蛋白缆。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: •In hepatocytes, 2% DMSO (plus trace glucagon) rapidly converted flat, spread cells into compact cuboidal forms, reorganizing F-actin into perijunctional rings and triggering a sharp rise in cytosolic calcium.<sup data-ref="106">106</sup> DMSO also shifted primary hepatocytes from flattened to polygonal/spherical shapes, depolymerizing dense intracellular F-actin and repolymerizing it into a submembranous cortical layer, while dispersing vinculin from focal adhesions and redistributing fibronectin to cell-cell contacts (enabling long-term culture exceeding one month),<sup data-ref="107">107</sup> while DMSO alone induced elaborate polygonal actin networks (“geodomes”) without altering total actin levels, indicating post-translational reorganization.<sup data-ref="108">108</sup>
content.cn: •在肝细胞中，2%的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）（加微量胰高血糖素）能迅速将扁平、铺展的细胞转化为紧凑的立方形，将F-肌动蛋白重构为细胞连接环，并引发胞浆钙浓度的急剧上升。 <sup>1</sup> 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）还将原代肝细胞从扁平形态转变为多边形/球形，使致密的细胞内F-肌动蛋白解聚，并重新聚合为膜下皮质层；同时，将粘连蛋白从焦黏连处分散，并将纤维连接蛋白重新分布至细胞间接触处（从而实现超过一个月的长期培养）， <sup>1</sup> 而单独使用DMSO则诱导形成了复杂的多边形肌动蛋白网络（“几何穹顶”），且未改变总肌动蛋白水平，这表明发生了翻译后重构。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: •In kidney mesangial cells, 10% DMSO caused rapid, reversible loss of contractility (disappearance of surface wrinkles within 10 minutes, reappearing upon washout).<sup data-ref="109">109</sup>
content.cn: •在肾系膜细胞中，10% DMSO会导致细胞收缩性迅速且可逆地丧失（10分钟内细胞表面皱褶消失，冲洗后重新出现）。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: In addition to facilitating a “cellular reset,” other direct benefits resulted from this process:
content.cn: 除了促进“细胞重置”外，这一过程还带来了其他直接益处：

content.en: •DMSO disassembled stress fibers and caused transient cytoplasmic relocation of talin (which anchors actin stress fibers to focal adhesions) away from adhesion sites; upon washout, talin returned to its normal position and actin cables fully reformed (potentially providing a mechanism to explain the benefits seen from using DMSO to treat problematic adhesions).<sup data-ref="110">110</sup>
content.cn: •二甲基亚砜（DMSO）使应力纤维解聚，并导致塔林（其作用是将肌动蛋白应力纤维锚定于焦黏附点）暂时从黏附位点移出细胞质；经洗涤后，塔林恢复至正常位置，肌动蛋白缆索也完全重建（这可能为解释使用DMSO治疗问题性黏附所见到的益处提供了一种机制）。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: • In neurons, DMSO triggered rapid translocation of actin and actin-polymerizing factors from growth cones into the nucleus, temporarily halting neurite outgrowth. Upon removal, these components returned to the growth cones, and motility was fully restored — demonstrating a reversible “disarm and re-arm” of the axonal growth machinery with potential relevance for resetting nerve regeneration.**<sup data-ref="86">86</sup>, <sup data-ref="87">87</sup>, <sup data-ref="88">88</sup>**
content.cn: • 在神经元中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）会触发肌动蛋白和肌动蛋白聚合因子从生长锥向细胞核的快速转位，从而暂时抑制神经突的生长。移除DMSO后，这些成分会返回生长锥，运动能力也完全恢复——这表明轴突生长机制存在可逆的“解除武装与重新武装”过程，这可能与重置神经再生相关。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup>

content.en: •In growth cone membranes, high DMSO concentrations reduced bending modulus and surface tension, lowering effective viscosity by promoting slip between the membrane and cytoskeleton (the dominant resistance to deformation) and thereby facilitating protrusion formation for axonal extension.<sup data-ref="111">111</sup> Low concentrations of DMSO also disrupted the axonal initial segment diffusion barrier, allowing redistribution of polarized membrane proteins.<sup data-ref="112">112</sup> Supporting this, 2% DMSO dramatically increased membrane tether length in human mesenchymal stem cells and fibroblasts (comparable to combined cytoskeleton disruption and cholesterol depletion), confirming that DMSO temporarily weakens membrane-cytoskeleton coupling and enhances membrane reservoir availability.<sup data-ref="113">113</sup>
content.cn: •在生长锥膜中，高浓度的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可降低弯曲模量和表面张力，通过促进膜与细胞骨架（变形的主要阻力来源）之间的滑移来降低有效粘度，从而促进突起形成，实现轴突延伸。 <sup>1</sup> 低浓度的DMSO还会破坏轴突起始段的扩散屏障，使极化膜蛋白得以重新分布。 <sup>1</sup> 支持这一结论的是，2%的DMSO显著增加了人类间充质干细胞和成纤维细胞的膜锚定长度（其效果与同时破坏细胞骨架和耗竭胆固醇相当），这证实了DMSO会暂时削弱膜与细胞骨架的耦合，并增强膜储备的可用性。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en:
•Tissue repair typically begins with the formation of a provisional gel-like matrix (composed of hyaluronan, fibrin, collagen, and structured water) that serves as the scaffold for cell migration and proliferation. As DMSO stabilizes numerous gel states,<sup data-ref="114">114</sup> (along with switching biomolecules like urea from opposing to supporting gel formation <sup data-ref="115">115</sup>) this provides another mechanism to explain [DMSO’s ability to facilitate tissue healing](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-is-a-miraculous-therapy-for).
*Note: similarly, DMSO enhances plant healing. [In one potato study](https://ir.library.oregonstate.edu/downloads/3t945v539), accelerated wound healing of potatoes by thickening their protective suberin layer and forming a stronger cork-like wound-sealing barrier on cut surfaces.
content.cn:
•组织修复通常始于一种临时性凝胶状基质的形成（由透明质酸、纤维蛋白、胶原蛋白和结构水组成），该基质作为细胞迁移和增殖的支架。 由于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能稳定多种凝胶状态， <sup>1</sup> （同时还能使尿素等生物分子从阻碍凝胶形成转变为促进凝胶形成 <sup>1</sup> ），这为解释DMSO促进组织愈合的能力提供了另一种机制。
注：同样，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）也能促进植物的愈合。在一项针对马铃薯的研究中，DMSO通过增厚马铃薯的保护性苏贝林层，并在切口表面形成更坚固的软木状伤口密封屏障，从而加速了马铃薯伤口的愈合。*

content.en: Another one of DMSO’s unique properties is that it will cause a wide range of cancer cells to differentiate (revert to normal); however exactly why it does this remains unknown. Since numerous polar solvents besides DMSO have also been observed to trigger differentiation,<sup data-ref="116">116</sup>, <sup data-ref="117">117</sup>, <sup data-ref="118">118</sup>, <sup data-ref="119">119</sup> (and [form liquid crystalline aggregates](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2865192/)) and studies have shown the state of the cytoplasm mediates malignancy <sup data-ref="120">120</sup>, <sup data-ref="121">121</sup>, <sup data-ref="122">122</sup>, <sup data-ref="123">123</sup> (e.g., cytoplasms from cancerous cells are highly carcinogenic whereas cytoplasms from normal cells reduces cancer cell growth and can drive differentiation), I was curious if physical changes from DMSO (e.g., it reorganizing the disordered cytoplasm frequently found in cancer cells) could be driving this effect. Studies, in turn, show:
content.cn: DMSO的另一项独特特性在于，它能促使多种癌细胞分化（恢复正常）；然而，其具体作用机制尚不清楚。 鉴于除DMSO之外，还有许多极性溶剂也被观察到能诱导分化， <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> （并形成液晶聚集体），且研究表明细胞质的状态会介导恶性程度 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> （例如，癌细胞的细胞质具有很强的致癌性，而正常细胞的细胞质则能抑制癌细胞生长并促进分化），我很好奇DMSO引起的物理变化（例如，它重构了癌细胞中常见的有序细胞质）是否可能驱动了这一效应。研究进而表明：

content.en: •When Friend erythroleukemia cells are differentiated by DMSO membrane, fluorescence polarization increased, capacitance dropped by approximately 30% and conductivity decreases more than 5-fold, indicating that the membrane became physically tighter and less conductive as cells matured from a cancerous to a more normal phenotype.<sup data-ref="124">124</sup>, <sup data-ref="125">125</sup> Additionally, actin progressively shifted from its soluble (G-actin) form toward its filamentous (F-actin) form, with the G/F-actin ratio decreasing steadily as cells matured, reflecting cytoskeletal stabilization.<sup data-ref="126">126</sup>
content.cn: •当Friend红白血病细胞通过DMSO膜进行分化时，荧光偏振增强，电容下降约30%，电导率降低超过5倍，这表明随着细胞从癌变表型向更接近正常表型的状态成熟，膜的物理结构变得更致密，导电性也随之降低。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 此外，肌动蛋白逐渐从可溶性（G-肌动蛋白）形式向丝状（F-肌动蛋白）形式转变，随着细胞成熟，G/F-肌动蛋白比值稳步下降，这反映了细胞骨架的稳定化。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: •In HL-60 leukemia cells, DMSO-induced differentiation normalized F-actin content in non-dividing cells to levels matching non-cancerous cells, an effect that did not occur in non-differentiable cell lines.<sup data-ref="127">127</sup> DMSO also increased total actin 1.8-fold and drove gelsolin-mediated filament shortening that restructured the cytoskeleton to parallel normal neutrophils.<sup data-ref="128">128</sup> The maturation also enabled entirely new cytoskeletal responses: non-differentiated HL-60 cells showed no F-actin increase when stimulated, while DMSO-differentiated cells acquired rapid 30–50% F-actin increases and pseudopod formation, reflecting acquisition of mature actin regulatory mechanisms.<sup data-ref="129">129</sup>
content.cn: •在HL-60白血病细胞中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）诱导的分化使非分裂细胞中的F-肌动蛋白含量恢复到与非癌细胞相当的水平，而在不可分化细胞系中并未观察到这种效应。 <sup>1</sup> 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）还使总肌动蛋白含量增加了1.8倍，并驱动了由凝溶蛋白介导的丝状体缩短，从而重构了细胞骨架，使其与正常中性粒细胞的结构相一致。 <sup>1</sup> 这种成熟还催生了全新的细胞骨架反应：未分化的HL-60细胞在受到刺激时F-肌动蛋白含量无明显增加，而经DMSO诱导分化的细胞则迅速出现30–50%的F-肌动蛋白含量增加并形成伪足，这反映了其获得了成熟的肌动蛋白调控机制。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: • [A 2022 study](https://faseb.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1096/fasebj.2022.36.S1.R5690) showed these cytoskeletal effects are highly cell-type specific. In normal skin cells, 1% DMSO strengthened the cytoskeleton by increasing F-actin and repositioning vinculin for better structural anchoring. In melanoma cells, it weakened pathological architecture and cancer invasiveness by reducing vinculin and shifting F-actin from rigid linear bundles to a more branched form. Adding calcium sulfide amplified this disruptive effect on cancer cells while leaving normal cells unaffected.
content.cn: • 一项2022年的研究表明，这些细胞骨架效应具有很强的细胞类型特异性。 在正常皮肤细胞中，1%的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）通过增加F-肌动蛋白的含量并重新定位粘连蛋白，从而增强了细胞骨架，改善了结构锚定。而在黑色素瘤细胞中，它则通过减少粘连蛋白的含量，并将F-肌动蛋白从刚性的线性束状结构转变为更分支化的形态，从而削弱了病理性结构并降低了癌细胞的侵袭性。添加硫化钙会增强这种对癌细胞的破坏作用，而对正常细胞则无影响。

content.en: Lastly, DMSO’s best known use is for cryopreservation, which it accomplishes by vitrifying the cells, so that when they freeze, rather than ice crystals forming (which destroy cells), they become a disordered vitreous (glass-like) amorphous solid due to the same headgroup dehydration, gel-phase stabilization, and controlled membrane-fluidity modulation described above <sup data-ref="30">30</sup>, <sup data-ref="48">48</sup> —all of which fully reverses once the cell thaws—again demonstrating that DMSO can guide cells through phase transitions without damaging cells.
content.cn: 最后，DMSO最广为人知的用途是用于冷冻保存，其原理是通过使细胞玻璃化来实现的：当细胞冷冻时，由于上述相同的头基脱水、 上述提到的侧链脱水、凝胶相稳定化以及可控的膜流动性调节 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> ——所有这些过程在细胞解冻后都会完全逆转——这再次证明了DMSO能够在不损伤细胞的情况下引导细胞完成相变。

content.en: *Note: the concentrations at which DMSO raised phospholipid phase transition temperatures (stabilizing membrane gel phases) correlated directly with the concentrations at which it induced differentiation of Friend leukemia cells. This correlation also held for other cryoprotective agents and divalent cations (which similarly raised transition temperatures), as well as for local anesthetics (which produced opposing effects by lowering the phase transition temperature and inhibiting differentiation).<sup data-ref="30">30</sup>, <sup data-ref="48">48</sup>, <sup data-ref="130">130</sup>, <sup data-ref="131">131</sup>, <sup data-ref="132">132</sup> —all of which suggests DMSO’s membrane-stabilizing actions and its differentiation-inducing properties share a common structural mechanism.
content.cn: 注：二甲基亚砜（DMSO）提高磷脂相变温度（稳定膜凝胶相）的浓度，与其诱导Friend白血病细胞分化的浓度呈直接相关。这种相关性也适用于其他冷冻保护剂和二价阳离子（它们同样会提高相变温度），以及局部麻醉剂（它们会通过降低相变温度并抑制分化产生相反的作用）。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> <sup>5</sup> ——所有这些均表明，DMSO的膜稳定作用及其诱导分化的特性具有共同的结构机制。*

content.en: Lastly, when used to treat chronic pain, it is frequently observed the best results are obtained with periodic breaks and several readers here independently discovered this. One with a complex neck/shoulder injury observed: “It seems that I would get the best response if I use an ON-OFF strategy: Apply DMSO for several days then stop for a day or two... when I stopped with DMSO, the pain would at first increase then over the course of the following day reach a new low. It’s almost as if DMSO attenuates some useful signals to the body, which after its removal is able to better ‘see’ where the problems really are and heal.” <sup data-ref="133">133</sup> The Parkinson’s researcher similarly found “I always feel my best the day after I stop DMSO” and explored pulsed dosing.<sup data-ref="134">134</sup> This pattern is consistent with the cellular reset model described earlier in this article, where DMSO’s temporary structural reorganization may need to be followed by a consolidation period for the body to establish a new baseline.
content.cn: 最后，在用于治疗慢性疼痛时，人们经常发现，若间歇性停用，往往能获得最佳效果，这里也有几位读者独立发现了这一点。一位患有复杂颈肩损伤的读者指出：“似乎采用‘开-停’策略能获得最佳疗效：使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）几天后停用一两天……当我停止使用DMSO时，疼痛起初会加剧，但在随后的一天内会降至新低。这几乎就像DMSO会削弱身体接收到的某些有益信号，而一旦停止使用，身体就能更好地‘察觉’问题真正所在并进行自愈。” <sup>1</sup> 一位帕金森病研究者也有类似发现：“停用二甲基亚砜后的第二天，我总是感觉最好”，并探索了脉冲式给药法。 <sup>1</sup> 这种模式与本文前文所述的“细胞重置模型”一致，即二甲基亚砜引发的暂时性结构重组之后，可能需要一个巩固期，以便身体建立新的基线。

content.en: Peripheral Nerve Regeneration & Protection
content.cn: 周围神经再生与保护

content.en: One of DMSO’s most remarkable properties is its ability to facilitate regeneration of the central nervous system (which otherwise does not heal), due to its having a variety of properties including:
content.cn: DMSO 最显著的特性之一是它能够促进中枢神经系统的再生（该系统通常无法自行愈合），这得益于它具有多种特性，包括：

content.en:
- [Powerfully facilitating](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-heals-the-brain-and-transforms) the polymerization of microtubules—which cells require to divide (discussed in [the first article](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-heals-the-brain-and-transforms))
- Differentiating stem cells into neurons (both of which were discussed in the [previous article](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-heals-the-spine-and-reverses))
- Restoring circulation to the nerves (discussed in [the first article](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-heals-the-brain-and-transforms))
- Stabilizing cell membranes (discussed above) and [reducing chronic inflammation](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-treats-incurable-autoimmune) (which often disrupts cellular repair)
- Preventing demyelination and promoting remyelination (discussed below and in [the first article](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-heals-the-brain-and-transforms)).
- [Enhancing](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/2384530/) electric field-induced nerve branching (new branch growth from existing nerves is how damaged neural pathways reconnect, a process the CNS environment normally suppresses).
content.cn:
有力地促进微管的聚合——这是细胞分裂所必需的（详见第一篇文章）
将干细胞分化为神经元（这两点均在前一篇文章中讨论过）
恢复神经血液循环（详见第一篇文章）
稳定细胞膜（如上所述）并减轻慢性炎症（慢性炎症往往会干扰细胞修复）
预防脱髓鞘并促进再髓鞘化（下文及第一篇文章中将对此进行讨论）。
增强电场诱导的神经分支形成（现有神经长出新分支是受损神经通路重新连接的方式，而这一过程通常会被中枢神经系统环境所抑制）。

content.en: Peripheral nerves, unlike those in the brain and spinal cord, possess an innate capacity to regenerate after injury. However, this process is slow (approximately 1 mm per day), frequently incomplete, and often complicated by scarring, inflammation, and loss of the supporting Schwann cells that myelinate nerves (with surgical approaches such as direct repair or autologous nerve grafting being the gold standard, but producing inconsistent results, particularly for severe injuries with gaps or delayed treatment). Fortunately, DMSO’s ability to heal the central nervous system also translates to it regenerating peripheral nerve injuries.
content.cn: 与大脑和脊髓中的神经不同，周围神经具有受伤后自我再生的先天能力。 然而，这一过程进展缓慢（每天约1毫米），往往无法完全恢复，且常因瘢痕形成、炎症以及为神经提供髓鞘保护的施万细胞丧失而变得复杂（虽然直接修复或自体神经移植等外科方法是金标准，但疗效不尽如人意，特别是对于存在间隙的严重损伤或延迟治疗的情况）。 幸运的是，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）修复中枢神经系统的能力同样适用于再生外周神经损伤。

content.en: DMSO-Alone Findings DMSO
content.cn: 单药治疗的研究结果

content.en: Several studies have directly demonstrated that DMSO promotes peripheral nerve regeneration and that local DMSO application consistently outperformed systemic (intraperitoneal) administration:<sup data-ref="135">135</sup>, <sup data-ref="136">136</sup>, <sup data-ref="137">137</sup>
content.cn: 多项研究已直接证明，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能促进周围神经再生，且局部应用DMSO的效果始终优于全身（腹腔内）给药： <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup>

content.en:
•In rats whose sciatic nerve was transected, local or intraperitoneal DMSO improved regeneration and reduced perineural adhesions, with significant gains over untreated controls across multiple metrics: gastrocnemius muscle weight ratio (+50%), nerve growth factor expression (+227%), myelin basic protein expression (+165%), myelinated axon counts (+26%), compound motor action potential amplitude (+935%), conduction velocity (+303%), and toe-spread test scores (+50%).<sup data-ref="138">138</sup>, <sup data-ref="139">139</sup>
•In a neurotmesis model (severing the nerve and each of its protective sheaths), 10% DMSO applied locally at the repair site for 12 weeks acted as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antifibrotic agent, significantly improving nerve healing: higher gastrocnemius muscle weight ratios, better macroscopic nerve scores with reduced adhesions, increased NGF and MBP (nerve-repair proteins) expression, thicker myelin sheaths, larger axon diameters, higher myelinated axon counts, improved nerve conduction (higher CMAP amplitude and conduction velocity), and better functional outcomes on pinprick and toe-spread (sensory and motor) tests.
content.cn:
•在坐骨神经被切断的大鼠中，局部或腹腔注射二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可促进神经再生并减少神经周围粘连，在多项指标上均显著优于未经治疗的对照组：腓肠肌重量比（+50%）、神经生长因子表达量（+227%）、 髓鞘基本蛋白表达（+165%）、有髓轴突数量（+26%）、复合运动动作电位振幅（+935%）、传导速度（+303%）以及趾张开试验评分（+50%）。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup>
•在神经断裂模型（切断神经及其各保护鞘）中，在修复部位局部应用10%二甲基亚砜（DMSO）持续12周，其作为抗氧化剂、抗炎剂和抗纤维化剂，显著改善了神经愈合： 腓肠肌重量比更高；肉眼观察下的神经评分更好，粘连减少；神经生长因子（NGF）和神经修复蛋白（MBP）的表达增加；髓鞘更厚；轴突直径更大；有髓轴突数量更多；神经传导功能改善（复合动作电位（CMAP）振幅和传导速度更高）；以及在针刺测试和趾张开测试（感觉和运动功能）中的功能结果更佳。

content.en: •In rabbits with sciatic nerve compression, topical 50% DMSO promoted nerve regeneration as confirmed by functional testing, electromyography, and histopathology,<sup data-ref="138">138</sup>, <sup data-ref="140">140</sup> (corroborating DMSO’s efficacy in treating compression neuropathies).
content.cn: •在坐骨神经受压的兔子身上，局部使用50%二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可促进神经再生，这一结果已通过功能测试、肌电图和组织病理学检查得到证实， <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> （这印证了DMSO在治疗压迫性神经病变方面的疗效）。

content.en: •DMSO also promoted Schwann cell proliferation after nerve injury: [in a sciatic nerve crush model](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=Mz9udXFtQxlwd67cOI6gloXUiR0tPNzhOd3Sly1jgVWh_0FLJ2nQE90mtpgRqLSMweF0fkSZKml9Q3DqfuHvBw6OeuCepb-c7BNdHzzSmfeXQmBfYChiPeHth3qUjIgnl8i-A4BLmscj20P1VapTl8-lU4l3zigllcUhbgaYxGLlBKGx-3JNaYmkGah30AQz&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN), the vehicle control group receiving 10% DMSO showed significantly higher Ki67-positive Schwann cell expression.
content.cn: •DMSO 还能促进神经损伤后施万细胞的增殖：在坐骨神经挤压损伤模型中，接受 10% DMSO 处理的溶剂对照组中，Ki67 阳性施万细胞的表达水平显著更高。

content.en: • [When DMSO was used](https://web.archive.org/web/20200919081124/https://shefayekhatam.ir/article-1-1663-en.html) as the fill agent within eggshell membrane nerve guidance channels bridging 1 cm rat sciatic nerve defects, it produced superior outcomes to autograft in several measures: higher Sciatic Functional Index scores (assessed by walking), greater myelinated axon counts, and significantly better muscle weight preservation at 90 days.
content.cn: • 当将二甲基亚砜（DMSO）用作填充剂，填充连接1厘米大鼠坐骨神经缺损处的蛋壳膜神经引导通道时，其在多项指标上均优于自体移植：坐骨神经功能指数评分更高（通过行走能力评估）、有髓神经元数量更多，且在90天时肌肉重量的保留情况显著更好。

content.en: DMSO also directly protects nerves from injury:
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）还能直接保护神经免受损伤：

content.en: •In cultured rat superior cervical ganglia, local application of DMSO delayed axon degeneration for up to 12 hours by preserving axonal structure and slowing microtubule degradation, with a protective effect comparable to overexpression of the WldS protein (a well-established standard for preventing axonal degeneration in nerve protection research).<sup data-ref="141">141</sup>, <sup data-ref="142">142</sup>
content.cn: •在体外培养的大鼠上颈神经节中，局部应用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）通过维持轴突结构并延缓微管降解，将轴突变性延迟长达12小时，其保护作用与WldS蛋白的过表达相当（WldS蛋白是神经保护研究中预防轴突变性的公认标准）。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup>

content.en:
•In frog and rabbit sciatic nerves, DMSO protected them from freezing damage <sup data-ref="143">143</sup>, <sup data-ref="144">144</sup>, <sup data-ref="145">145</sup>, <sup data-ref="146">146</sup>*
•* [0.00078% DMSO preserved bioelectrical activity](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?hl=en&as_sdt=0%2C44&q=PROTECTIVE+EFFECT+OF+0.1+MM+DMSO+ON+BIOELECTRICAL+ACTIVITY+OF+A+GROUP+NERVE-FIBERS+UNDER+INFLUENCE+OF+UV-RADIATION&btnG=) in a group of nerve fibers exposed to UV radiation.
*Note: [in the first part of this series](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-heals-the-brain-and-transforms), I showed that DMSO protects cells and organs throughout the body (particularly in the brain and spinal cord) from a wide range of otherwise lethal stressors.
content.cn:
•在青蛙和兔子的坐骨神经中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能保护它们免受冷冻损伤 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup>
0.00078%的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）使一组暴露于紫外线辐射下的神经纤维保持了生物电活动。
注：在本系列的第一部分中，我证明了二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能够保护全身的细胞和器官（尤其是大脑和脊髓）免受各种原本会致命的应激因素的伤害。*

content.en: Numerous readers have reported that DMSO regenerated and repaired their nerves. Two of the most remarkable ones were:
content.cn: 许多读者反映，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）帮助他们再生并修复了神经。其中最引人注目的两个案例是：

content.en: •A reader’s husband developed drop foot from a fall compressing a nerve, with the front leg muscles “basically dying” and pain severe enough to require near-overdose levels of opioids. DMSO was “a massive game changer, the only thing giving relief from nerve damage.” After eight weeks of topical use, “muscle had started growing back, an inch above ankle and inch below knee, which Neurosurgeon has no answer for and is in disbelief.” This muscle regrowth enabled a compression test and subsequent nerve release surgery, and two weeks post-surgery, he was walking better without his foot brace.<sup data-ref="147">147</sup>
content.cn: •一位读者的丈夫因摔倒导致神经受压而患上足下垂，前腿肌肉“基本坏死”，疼痛剧烈到需要服用接近过量剂量的阿片类药物才能缓解。二甲基亚砜（DMSO）“彻底改变了局面，是唯一能缓解神经损伤症状的药物”。 经过八周的外用治疗，“肌肉开始再生，范围位于脚踝上方一英寸和膝盖下方一英寸处，这让神经外科医生无法解释，甚至难以置信。”这种肌肉再生使得压迫测试和随后的神经松解手术成为可能，术后两周，他无需脚部支具就能走得更稳了。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: •Rebecca (who has been filming the DMSO testimonials I've posted like Todd’s) had her lower leg crushed in an accident over 10 years ago, requiring multiple surgeries, tissue transfer, and skin grafts. Despite numerous treatments, she had persistent poor circulation and extensive numbness throughout the scarred area. After two weeks of daily DMSO with aloe vera,<sup>⬖</sup> blood flow visibly increased into tissue that had turned gray and purple, sensation began returning to areas numb for 9.5 years, and as time goes on, more sensation returns.[¹](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/261198422)
content.cn: •丽贝卡（她一直负责拍摄我发布的DMSO使用见证视频，比如托德的那段）在10多年前的一场事故中小腿严重挤压受伤，不得不接受多次手术、组织移植和皮肤移植。尽管接受了多种治疗，但她疤痕区域的血液循环始终不良，且大面积区域持续麻木。 在连续两周每天使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）配合芦荟进行治疗后， <sup>⬖</sup> 原本已呈灰紫色的组织血液循环明显改善，那些麻木了9.5年的区域开始恢复知觉，并且随着时间的推移，感觉正在逐渐恢复。¹

content.en: Axolemmal Resealing
content.cn: 轴膜重新密封

content.en: When nerve fibers are cut or crushed, the ruptured membrane must reseal rapidly to prevent cell death. DMSO has been shown to significantly enhance this critical repair step. [In guinea pig spinal cord white matter](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1023/A:1019645505848), 5% DMSO enhanced axolemmal resealing under conditions of low calcium or low temperature (improving membrane potential recovery by approximately 21-23% and markedly reducing unrepaired axons), conditions that otherwise severely impair the repair process.
content.cn: 当神经纤维被切断或压碎时，破裂的膜必须迅速重新密封，以防止细胞死亡。研究表明，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能显著促进这一关键的修复步骤。 在豚鼠脊髓白质中，5%的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在低钙或低温条件下促进了轴突膜的重新密封（使膜电位恢复率提高约21-23%，并显著减少了未修复的轴突），而这些条件原本会严重阻碍修复过程。

content.en: Similarly, [in rat dorsal root axons](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/10465464/) in vivo, 0.5-5% DMSO significantly enhanced resealing in low-calcium conditions to levels comparable to normal physiological calcium, likely by disrupting the submembranous actin network and facilitating membrane reorganization.
content.cn: 同样，在活体大鼠背根轴突中，0.5%–5%的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在低钙条件下显著增强了膜再密封作用，使其达到与正常生理钙浓度相当的水平，这可能是通过破坏膜下肌动蛋白网络并促进膜重构来实现的。

content.en: [Even at very low concentrations](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1002/jnr.24232?casa_token=SSp4QCB__dkAAAAA:727oPVV871Myw4Y4vFC5qVeRHIqJDzjSI3ekL4CxTYu42bzdcZq6S-hWc5ZY12BFjxVzKpEub9-DcjM) (0.00064-0.2%), DMSO significantly increased axolemmal sealing frequencies in hippocampal-derived neuroblastoma cells, likely by enhancing Ca²⁺ influx and vesicle fusion.
content.cn: 即使在极低浓度（0.00064%-0.2%）下，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）也能显著增加海马源性神经母细胞瘤细胞的轴膜密封频率，这很可能是通过增强Ca²⁺内流和囊泡融合实现的。

content.en: Limb Regeneration
content.cn: 肢体再生

content.en: DMSO’s regenerative potential extends beyond nerve repair to whole-limb regeneration. In postmetamorphic bullfrogs (**which normally cannot regenerate amputated limbs**), repeated topical DMSO immersions of the amputated stump induced substantial regeneration in 100% of cases by 120 days, containing multiple cartilage elements, striated muscle, and evidence of bone remodeling.<sup data-ref="148">148</sup>
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的再生潜能不仅限于神经修复，更延伸至整条肢体的再生。在变态后的大蛙（通常无法再生被截断的肢体）身上，通过反复将截断的残端浸入二甲基亚砜溶液中，120天后100%的病例均出现了显著的再生，再生组织中包含多个软骨结构、横纹肌，并观察到骨重塑的迹象。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: DMSO appeared to promote cellular dedifferentiation and blastema formation, effectively unlocking latent regenerative capacity in these normally non-regenerating animals. In adult newts, a single systemic exposure to DMSO accelerated limb regeneration by approximately 48-72 hours, with markedly higher lysosomal hydrolase activity during the critical early phase, supporting enhanced tissue reorganization.<sup data-ref="149">149</sup>, <sup data-ref="150">150</sup>
content.cn: DMSO似乎能促进细胞去分化和芽原形成，从而有效激活了这些通常不具备再生能力的动物体内的潜在再生能力。在成年蝾螈中，单次全身性接触DMSO可将四肢再生时间缩短约48-72小时，且在关键的早期阶段，溶酶体水解酶活性显著升高，这表明组织重构能力得到了增强。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup>

content.en: Neuronal Differentiation
content.cn: 神经元分化

content.en: As I showed in [the previous article](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-heals-the-spine-and-reverses), a large number of studies show DMSO induces neural differentiation, thereby providing a way for the body’s stem cells to repair damaged nervous tissue.
content.cn: 正如我在上一篇文章中指出的那样，大量研究表明，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能诱导神经分化，从而为机体干细胞修复受损的神经组织提供了一种途径。

content.en: In one particularly relevant study of N1E-115 neuroblastoma cells, 1.5% DMSO for 48 hours reproducibly triggered neuronal characteristics (neurite outgrowth, functional excitability) without elevating intracellular calcium or triggering cell death.<sup data-ref="151">151</sup>, <sup data-ref="152">152</sup> When these DMSO-differentiated cells were seeded onto biomaterial scaffolds and implanted at peripheral nerve injury sites, they remained viable and continued to secrete neurotrophic factors at near-physiological concentrations at the implantation site for the entire regeneration periods studied (12 weeks for axonotmesis and 20 weeks for neurotmesis), creating a supportive local microenvironment for axonal regrowth, Schwann cell migration, and remyelination.<sup data-ref="153">153</sup> The differentiated cells maintained viability on chitosan membranes and other biomaterial scaffolds, supporting their potential for peripheral nerve tissue engineering.<sup data-ref="154">154</sup>, <sup data-ref="155">155</sup> Finally, when PLGA 90:10 tube-guides (with or without DMSO-differentiated cells) were used to bridge 10 mm rat sciatic nerve gaps, significant motor and sensory functional recovery was achieved in both groups over 20 weeks (comparable to each other, though inferior to autologous graft).<sup data-ref="155">155</sup>
content.cn: 在一项针对N1E-115神经母细胞瘤细胞的特别相关研究中，1.5%的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）处理48小时后，能够可重复地诱导出神经元特征（神经突生长、功能性兴奋性），且不会导致细胞内钙离子浓度升高或引发细胞死亡。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 当这些经二甲基亚砜（DMSO）分化的细胞被接种到生物材料支架上并移植到周围神经损伤部位时，它们在整个研究再生周期内（轴突断裂为12周，神经断裂为20周）均保持存活，并在移植部位持续以接近生理浓度的水平分泌神经营养因子， 从而为轴突再生、施万细胞迁移和再髓鞘化营造了有利的局部微环境。 <sup>1</sup> 这些分化细胞在壳聚糖膜及其他生物材料支架上均保持了存活能力，这证明了其在周围神经组织工程中的应用潜力。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 最后，当使用 PLGA 90:10 管状引导支架（无论是否含有二甲基亚砜（DMSO）分化细胞）来桥接 10 毫米的大鼠坐骨神经缺损时，两组在 20 周内均实现了显著的运动和感觉功能恢复（两组之间相当，但均逊于自体移植）。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: Dose-Dependent Regeneration
content.cn: 剂量依赖性再生

content.en: DMSO’s effects on nerve conduction are concentration-dependent and biphasic. At very low concentrations (0.01–0.1%), no effects on axonal transport,<sup data-ref="156">156</sup> action potential propagation,<sup data-ref="157">157</sup> or fast axonal transport <sup data-ref="158">158</sup> have been detected**.** At low concentrations (≤1%), DMSO enhances synaptic transmission and promotes neuronal repair.
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）对神经传导的影响呈浓度依赖性且为双相性。 在极低浓度（0.01–0.1%）下，未检测到其对轴突运输、 <sup>1</sup> 动作电位传导、 <sup>1</sup> 或快速轴突运输 <sup>1</sup> 产生任何影响。在低浓度（≤1%）下，DMSO可增强突触传递并促进神经元修复。

content.en: In mollusk neurons, concentrations up to 0.8% produced no significant changes in resting potential or ionic currents, while 4-8% caused reversible depolarization with altered firing patterns.<sup data-ref="159">159</sup>, <sup data-ref="160">160</sup>
content.cn: 在软体动物神经元中，浓度高达0.8%时，静息电位或离子电流均未发生显著变化；而浓度为4%至8%时，则会引起可逆性去极化，并伴随放电模式的改变。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup>

content.en: At higher concentrations (5–10%), it can reversibly disrupt fast axonal transport <sup data-ref="161">161</sup>, <sup data-ref="162">162</sup>, <sup data-ref="163">163</sup> and slow nerve conduction velocity or block it <sup data-ref="164">164</sup>, <sup data-ref="165">165</sup>, <sup data-ref="166">166</sup>, <sup data-ref="167">167</sup> (which likely contributes to its analgesic \[pain reducing\] properties). At the highest concentrations studied systemically (7.8% intraperitoneally for 10 days in rats—a concentration far exceeding what standard DMSO dosing can reach), reversible structural changes to myelin were observed (uncompacted lamellae, axonal swelling) with full functional recovery by day 55, while no structural changes occurred at 1.8% or 3.6%**.**<sup data-ref="168">168</sup> Likewise, when concentrated DMSO (33% or 100%) was injected perineurally around the rat sciatic nerve, dose-dependent (but recoverable) nerve injuries occurred.<sup data-ref="169">169</sup>, <sup data-ref="170">170</sup>
content.cn: 在较高浓度（5–10%）下，它会可逆性地干扰快速轴突运输 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> ，并减慢或阻断神经传导速度 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> （这很可能促成了其镇痛\[减轻疼痛\]特性）。 在已研究的最高全身给药浓度下（大鼠腹腔注射7.8%，持续10天——该浓度远超标准DMSO给药所能达到的水平），观察到髓鞘发生可逆性结构变化（层板未致密化、轴突肿胀），且至第55天功能完全恢复；而在1.8%或3.6%浓度下则未发生结构变化。 <sup>1</sup> 同样，当将高浓度二甲基亚砜（33%或100%）注射到大鼠坐骨神经周围的神经周围组织时，会发生剂量依赖性（但可逆）的神经损伤。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup>

content.en: This helps to explain why while DMSO typically aids nerve regeneration one early study found topical 90% DMSO applied under the skin directly to a nerve repair site (resulting in much higher concentrations than 90% DMSO applied to the skin above a nerve) had no measurable effect on regeneration rate or quality (though treated animals had fewer auto-amputated toes and finer scar lines).<sup data-ref="171">171</sup>
content.cn: 这有助于解释，尽管二甲基亚砜（DMSO）通常有助于神经再生，但一项早期研究发现，将90%的DMSO局部涂抹于皮下直接作用于神经修复部位（其浓度远高于涂抹在神经上方皮肤表面的90% DMSO），却对再生速率或质量没有可测量的影响（尽管接受治疗的动物自发性截肢的趾数较少，且疤痕线更为细腻）。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: *Note: intraperitoneal DMSO (which creates higher DMSO levels than topical applications) had no adverse impact on olfactory neuroepithelium, axon pathways, regeneration, or targeting, confirming the safety of systemic applications for nerves.<sup data-ref="172">172</sup>
content.cn: 注：腹腔注射二甲基亚砜（其产生的二甲基亚砜浓度高于局部给药）对嗅觉神经上皮、轴突通路、再生或靶向作用均无不良影响，这证实了全身给药对神经的安全性。 <sup>1</sup>*

content.en: Synaptic Transmission and Neuromuscular Function
content.cn: 突触传递与神经肌肉功能

content.en:
DMSO directly enhances neurotransmitter release at synapses and neuromuscular junctions:
• [In frog neuromuscular preparations](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/0005273685901816), DMSO (0.5-5%) acted as a fusogenic agent that promoted synaptic vesicle fusion with the nerve terminal membrane, markedly elevating spontaneous acetylcholine release even in near-calcium-free conditions and increasing evoked release 2- to 19-fold depending on concentration and calcium levels.
• [In guinea pig tracheal spirals](https://www.thelancet.com/journals/lancet/article/PII0140-6736\(90\)90052-7/abstract), 1% DMSO caused a 13% increase in electrically induced muscle contractions.
• [In bullfrog sympathetic ganglia](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/2986996/), DMSO (3-10%) restored synaptic transmission under low-calcium conditions that would otherwise impair signaling, preserving acetylcholine release and even inducing repetitive firing from a single stimulus.
content.cn:
二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可直接促进突触和神经肌肉接头处神经递质的释放：
• 在青蛙神经肌肉制备中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO，0.5%～5%）作为一种促融合剂，能促进突触小泡与神经末梢膜的融合，即使在几乎不含钙的条件下，也能显著提高自发乙酰胆碱释放量，并根据浓度和钙离子水平的不同，使诱发释放量增加2至19倍。
• 在豚鼠气管螺旋肌中，1%的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）使电刺激引起的肌肉收缩增加了13%。
• 在牛蛙交感神经节中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO，3%–10%）在低钙条件下恢复了原本会受损的突触传递，维持了乙酰胆碱的释放，甚至能通过单一刺激诱导重复放电。

content.en:
• [In frog sympathetic ganglia](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/6302155/), DMSO enhanced synaptic transmission by increasing and prolonging fast excitatory postsynaptic potentials, likely through interference with potassium permeability.
• [DMSO potentiated synaptic transmission](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?hl=en&as_sdt=2005&sciodt=0%2C5&cites=17512746988360137432&scipsc=&q=Effect+of+dimethyl+sulfoxide+on+the+transmission+of+impulses+in+the+superior+cervical+ganglion+of+the+rat&btnG=) at the rat superior cervical ganglion prior to neostigmine treatment.
content.cn:
• 在青蛙交感神经节中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）通过增强并延长快速兴奋性突触后电位来增强突触传递，这很可能是通过干扰钾离子通透性实现的。
• 在新东莨菪碱治疗之前，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）增强了大鼠上颈神经节的突触传递。

content.en: *Note: [in garter snakes](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC1986958/), 0.5% DMSO had no effect on spontaneous acetylcholine release or resting membrane potential, but did increase endplate current amplitudes and prolong their time courses, consistent with its known acetylcholinesterase inhibiting activity. Likewise, [at the squid synapse](https://physoc.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1113/jphysiol.1993.sp019963), neither DMSO (0.1%) nor nitrendipine affected transmission.
content.cn: 注：在缨蛇中，0.5%的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）对自发乙酰胆碱释放或静息膜电位无影响，但确实增加了终板电流的振幅并延长了其持续时间，这与其已知的乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制活性一致。同样，在鱿鱼突触处，无论是DMSO（0.1%）还是硝苯地平，均未影响神经传递。*

content.en: Additionally, DMSO has a particular affinity for adrenergic (sympathetic) nerve tissue: [when added to glyoxylic acid histochemical preparations](https://europepmc.org/article/med/3324998), DMSO markedly improved the visualization of adrenergic nerve elements, consistent with enhanced penetration and concentration within these structures. Finally, [in rabbit ileum](https://www.jstage.jst.go.jp/article/jphs1951/18/1/18_1_86/_article/-char/ja/), 0.44% DMSO completely blocked sympathetic nerve-mediated inhibition of contractions after two hours while having no direct effect on ileal tone or rhythmicity (even after six hours), with exogenous noradrenaline retaining full activity, confirming DMSO selectively impaired nerve conduction rather than blocking adrenergic receptors.
content.cn: 此外，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）对肾上腺素能（交感）神经组织具有特殊的亲和力：当将其加入羟基乙酸组织化学制备物中时，DMSO显著提高了肾上腺素能神经元素的可视化效果，这与该物质在这些结构内的渗透性和浓度增强相一致。 最后，在兔回肠中，0.44%的DMSO在两小时后完全阻断了交感神经介导的收缩抑制作用，同时对回肠张力或节律性没有直接影响（即使在六小时后也是如此），外源性去甲肾上腺素仍保持完全活性，这证实DMSO是选择性地损害了神经传导，而非阻断肾上腺素能受体。

content.en: Combination Studies in Peripheral Nerve Models
content.cn: 外周神经模型中的联合研究

content.en:
In many studies and patents, DMSO is used to deliver (and potentiate) an agent, where in many cases, the therapeutic properties of the combination resemble what DMSO alone does (and in some cases, the study makes it possible to independently assess the effects of DMSO, where often, a benefit from DMSO alone is observed—but often not mentioned in the article’s summary). In this series, I have included the combination studies for you to **skim** through both because they shed light on possible therapeutic effects of DMSO (particularly if common benefits are seen across multiple combinations) and because they provide ideas for therapeutic combinations readers can utilize (with natural agents that were combined with DMSO being marked with a <sup>⬖</sup> to support readers exploring combination options).
*Note: I believe a key reason lab results are frequently not seen in humans is because lab studies often use DMSO whereas human studies only use the agent.
content.cn:
在许多研究和专利中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）被用于输送（并增强）某种活性成分，而在许多情况下，这种组合的治疗特性与DMSO单独使用时的效果相似（在某些情况下，研究使得能够独立评估DMSO的作用，通常会观察到DMSO单独使用带来的益处——但这在文章摘要中往往未被提及）。 在本系列中，我收录了这些联合用药研究供您浏览，一方面是因为它们揭示了二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可能具有的治疗效果（特别是当多种组合中均观察到共同益处时），另一方面是因为它们为读者提供了可运用的治疗组合思路（与二甲基亚砜（DMSO）联合使用的天然药物均用 <sup>⬖</sup> 标记，以帮助读者探索组合方案）。
注：我认为实验室研究结果在人体中往往无法复现的一个关键原因在于，实验室研究通常使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO），而人体研究仅使用该药物本身。*

content.en:
