For example, DMSO (in 5–50% aqueous solutions) has been repeatedly described in the Russian literature as a universal solvent for topical iontophoretic (electrical) delivery in peripheral nervous system diseases (including neuritis and neuralgia of the facial, radial, ulnar, femoral, sciatic, and tibial nerves), as it enhances drug penetration and pharmacological activity and enables iontophoretic treatment with water-insoluble medications.<sup data-ref="173">173</sup>, <sup data-ref="174">174</sup> Numerous DMSO combinations have hence been used to treat nerve injuries. These include:
•Histamine transiently improved pain and touch perception at leprosy lesions in 31--47% of patients (depending on concentration).<sup data-ref="175">175</sup>
content.cn:
例如， 俄罗斯文献中多次将二甲基亚砜（DMSO，5%–50%水溶液）描述为外用离子导入（电导入）治疗周围神经系统疾病（包括面神经、桡神经、尺神经、股神经、坐骨神经和胫神经的神经炎及神经痛）的通用溶剂，因为它能增强药物的渗透性和药理活性，并使水不溶性药物也能进行离子导入治疗。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 因此，已有多种二甲基亚砜（DMSO）复方制剂被用于治疗神经损伤。其中包括：
•在31%至47%的患者中（具体比例取决于浓度），组胺可暂时改善麻风病病变处的疼痛和触觉感知。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en:
•A peripheral nerve injury patent using DMSO mixed with spasmolytic medications applied over specific anatomical zones under a pulsating magnetic field.<sup data-ref="176">176</sup>
•Another patent that used topical stephaglabrine sulfate <sup>⬖</sup> in a DMSO-containing base.<sup data-ref="177">177</sup>
content.cn:
•一种治疗周围神经损伤的方法，即在脉冲磁场作用下，将二甲基亚砜（DMSO）与解痉药物混合后涂抹于特定解剖区域。 <sup>1</sup>
•另一项专利，该专利将硫酸斯泰法格拉林 <sup>⬖</sup> 用于含有二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的基质中。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: Likewise, a large number of agents dissolved in DMSO have demonstrated therapeutic benefit in peripheral nerve injury models (following sciatic nerve injury):
content.cn: 同样，大量溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的药物在周围神经损伤模型（坐骨神经损伤后）中均显示出治疗效果：

content.en:
•Curcumin <sup>⬖</sup> promoted Schwann cell autophagy, reduced apoptosis, and facilitated myelination and axon regeneration through the Erk1/2 and Akt pathway.<sup data-ref="178">178</sup>
•Resveratrol <sup>⬖</sup> improved motor function and upregulated NeuN/MAP2 with preserved anterior horn neuron numbers.<sup data-ref="179">179</sup>
•Rapamycin enhanced autophagy, increased LC3-II expression, promoted motor recovery (2-fold higher stand time at 1-2 weeks), increased myelin basic protein and neurofilament-200 immunoreactivity, and reduced Schwann cell apoptosis.<sup data-ref="180">180</sup>
•Pterostilbene <sup>⬖</sup> further increased Schwann cell proliferation beyond DMSO alone, improved sciatic nerve function, upregulated autophagy markers, and increased myelin thickness.<sup data-ref="181">181</sup>
•Lycopene <sup>⬖</sup> (in eggshell membrane nerve guidance channels) achieved superior functional recovery, muscle preservation, myelinated axon counts, myelin thickness, and Schwann cell density comparable to autograft.<sup data-ref="182">182</sup>, <sup data-ref="183">183</sup>
•Minocycline attenuated the neuroinflammatory cascade that perpetuates nerve injury, suppressed spinal microglial activation, reduced BDNF upregulation, and inhibited PI3K and ERK phosphorylation (with comparable efficacy to local pulsed radiofrequency).<sup data-ref="137">137</sup>, <sup data-ref="184">184</sup>
content.cn:
•姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 通过Erk1/2和Akt通路促进施万细胞自噬、减少凋亡，并促进髓鞘形成和轴突再生。 <sup>1</sup>
•白藜芦醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 改善了运动功能，并上调了NeuN/MAP2的表达，同时保持了前角神经元的数量。 <sup>1</sup>
•雷帕霉素增强了自噬，提高了LC3-II的表达，促进了运动功能恢复（1-2周时站立时间延长了2倍），增加了髓鞘基本蛋白和神经丝-200的免疫反应性，并减少了施万细胞的凋亡。 <sup>1</sup>
•翼苯 <sup>⬖</sup> 不仅比单独使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）更能促进施万细胞增殖，还改善了坐骨神经功能，上调了自噬标志物，并增加了髓鞘厚度。 <sup>1</sup>
•番茄红素 <sup>⬖</sup> （存在于蛋壳膜神经引导通道中）在功能恢复、肌肉保存、有髓神经元数量、髓鞘厚度以及施万细胞密度方面均表现优异，其效果可与自体移植相媲美。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup>
•米诺环素减轻了导致神经损伤持续的神经炎症级联反应，抑制了脊髓小胶质细胞的活化，降低了脑源性神经营养因子（BDNF）的上调，并抑制了PI3K和ERK的磷酸化（其疗效与局部脉冲射频相当）。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup>

content.en: Among agents targeting specific pathways, [a ROCK inhibitor](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41201025/) enhanced axonal regeneration, growth cone expansion, Schwann cell proliferation, remyelination, and functional recovery via PI3K/GSK3β signaling, [a caspase-1 inhibitor](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37872210/) reduced Schwann cell pyroptosis, demyelination, and reactive oxygen species through Nrf2/HO-1 modulation, [an HDAC6 inhibitor](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFDLAST2018&filename=1018815189.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=bfkm1naXAIP0EfnPa4GmJh1Kz4fxk1fv9YJ9-b5oJkaJdiiUUUEaAMsmYiJB0Rig) (Tubastatin A) reduced dorsal root ganglion neuronal apoptosis and improved sensory function in a cauda equina compression model and [a p38MAPK inhibitor](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFDLAST2016&filename=1015597126.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=hfkaCthsXKLUlt5_I9WHxlA6c5OLRrE2ZISwzU9VK-CPIcwORY4qaFb7gQo-DDlM) ameliorated skeletal muscle fibrosis and reduced connective tissue growth factor expression after chronic nerve compression.
content.cn: 在针对特定信号通路的药物中，一种ROCK抑制剂通过PI3K/GSK3β信号通路促进了轴突再生、生长锥扩张、施万细胞增殖、脱髓鞘修复及功能恢复；一种caspase-1抑制剂则通过Nrf2/HO-1调节机制减轻了施万细胞的焦亡、 脱髓鞘以及活性氧的产生；一种HDAC6抑制剂（Tubastatin A）在马尾神经压迫模型中减轻了背根神经节神经元的凋亡并改善了感觉功能；而一种p38MAPK抑制剂在慢性神经压迫后缓解了骨骼肌纤维化并降低了结缔组织生长因子的表达。

content.en: Additional agents showing neuroprotective or pro-regenerative effects for peripheral nerves include an [FK506 inducer](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=r3g0b1Wd3tfQHqOojdPh6a2Z_4MwWr-SMk6Bj_KWFWTZ7JR9U6ibflcrmTNb91OnJr7dHl5PRxa0tT-CQ5_PSpQ98i8HBbsPJfhctJEiZZcFgCdXvZbOAqr970hCyE9i2VrUheYG7XDC_hMapx4yU9xKsmlsiZDFVy4ndVpP3uZ0yZkeKgz9iAQJotoM3pu6&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) (promoted Schwann cell differentiation with increased GFAP and NF200 expression), [clobetasol](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=BoNITJRTahIadC5ZPCSDK3vP3vIMSCdmjtkfVV5twU2LgIYtyLAt5YbeRnupX9poe6CazquBMonlGjZnOyUrTEDbSlYDr30sQm4-1YqVq7jO5HhkX6wWKVDvYxc5cPtc7jc5kdNtHJGfr6qErqOJ8lOFmwXd3c2Z18cNKYbHLbxRUpBTTiAWeVHhpnpPZH9MOb7PFaIZ8og=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) (enhanced Schwann cell proliferation and NRG1/EGR2 expression in sericin nerve conduits, achieving recovery comparable to autograft), [chondroitinase ABC](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFDLAST2016&filename=1016080262.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=Hf8L_70_H55BrEVUV7RfAVyaDge_lC9qty-QvqQgvNHkTA3k1SxoVLXJPj7EIgFQ) combined with intracellular sigma peptide (promoted axon regeneration and motor neuron survival in brachial plexus avulsion), and [tetramethylpyrazine](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFDLAST2015&filename=1014411096.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=2-2sys__VafE4bCjy03Eu2x27eiujQ63a_sMewnSolsicp68A6rfdQsIpKn-WAi-) <sup>⬖</sup> (induced bone marrow mesenchymal stem cell neural differentiation, significantly improving motor function, evoked potentials, and NGF expression after sciatic nerve injury).
content.cn: 其他对周围神经具有神经保护或促进再生作用的药物包括：FK506诱导剂（可促进施万细胞分化，并增加GFAP和NF200的表达）， 氯倍他索（在丝胶神经导管中增强施万细胞增殖及NRG1/EGR2表达，其恢复效果可与自体移植媲美）、ABC型软骨素酶联合细胞内σ肽（在臂丛神经撕脱伤中促进轴突再生和运动神经元存活），以及四甲基吡嗪 <sup>⬖</sup> （诱导骨髓间充质干细胞的神经分化，显著改善坐骨神经损伤后的运动功能、诱发电位及NGF表达）。

content.en: Among agents promoting axonal outgrowth across inhibitory barriers, [diltiazem](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s12035-018-1349-5) enhanced axon regeneration up to 2-fold in adult mouse DRG neurons on inhibitory CSPG substrates and similarly promoted outgrowth in human induced sensory neurons, while [quercetin](https://www.fujifoundation.or.jp/report/pdf/030/30_22.pdf) <sup>⬖</sup> [and genistein](https://www.fujifoundation.or.jp/report/pdf/030/30_22.pdf) <sup>⬖</sup> enhanced NGF-induced neurite outgrowth in PC12 cells via Na⁺/K⁺/2Cl⁻ cotransporter activation and [nimodipine](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6272420/) (which enhanced NGF-induced neurite outgrowth from neurons in a concentration-dependent manner while protecting against ethanol and osmotic stress-induced cytotoxicity). [Miconazole](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201801&filename=1017970919.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=9jqCeRAK_3bGm9rnP3QWNUPKrCg9Cdn8H7Cf6VAlBeZI1S7KR2UB0Wd3XsQqaj6r) reversed organophosphate-induced delayed neuropathy in hens, restoring Nissl bodies, sciatic nerve S100β, and myelin basic protein expression while normalizing ErbB3/Akt signaling.
content.cn: 在促进轴突穿过抑制性屏障生长的多种药物中，地尔硫卓在抑制性CSPG基质上将成年小鼠DRG神经元的轴突再生能力提高了2倍，并以类似方式促进了人类诱导感觉神经元的轴突生长， 而槲皮素 <sup>⬖</sup> 和染料木黄酮 <sup>⬖</sup> 则通过激活 Na⁺/K⁺/2Cl⁻ 共转运蛋白，增强了 PC12 细胞中 NGF 诱导的神经突生长；尼莫地平（其以浓度依赖性方式增强了神经元中 NGF 诱导的神经突生长，同时能抵御乙醇和渗透应激诱导的细胞毒性）。 咪康唑逆转了母鸡中有机磷化合物诱导的延迟性神经病变，恢复了尼氏小体、坐骨神经S100β及髓鞘基本蛋白的表达，同时使ErbB3/Akt信号传导恢复正常。

content.en: DMSO combinations also counteracted the neuropsychiatric consequences of nerve injuries. In rats, intrathecal (delivered into the CSF) [rapamycin](https://pesquisa.bvsalud.org/portal/resource/pt/wpr-745662) attenuated depression (triggered by spinal nerve ligation-induced neuropathic pain), increasing mechanical withdrawal thresholds, reducing forced swim immobility, and restoring prefrontal cortex autophagy (upregulating LC3 II/Beclin-1, downregulating p62). Likewise in rats, an [α5-GABAAR inverse agonist](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=edlgIlFUcgtmDyHfSnywMNH-QpidZsRb5xu8SpYj8qWhtdArZJu-onAQesuATcdRj3Q0Hr9D4tQ1MedVdhNLKwMAem-YboK7Bwjq9hRrHsC8zmpcTGEOMnHKNGXZ4H1DT3B9QIbHARcsvPyJwW4C8KVxi2N8N0JSWHIZs50cHIsgPToPusaTVw==&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) reversed GABAergic cognitive impairment (lost recognition memory and spatial alternation) following [sciatic nerve injury](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=edlgIlFUcgtmDyHfSnywMNH-QpidZsRb5xu8SpYj8qWhtdArZJu-onAQesuATcdRj3Q0Hr9D4tQ1MedVdhNLKwMAem-YboK7Bwjq9hRrHsC8zmpcTGEOMnHKNGXZ4H1DT3B9QIbHARcsvPyJwW4C8KVxi2N8N0JSWHIZs50cHIsgPToPusaTVw==&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN).
content.cn: DMSO联合用药还缓解了神经损伤引起的神经精神后果。 在大鼠实验中，鞘内给药（注入脑脊液）的雷帕霉素减轻了（由脊神经结扎诱导的神经病理性疼痛引发的）抑郁症状，提高了机械性撤回阈值，缩短了强迫游泳试验中的不动时间，并恢复了前额叶皮层的自噬（上调了LC3 II/Beclin-1，下调了p62）。 同样在大鼠实验中，α5-GABAAR 反向激动剂逆转了坐骨神经损伤后引起的 GABA 能认知障碍（识别记忆丧失和空间交替行为障碍）。

content.en: *Note: the one drug which caused significant issues in combination with DMSO was sulindac (a now restricted NSAID) which sometimes caused neurotoxic reactions (e.g., there was one case of a profound mixed sensorimotor peripheral neuropathy <sup data-ref="185">185</sup>, <sup data-ref="186">186</sup>, <sup data-ref="187">187</sup>, <sup data-ref="188">188</sup>) despite DMSO reducing sulindac’s bioactivity,<sup data-ref="189">189</sup>
content.cn: 注：唯一一种与二甲基亚砜（DMSO）联用时引发严重问题的药物是苏林达克（一种目前已受限制的非甾体抗炎药），该药有时会引起神经毒性反应（例如，曾有一例严重的混合性感觉运动性周围神经病变 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> ），尽管二甲基亚砜会降低苏林达克的生物活性， <sup>1</sup>*

content.en: Veterinary Applications
content.cn: 兽医应用

content.en: DMSO is used in veterinary practice for a variety of peripheral nerve conditions and has been cited in multiple veterinary textbooks and reviews as a conventional treatment for peripheral nerve conditions in dogs and horses (that is valued for its anti-inflammatory, analgesic, antioxidant, and tissue-penetrating properties). <sup data-ref="190">190</sup>, <sup data-ref="191">191</sup>
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在兽医临床实践中用于治疗多种周围神经疾病，并被多部兽医教科书和综述文献列为犬和马周围神经疾病的常规治疗方法（因其具有抗炎、镇痛、抗氧化及组织渗透等特性而备受推崇）。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup>

content.en: In horses, published cases show IV DMSO contributed to recovery from temporohyoid osteoarthropathy with facial nerve and vestibular deficits,<sup data-ref="192">192</sup> femoral nerve paralysis secondary to rhabdomyolysis (complete resolution by day 19),<sup data-ref="193">193</sup> and post-anesthetic femoral neuropathy (one of two horses achieved full recovery after 6 months).<sup data-ref="194">194</sup>
content.cn: 在马匹中，已发表的病例显示，静脉注射二甲基亚砜（DMSO）有助于治疗伴有面神经和前庭功能障碍的颞舌骨骨关节病、 <sup>1</sup> 继发于横纹肌溶解症的股神经麻痹（第19天完全缓解）， <sup>1</sup> 以及麻醉后股神经病变（两匹马中有一匹在6个月后完全康复）。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: Additionally:此外：

•Topical DMSO applied as cold packs [resolved bilateral radial nerve paralysis](https://vetjournal.it/images/archive/pdf_riviste/3979.pdf) in a newborn foal with dystocia-related (birth trauma) compression injury.
content.cn: •将局部涂抹的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）作为冷敷剂使用，成功治愈了一例因难产（分娩创伤）导致压迫性损伤的新生驹所患的双侧桡神经麻痹。

content.en: •A rectal DMSO protocol (combined with an anti-inflammatory, vitamin E,<sup>⬖</sup> and an antibiotic) [fully and permanently reversed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/20002548/) a severe movement disorder in horses (stringhalt graded at the worst possible score) caused by distal axonopathy with mixed polyneuropathy.
content.cn: •一种直肠给药的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）治疗方案（联合使用抗炎药、维生素E、 <sup>⬖</sup> 和抗生素），彻底且永久性地治愈了由远端轴突病变合并混合性多发性神经病变引起的马匹严重运动障碍（“跛行”症状评分达到最严重等级）。

content.en: • [Post-anesthetic myopathies and neuropraxias](https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Geraldo-Eleno-Alves/publication/268395682_Dimetilsulfoxido_DMSO/links/551d67700cf252bc3a87a882/Dimetilsulfoxido-DMSO.pdf) in horses are a recognized indication for topical DMSO.
content.cn: • 马匹的麻醉后肌病和神经功能障碍是公认的局部使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的适应症。

content.en: • [In a large clinical series of 172 horses](https://www.cabidigitallibrary.org/doi/full/10.5555/19772200647), a DMSO-corticosteroid preparation applied to 21 conditions (including neuritis) achieved signs of improvement in 85.5% of cases.
content.cn: • 在一项涉及172匹马的大型临床研究中，将二甲基亚砜（DMSO）-皮质类固醇制剂用于治疗21种病症（包括神经炎），其中85.5%的病例出现了好转迹象。

content.en: Peripheral Neuropathies
content.cn: 周围神经病变

content.en: DMSO’s therapeutic properties have allowed it to treat a wide range of peripheral nerve conditions, from complex regional pain syndrome (where it has the strongest evidence base, including multiple randomized controlled trials) to facial nerve palsy, trigeminal neuralgia, post herpetic neuralgia, compression neuropathies, diabetic neuropathy and many different types of neuropathic pain.
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的治疗特性使其能够用于治疗多种外周神经疾病，从复杂性区域疼痛综合征（该领域拥有最充分的证据基础，包括多项随机对照试验）到面神经麻痹、三叉神经痛、带状疱疹后神经痛、压迫性神经病变、糖尿病神经病变以及多种类型的神经病理性疼痛。

content.en: Complex Regional Pain Syndrome
content.cn: 复杂性区域疼痛综合征

content.en: One of my favorite therapies was discovered a century ago after observing that intravenous or locally injected procaine could almost instantaneously resolve a wide range of debilitating symptoms (or accelerate wound healing), particularly in painful scars, where the pain relief and cessation of other symptoms lasted long after the anesthetic had worn off. This led to the realization injuries (e.g., from toxins, infections, or scars) could create “interference fields” where nerves became hyper-excitable (disrupting the autonomic nervous system) and that local anesthetics could reset this, as when anesthesia wore off the hyperactive nerve, its firing pattern would reset and it would no longer be “hyperactive” (and hence no longer inappropriately trigger the autonomic nervous system).
content.cn: 我最喜欢的疗法之一是在一个世纪前被发现的，当时人们观察到，静脉注射或局部注射普鲁卡因几乎能立即缓解各种令人衰弱的症状（或加速伤口愈合），特别是在疼痛性疤痕方面，即使麻醉药效已过，疼痛缓解及其他症状消失的效果仍能持续很长时间。 这促使人们认识到，损伤（例如由毒素、感染或疤痕引起）可能会产生“干扰场”，导致神经处于过度兴奋状态（从而扰乱自主神经系统），而局部麻醉剂能够重置这种状态——当麻醉作用从过度活跃的神经上消退时，其放电模式会恢复正常，不再处于“过度活跃”状态（因此也不会再不当触发自主神经系统）。

content.en: Neural therapy’s success in treating a wide range of “incurable” symptoms led to decades of German research which mapped out how specific nerves and ganglia could contribute to specific chronic issues (while in parallel mainstream medicine recognized anesthetizing neuronal centers like the stellate ganglion had therapeutic utility). Practitioners across the world, in turn, gradually recognized how often “toxic scars” created chronic health problems and incrementally adopted the German protocols and found ways besides anesthetics to treat interference fields. Finally, the most talented ones realized that while common patterns in interference fields existed, refining their ability to detect them led to the best success, and in many cases resulted in them injecting areas outside the classic neural therapy locations.
content.cn: 神经疗法在治疗各种“不治之症”方面取得的成功，促使德国进行了长达数十年的研究，从而厘清了特定神经和神经节如何导致特定的慢性疾病（与此同时，主流医学界也认识到，对星状神经节等神经中枢进行麻醉具有治疗价值）。 随后，世界各地的从业者逐渐认识到“毒性疤痕”是导致慢性健康问题的常见原因，于是逐步采纳了德国的治疗方案，并探索出除麻醉剂以外治疗干扰场的其他方法。最终，最杰出的从业者意识到，尽管干扰场中存在一些常见模式，但只有精进检测能力才能取得最佳疗效，这使得他们在许多情况下将注射部位扩展到了传统神经疗法定位范围之外。

content.en: *Note: one common consequence of an interference field is chronic irritation or low grade inflammation. Another (from it driving sympathetic overactivity) is vasoconstriction, as excess sympathetic tone constricts the arterioles and blood supplying a region. This may also, in part, explain why Stanley Jacob found 50% of Raynaud’s patients fully recovered with DMSO <sup data-ref="3">3</sup> and why many readers with it have reported improved circulation to their fingers and toes following DMSO.
content.cn: 注：干扰场的一种常见后果是慢性刺激或低度炎症。 另一种后果（源于其导致交感神经过度活跃）是血管收缩，因为过度的交感神经张力会收缩小动脉并限制向该区域的血液供应。这在一定程度上也可以解释，为什么斯坦利·雅各布发现50%的雷诺氏症患者在使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）后完全康复 <sup>1</sup> ，以及为什么许多患有该病的读者报告称，在使用二甲基亚砜后，手指和脚趾的血液循环有所改善。*

content.en: One of the diseases many have recognized best maps to the neural therapy concept <sup data-ref="195">195</sup>, <sup data-ref="196">196</sup>, <sup data-ref="197">197</sup> is “complex regional pain syndrome” (CRPS, previously called reflex sympathetic dystrophy) a chronic neurological disorder marked by severe, persistent pain—often burning, shooting, or throbbing (typically in one limb) accompanied by pain hypersensitivity and autonomic dysfunction such as skin color or temperature changes, swelling, abnormal sweating, motor dysfunction (weakness, tremors, stiffness), and trophic changes (hair, nail, or skin alterations).
content.cn: 许多人认为最符合神经疗法概念的疾病之一 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> 是“复杂性区域疼痛综合征” （CRPS，以前称为反射性交感神经萎缩症），这是一种慢性神经系统疾病，其特征是剧烈且持续的疼痛——通常表现为灼痛、刺痛或搏动性疼痛（通常发生在一侧肢体），并伴有疼痛高敏反应和自主神经功能障碍，例如皮肤颜色或温度变化、肿胀、异常出汗、运动功能障碍（无力、震颤、僵硬）以及营养性改变（毛发、指甲或皮肤的改变）。

content.en:
The cause of CRPS is still not understood but it is recognized to typically have a trigger (e.g., a trauma, surgery, stroke, heart attack, or other injury) that is typically “much less severe” than the ensuing pain, and in some cases (CRPS Type 2) to have accompanying nerve damage.
Note: one of the side effects [repeatedly linked to the HPV vaccine](https://www.amazon.com/HPV-Vaccine-Trial-Generation-Betrayed/dp/1799754944) was CRPS Type 1.
content.cn:
CRPS的病因尚不明确，但已知该病通常存在某种诱因（例如外伤、手术、中风、心脏病发作或其他损伤），其严重程度通常“远低于”随后出现的疼痛；在某些情况下（CRPS 2型），还会伴有神经损伤。*
注：与HPV疫苗反复关联的副作用之一是1型复杂性区域疼痛综合征（CRPS）。*

content.en:
Presently, no definitive cure exists for CRPS, so a variety of partially effective treatments are used, including secondary ones like ganglion blocks and IV ketamine (which can reset neuronal hypersensitivity and may work in cases where nothing else does). Because of this, I periodically run into patients with debilitating CRPS (which often has been there for years) who experience immediate and dramatic relief from a (correctly targeted) lidocaine or procaine injection—making it immensely frustrating that there is no conventional support for neural therapy (particularly since its uses go far beyond pain management).
*Note: some psychiatric disorders are triggered by autonomic imbalances, and in CRPS (a disorder frequently associated with psychiatric co-morbidities) I have seen numerous cases where injecting a “toxic scar” with lidocaine caused longstanding mood issues (e.g., agitation or anxiety) to immediately improve. Likewise, I frequently encounter psychiatric disorders that require either addressing sources of excess sympathetic activity or deficient parasympathetic activity (e.g., one reader recently reported good effects from a DMSO protocol for the vagal nerve I shared <sup data-ref="198">198</sup>), while other psychiatrists I know have had significant success unconventionally using the alpha-2 agonists guanfacine and clonidine (which reduce sympathetic activity) to treat anxiety, PTSD, and panic disorders. DMSO’s use in psychiatric disorders is discussed further in [the first part of this series](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-heals-the-brain-and-transforms).
content.cn:
目前，CRPS尚无根治方法，因此采用多种效果有限的治疗手段，包括神经节阻滞和静脉注射氯胺酮等辅助治疗（这些方法可重置神经元超敏反应，在其他方法均无效的情况下可能奏效）。 正因如此，我时常会遇到患有严重CRPS（通常已持续多年）的患者，他们通过（准确定位的）利多卡因或普鲁卡因注射获得立竿见影且显著的缓解——这使得神经疗法缺乏常规医学支持的情况令人极其沮丧（尤其是考虑到其应用范围远不止于疼痛管理）。
注：某些精神障碍是由自主神经失衡引发的，而在复杂性区域疼痛综合征（CRPS，一种常伴有精神共病的情况）中，我曾遇到过许多病例，向“毒性瘢痕”注射利多卡因后，长期存在的情绪问题（如躁动或焦虑）会立即得到改善。 同样，我经常遇到需要针对交感神经活动亢进或副交感神经活动不足进行干预的精神障碍（例如，一位读者最近反馈，我分享的针对迷走神经的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）治疗方案 <sup>1</sup> 效果显著），而我认识的其他精神科医生则通过非传统方式，成功使用α-2受体激动剂可乐定和克隆定（这两种药物可降低交感神经活动）来治疗焦虑、 创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）以及惊恐障碍方面取得了显著成效。关于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在精神疾病中的应用，本系列的第一部分将进行更深入的探讨。*

content.en: Since CRPS is challenging to treat, its responsiveness to DMSO immediately caught physicians’ attention, leading to roughly a dozen clinical studies which consistently found topical DMSO cream improved acute “warm” CRPS, with the strongest effects seen when treatment begins early in the disease course.
content.cn: 由于CRPS难以治疗，其对二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的反应性立即引起了医生的关注，由此开展了大约十几项临床研究，这些研究一致表明，外用DMSO乳膏可改善急性“热型”CRPS，且在疾病早期开始治疗时效果最为显著。

content.en: This began [with a 1985 study](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/3931223/) that transformed medical understanding of CRPS by showing that free-radical scavengers like DMSO could significantly reduce pain, swelling, and burning sensations (with an approximately 90% recovery rate when the therapy was initiated in the early stages of the illness).
content.cn: 这一切始于1985年的一项研究，该研究通过证明二甲基亚砜（DMSO）等自由基清除剂能够显著减轻疼痛、肿胀和灼热感（若在疾病早期阶段开始治疗，康复率可达约90%），从而彻底改变了医学界对复杂性区域疼痛综合征（CRPS）的认识。

content.en: In the earliest controlled studies, DMSO significantly outperformed both placebo and regional sympathetic blocks (with intravenous Ismelin) for pain reduction, range of motion, and overall clinical improvement, with one crossover study (likely unaware of DMSO’s neurological effects) concluding that DMSO’s efficacy “indicates that RSD primarily involves an inflammatory process rather than a sympathetic reflex.” <sup data-ref="199">199</sup>, <sup data-ref="200">200</sup>, <sup data-ref="201">201</sup>, <sup data-ref="202">202</sup>, <sup data-ref="203">203</sup> In [an RCT of 31 patients](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/8721469/), DMSO cream reduced the median RSD-score from 5 to 0 over two months (vs. 4 to 2 with placebo, p<0.01), and [in a study of 37 patients](https://europepmc.org/article/med/8455741), pain scores dropped from 5.3 to 0.9 over 3.4 months [Another RCT](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/12670672/) of 146 patients also found four months of DMSO was an effective treatment (approximately 80% improved with a mean 9.05 improvement on impairment score), with the greatest benefit found in warm CRPS**.** In a study of 74 CRPS 1 patients treated with a combination of therapies including topical DMSO, a mean 35% pain reduction was achieved after one year.<sup data-ref="204">204</sup>
content.cn: 在最早的对照研究中，就镇痛、关节活动度及整体临床改善而言，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在效果上显著优于安慰剂和区域交感神经阻滞（使用静脉注射伊斯梅林），其中一项交叉研究（可能未意识到DMSO的神经系统效应）得出结论：DMSO的疗效“表明反射性交感神经萎缩症（RSD）主要涉及炎症过程，而非交感神经反射”。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> <sup>5</sup> 在一项涉及31名患者的随机对照试验（RCT）中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）软膏在两个月内将RSD评分中位数从5降至0（而安慰剂组从4降至2，p<0.01）， 而在一项涉及37名患者的研究中，疼痛评分在3.4个月内从5.3降至0.9。另一项涉及146名患者的RCT也发现，为期四个月的二甲基亚砜治疗是有效的（约80%的患者症状改善，功能障碍评分平均改善9.05分），其中温暖型CRPS患者的获益最为显著。 在一项针对74名CRPS 1型患者的研究中，采用包括局部DMSO在内的联合疗法，一年后疼痛平均减轻了35%。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: A 145 person study compared DMSO to oral N-acetylcysteine for CRPS 1. Both treatments were effective, but DMSO was superior overall (especially in warm CRPS) and more cost-effective from a societal perspective (€2,852 vs €3,934 and better clinical outcomes).<sup data-ref="205">205</sup>, <sup data-ref="206">206</sup>, <sup data-ref="207">207</sup>, <sup data-ref="208">208</sup> A 2012 study of 29 patients with CRPS 1 of less than one year’s duration similarly found DMSO reduced pain by 3.09 VAS points over a year, with 89.7% showing quality-of-life improvements and moderate restoration of limb function, with 12 patients who did not receive DMSO showing worse improvements.<sup data-ref="209">209</sup>, <sup data-ref="210">210</sup> DMSO has also been incorporated into compound analgesic creams for CRPS, where [69% of patients](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/26547813/) reported pain reduction, with two achieving complete resolution (along with [a case report](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3199095/) where severe intractable CRPS 1 responded to a compound cream). Ukrainian clinicians have also reported success with overnight compresses DMSO solution mixed with dexamethasone for localized CRPS,<sup data-ref="211">211</sup> and [in one study](https://rsds.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/Ambroxol-Cream-CRPS.pdf), DMSO with ambroxol was found to be a highly effective CRPS treatment.
content.cn: 一项涉及145名患者的研究对比了二甲基亚砜（DMSO）与口服N-乙酰半胱氨酸治疗CRPS 1型的情况。两种治疗均有效，但DMSO总体效果更佳（尤其在热型CRPS中），且从社会角度看更具成本效益（2,852欧元 vs 3,934欧元，且临床疗效更佳）。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> 2012年一项针对29名病程不足一年的CRPS 1型患者的研究也发现，DMSO在一年内可使疼痛减轻3.09个VAS评分点，其中89.7%的患者生活质量生活质量的改善以及肢体功能的中度恢复，而未接受二甲基亚砜治疗的12名患者改善情况较差。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 二甲基亚砜还被纳入了用于治疗CRPS的复合镇痛软膏中，其中69%的患者报告疼痛减轻，有两名患者实现了完全缓解（另有病例报告显示，一例严重的顽固性CRPS 1型对复合软膏产生了反应）。 乌克兰临床医生还报告称，对于局限性CRPS，使用二甲基亚砜溶液与地塞米松混合制成的敷料进行过夜敷贴取得了成功， <sup>1</sup> 且在一项研究中，发现二甲基亚砜与氨溴索的组合是治疗CRPS的高效方案。

content.en:
Multiple systematic reviews and German, Dutch, and Russian clinical guidelines recommend topical 50% DMSO cream for the acute inflammatory phase of CRPS (particularly for CRPS 1),<sup data-ref="212">212</sup>, <sup data-ref="213">213</sup>, <sup data-ref="214">214</sup>, <sup data-ref="215">215</sup>, <sup data-ref="216">216</sup>, <sup data-ref="217">217</sup>, <sup data-ref="218">218</sup>, <sup data-ref="219">219</sup>, <sup data-ref="220">220</sup>, <sup data-ref="221">221</sup>, <sup data-ref="222">222</sup>, <sup data-ref="223">223</sup>, <sup data-ref="224">224</sup>, <sup data-ref="225">225</sup>, <sup data-ref="226">226</sup> with a standardized compounding formulation published in the Formularium Der Nederlandse Apothekers.<sup data-ref="227">227</sup> DMSO has also been recommended or utilized for CRPS across numerous other clinical and rehabilitation contexts.<sup data-ref="228">228</sup>, <sup data-ref="229">229</sup>, <sup data-ref="230">230</sup>, <sup data-ref="231">231</sup>, <sup data-ref="232">232</sup>, <sup data-ref="233">233</sup>, <sup data-ref="234">234</sup>, <sup data-ref="235">235</sup>, <sup data-ref="236">236</sup>, <sup data-ref="237">237</sup>, <sup data-ref="238">238</sup>  
多项系统性综述以及德国、荷兰和俄罗斯的临床指南均建议在CRPS的急性炎症期（特别是CRPS 1型）使用50%二甲基亚砜（DMSO）外用乳膏， <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> <sup>5</sup> <sup>6</sup> <sup>7</sup> <sup>8</sup> <sup>9</sup> <sup>10</sup> <sup>11</sup> <sup>12</sup> <sup>13</sup> <sup>14</sup> <sup>15</sup> ，其标准化复方配方已刊载于《荷兰药师处方集》（Formularium Der Nederlandse Apothekers）。 <sup>1</sup> 在许多其他临床和康复场景中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）也被推荐或用于治疗复杂性区域疼痛综合征（CRPS）。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> <sup>5</sup> <sup>6</sup> <sup>7</sup> <sup>8</sup> <sup>9</sup> <sup>10</sup> <sup>11</sup>
content.cn: 读者的反馈印证了临床数据。其中最详尽的CRPS病例报告来自一位读者，该读者患有CRPS已有数十年，同时还患有重症肌无力及强直性脊柱炎。该读者表示，自2021至2022年开始使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）以来，再未出现过严重的CRPS发作：“当我感觉到病情复发时，我知道该用什么来阻止它。” <sup data-ref="228">228</sup>

content.en: Reader reports corroborate the clinical data. The most detailed CRPS report came from a reader with a multi-decade history of the condition alongside myasthenia gravis and ankylosing spondylosis, who reported that since starting DMSO in 2021–2022, they have not had a major CRPS episode: “When I can sense it returning I know what stops it.” <sup data-ref="239">239</sup>

Other readers have also reported significant improvements <sup data-ref="240">240</sup>, <sup data-ref="241">241</sup>, <sup data-ref="242">242</sup>, <sup data-ref="243">243</sup>, <sup data-ref="244">244</sup>, <sup data-ref="245">245</sup>, <sup data-ref="239">239</sup> (e.g, “pain was gone.” <sup data-ref="245">245</sup>), including one reader who used topical DMSO daily for 18 years for CRPS, calling it “a freaking Miracle,” <sup data-ref="240">240</sup> another CRPS in the arm and hand following a wrist fracture who’s been in remission for approximately nine years due to her veterinarian father introducing her to DMSO,<sup data-ref="241">241</sup> and a reader with MS, fibromyalgia, liver fibrosis, CRPS, and lymphedema described oral and topical DMSO as “a godsend” (after about a year of use).<sup data-ref="243">243</sup>
content.cn: 其他读者也报告了显著的改善 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> <sup>5</sup> <sup>6</sup> <sup>7</sup> （例如，“疼痛消失了。” <sup>1</sup> ），其中一位读者因患有复杂性区域疼痛综合征（CRPS），每天外用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）长达18年，称其为“简直是个奇迹”， <sup>1</sup> 还有一位因腕部骨折导致手臂和手部出现CRPS的读者，由于她的兽医父亲向她介绍了二甲基亚砜（DMSO），病情已缓解约九年； <sup>1</sup> 以及一位患有多发性硬化症、纤维肌痛、肝纤维化、CRPS和淋巴水肿的读者，将口服和外用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）描述为“天赐之物”（使用约一年后）。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: *Note: [in rats with CRPS 1](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2017&filename=SYYZ201711012&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=SZ3dWkMf95MvyTEbpqy_GVa4j6zWPO48Yox83cu4bUcKs9F5DiK0DVfmJAeEdTxk), resveratrol <sup>⬖</sup> and ISO-1 (in DMSO) significantly improved pain thresholds and reduced inflammatory mediators and ERK1/2 signaling in the sciatic nerve, with similar results in a post-fracture CRPS model.<sup data-ref="246">246</sup> An NLRP3 inhibitor in DMSO also attenuated CRPS allodynia in rats.<sup data-ref="247">247</sup> In clinical practice, DMSO has also been combined with novocaine,<sup data-ref="230">230</sup>, <sup data-ref="236">236</sup>* *heparin, (as Dolobene gel),<sup data-ref="232">232</sup>, <sup data-ref="233">233</sup>* NSAIDs <sup data-ref="232">232</sup> *and the dexamethasone and compound cream formulations described above for CRPS.*
content.cn: 注：在患有CRPS 1型的大鼠模型中，白藜芦醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 和ISO-1（溶于DMSO）显著提高了疼痛阈值，并降低了坐骨神经中的炎症介质和ERK1/2信号传导水平；在骨折后CRPS模型中也获得了类似结果。 <sup>1</sup> 溶于DMSO的NLRP3抑制剂同样减轻了大鼠CRPS的异痛症。 <sup>1</sup> 在临床实践中，二甲基亚砜还曾与诺卡因、 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 肝素（如多洛贝恩凝胶）、 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 非甾体抗炎药（NSAIDs） <sup>1</sup> 以及上文所述用于治疗CRPS的地塞米松和复合软膏制剂联合使用。

content.en: Facial Nerve Palsy
content.cn: 面神经麻痹

content.en:
Facial nerve paralysis (Bell’s palsy) causes sudden weakness or paralysis of one side of the face, typically from inflammation and swelling of the facial nerve within the narrow Fallopian canal of the skull. While most cases resolve spontaneously, a significant minority develop permanent facial asymmetry, that fortunately, DMSO has been shown to improve.
*Note: DMSO also has direct effects on peripheral nerve-mediated vascular responses, as [topical DMSO produces facial flushing](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/8477599/) consistent with activation of vasodilatory nerve reflexes.
content.cn:
面神经麻痹（贝尔氏麻痹）会导致面部一侧突然出现无力或麻痹，通常是由颅骨内狭窄的法洛普管中面神经发生炎症和肿胀所致。虽然大多数病例可自愈，但仍有相当一部分患者会出现永久性面部不对称，所幸研究表明二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可改善这一状况。
注：二甲基亚砜（DMSO）还对周围神经介导的血管反应具有直接影响，因为局部使用DMSO会引起面部潮红，这与血管舒张性神经反射的激活相一致。*

content.en: The most substantive evidence comes from a controlled study of 65 patients with Bell’s palsy, where compresses of DMSO mixed with nicotinic acid and saline were applied to the parotid region of the affected side for 10-12 sessions. Compared to conventional treatment controls, the DMSO protocol produced a statistically significant increase in the cure rate and a significant decrease in therapy duration.<sup data-ref="248">248</sup>, <sup data-ref="249">249</sup>, <sup data-ref="250">250</sup>
content.cn: 最具说服力的证据来自一项针对65例贝尔氏麻痹患者的对照研究，该研究中，研究人员将二甲基亚砜（DMSO）与烟酸及生理盐水混合制成的敷料，敷于患侧腮腺区域，共进行10至12次治疗。与接受常规治疗的对照组相比，采用DMSO治疗方案的组别治愈率出现了具有统计学意义的提高，且治疗周期显著缩短。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup>

content.en: DMSO has also been used to restore mimic muscle function after peripheral facial nerve lesions by dissolving therapeutic drugs (ATP, lidase, novocaine for paretic muscles; vitamin E <sup>⬖</sup> for spastic muscles) and introducing them into acupuncture points of the injured facial neuromuscular structures. Pretreatment involved 1-3 applications of topical DMSO followed by drug injection in DMSO solution with low-frequency electrical stimulation. [In one documented case](https://elibrary.ru/item.asp?id=38133167), a patient with post-cold right facial nerve paresis achieved full recovery of muscle function without residual contractures or synkinesis (involuntary movements when a different facial muscle is used due to miswiring during the nerve’s regeneration) after 10 sessions.
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）还被用于恢复外周面神经损伤后的表情肌功能，具体方法是将其用于溶解治疗药物（针对瘫痪肌肉的ATP、利达酶、诺卡因；针对痉挛肌肉的维生素E <sup>⬖</sup> ），并将这些药物注入受损面神经肌肉结构的穴位。预处理包括1-3次局部涂抹DMSO，随后在低频电刺激下注射DMSO溶液中的药物。 在一份有记录的病例中，一名因感冒导致右侧面神经麻痹的患者，经过10次治疗后，肌肉功能完全恢复，且未出现残留挛缩或协同运动（即由于神经再生过程中神经连接异常，导致使用其他面部肌肉时出现的不自主运动）。

content.en: Several clinical guidelines and reviews recommend topical DMSO application to the facial nerve exit area during the acute period of facial neuropathy for its anti-edema, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory effects, positioned alongside corticosteroids, diuretics, NSAIDs, and vascular agents in the standard management algorithm.<sup data-ref="251">251</sup>, <sup data-ref="252">252</sup>, <sup data-ref="253">253</sup> [DMSO-containing baths and compresses](https://dental-almanac.org/index.php/journal/article/view/113) are also listed as standard therapy for facial nerve neuropathies in Russian clinical practice (e.g., [in a cohort of patients with facial nerve paralysis](https://cyberleninka.ru/article/n/zastosuvannya-elementiv-litoterapiyi-v-kompleksnomu-likuvanni-patsientiv-z-nevropatiyami-litsevogo-nerva), DMSO applied at night was used as part of a multimodal protocol that successfully treated 60% of cases).
content.cn: 多项临床指南和综述建议，在面神经病变的急性期，因二甲基亚砜（DMSO）具有抗水肿、抗炎和血管扩张作用，可将其外用涂抹于面神经出口区域，并与皮质类固醇、利尿剂、非甾体抗炎药（NSAIDs）及血管活性药物一同纳入标准治疗方案。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> 在俄罗斯的临床实践中，含二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的浴疗和敷贴也被列为面神经病变的标准治疗方法（例如，在一项面神经麻痹患者队列研究中，夜间使用DMSO作为多模式治疗方案的一部分，成功治愈了60%的病例）。

content.en: Additional applications include DMSO in postoperative dressings following composite flap surgery to correct lagophthalmos (inability to close eyelids from facial nerve paralysis), supporting anti-inflammatory care in six patients who achieved full eyelid closure.<sup data-ref="254">254</sup> DMSO has also been used in iontophoretic delivery protocols for facial neuritis, where drug-impregnated wipes placed in the ear cavity and nasal passage achieved marked improvement in 93% of 154 patients with various conditions including facial neuritis.<sup data-ref="255">255</sup> In patients with radiation fibrosis and secondary neuritis, DMSO was incorporated into acupuncture reflexotherapy rehabilitation protocols.<sup data-ref="256">256</sup>
content.cn: 其他应用包括：在通过复合皮瓣手术矫正眼睑闭合不全（因面神经麻痹导致无法闭合眼睑）后的术后敷料中使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO），该疗法辅助抗炎治疗，使6名患者实现了完全闭合眼睑。 <sup>1</sup> 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）还被用于面神经炎的电离子导入治疗方案中，将浸有药物的湿巾置于耳道和鼻腔内，在154名患有包括面神经炎在内的各种疾病的患者中，93%的患者症状显著改善。 <sup>1</sup> 对于患有放射性纤维化和继发性神经炎的患者，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）被纳入针灸反射疗法康复方案中。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: A reader diagnosed with Ramsay Hunt syndrome (rare facial paralysis from shingles) started using DMSO and “within a week I started to see movement in my face again,” with continued improvement in taste, hearing, vision, and facial mobility.<sup data-ref="257">257</sup> Another applied DMSO gel to the skin over the skull near the ear of a friend with Bell’s palsy: “He says now that it burned for a little while, then the pain subsided a lot.” <sup data-ref="258">258</sup>
content.cn: 一位被诊断为拉姆齐-亨特综合征（由带状疱疹引起的罕见面瘫）的读者开始使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO），结果“一周内，我的面部就开始恢复活动了”，随后味觉、听力、视力和面部活动能力持续改善。 <sup>1</sup> 还有一位读者将二甲基亚砜凝胶涂抹在患有贝尔氏麻痹的朋友耳旁颅骨处的皮肤上：“他说当时感觉灼烧了一会儿，随后疼痛就减轻了很多。” <sup>1</sup>

content.en: *Note: in the early vaccine literature, the nerve paralyses they caused were attributed to inflammatory edema compressing the tight pathways those nerves traveled through.<sup data-ref="259">259</sup> As the facial nerve examples show, DMSO’s fluid draining properties makes it well suited for these impingements, further corroborated by Russian and Ukrainian guidelines for radiculitis and sciatica treatment using spinal DMSO and procaine compresses as a standard protocol for reducing edema and inflammation around affected nerve roots <sup data-ref="260">260</sup>, <sup data-ref="261">261</sup>, <sup data-ref="262">262</sup>, <sup data-ref="263">263</sup>
content.cn: 注：在早期的疫苗文献中，疫苗引起的神经麻痹被归因于炎症性水肿压迫了神经所经过的狭窄通路。 <sup>1</sup> 正如面神经的例子所示， 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的利尿特性使其非常适合用于治疗此类神经受压情况，这一点还得到了俄罗斯和乌克兰关于神经根炎及坐骨神经痛治疗指南的进一步印证——这些指南将脊柱二甲基亚砜和普鲁卡因敷料作为标准方案，用于减轻受累神经根周围的水肿和炎症 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup>*

content.en: Additionally:此外：

•DMSO mixed with novocaine is applied topically to treat post-mastectomy scalenus syndrome, a neurovascular compression that contributes to plexitis and neuropathy,<sup data-ref="264">264</sup> and DMSO dissolved with B vitamins (1% thiamine chloride and 1% pyridoxine hydrochloride) has been applied to skin as part of reflexotherapy protocols for traumatic mononeuropathies and plexopathies, with positive EMG-confirmed recovery in all treated patients.<sup data-ref="265">265</sup>, <sup data-ref="266">266</sup>
content.cn: •将二甲基亚砜（DMSO）与诺卡因混合后局部涂抹，用于治疗乳腺切除术后斜角肌综合征——这是一种导致神经丛炎和神经病变的神经血管压迫性病变； <sup>1</sup> 此外，将二甲基亚砜与B族维生素（1%氯化硫胺素和1%盐酸吡哆醇）混合后外敷于皮肤，作为创伤性单神经病变和神经丛病变反射疗法方案的一部分，所有接受治疗的患者均通过肌电图（EMG）确认恢复良好。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup>

content.en: •Melkerson-Rosenthal syndrome, a chronic condition characterized by macrocheilitis (swollen lips), folded tongue, and usually unilateral facial nerve paralysis resulting from impaired microcirculation of blood and lymph, has also been treated with topical DMSO-heparin ointments and heparin iontophoresis.<sup data-ref="267">267</sup>
content.cn: •梅尔克森-罗森塔尔综合征是一种慢性疾病，其特征为巨唇炎（嘴唇肿胀）、舌褶以及通常伴有单侧面神经麻痹，这些症状均由血液和淋巴微循环障碍引起。该病也可采用局部涂抹二甲基亚砜-肝素软膏及肝素电渗疗法进行治疗。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: •In horses, IV DMSO contributed to recovery from fourth branchial arch defects causing laryngeal paralysis, with a progressive decrease in laryngeal inflammation observed by endoscopy after intranasal DMSO-dexamethasone-nitrofurazone treatment for 5 days post-surgery.<sup data-ref="268">268</sup> Non-surgical treatment of laryngeal hemiplegia induced by perivascular or perineural injection has also included topical DMSO.<sup data-ref="269">269</sup> A detailed equine lameness protocol used aquapuncture injections of vitamin B12 <sup>⬖</sup> mixed with Sarapin <sup>⬖</sup> and DMSO for treating lameness through combined acupuncture and DMSO-enhanced drug delivery.<sup data-ref="270">270</sup> *Note: DMSO has been used extensively for decades in horses to treat severe neurological issues (detailed [here](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-heals-the-spine-and-reverses)).*
content.cn: •在马匹中，静脉注射二甲基亚砜（DMSO）有助于因第四鳃弓畸形导致的喉瘫痪恢复；术后经鼻腔给药二甲基亚砜-地塞米松-硝基呋喃酮治疗5天后，内镜检查显示喉部炎症呈进行性减轻。 <sup>1</sup> 针对由血管周围或神经周围注射引起的喉半侧麻痹，非手术治疗方案中也包括局部应用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）。 <sup>1</sup> 一项详细的马匹跛行治疗方案采用水针疗法，将维生素B12 <sup>⬖</sup> 与萨拉平 <sup>⬖</sup> 和二甲基亚砜（DMSO）混合注射，通过针灸与DMSO增强药物输送相结合的方式治疗跛行。 <sup>1</sup> 注：数十年来，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在马匹治疗严重神经系统疾病方面已被广泛应用（详情见此处）。

content.en: Trigeminal Neuralgia
content.cn: 三叉神经痛

content.en: Trigeminal neuralgia (TN), one of the most severe pain conditions known, is characterized by sudden, intense, shock-like facial pain along one or more branches of the trigeminal nerve. Standard treatments (carbamazepine, surgical decompression) are often only partially effective, and the condition frequently stops responding to treatment. However:
content.cn: 三叉神经痛（TN）是已知最严重的疼痛疾病之一，其特征是在三叉神经的一条或多条分支沿线出现突然、剧烈、类似电击的面部疼痛。标准治疗方法（卡马西平、手术减压）往往仅能部分奏效，且该病症常会出现对治疗不再响应的情况。然而：

content.en: • [Stanley Jacob reported](https://headachejournal.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1111/j.1526-4610.1965.hed0503078.x) on 59 patients with headaches from a variety of causes, of whom 26 out of 35 patients with TN of more than a year’s duration (many with numerous failed treatments) improved with topical DMSO, with 13 achieving a full recovery. In another early report, DMSO showed promise for TN alongside other headache types, with improvement noted in patients where topical DMSO was applied to the affected area or instilled intranasally.<sup data-ref="271">271</sup>,<sup data-ref="272">272</sup>
content.cn: • 斯坦利·雅各布（Stanley Jacob）报告了59例因各种原因导致头痛的患者，其中35例三叉神经痛（TN）病程超过一年的患者（其中许多人曾多次治疗未果）中有26例在局部使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）后症状有所改善，其中13例完全康复。 在另一份早期报告中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在三叉神经痛及其他类型头痛的治疗中均显示出良好前景，将二甲基亚砜外用涂抹于患处或经鼻腔滴入的患者均观察到症状改善。 <sup>1</sup>, <sup>2</sup>

content.en: •A Russian patent reported “simple, effective, and free of side effects” treatment for TN: applications of napkins moistened with a solution of DMSO and 2% novocaine or lidocaine applied to the facial skin over the affected trigeminal nerve branch exits, 2--3 times daily for 20-30 minutes over 10-15 days.<sup data-ref="273">273</sup> DMSO has also been recommended as part of conservative therapy for trigeminal neuralgia exacerbations via local applications, often in combination with antihomotoxic (homeopathic) preparations.<sup data-ref="274">274</sup>
content.cn: •一项俄罗斯专利报道了一种“简单、有效且无副作用”的三叉神经痛（TN）治疗方法：将浸有二甲基亚砜（DMSO）和2%诺卡因或利多卡因溶液的纸巾敷于三叉神经分支出口处的面部皮肤上，每天2至3次，每次20至30分钟，持续10至15天。 <sup>1</sup> 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）也被推荐作为三叉神经痛发作期保守治疗的一部分，通过局部敷用，通常与抗同毒性（顺势疗法）制剂联合使用。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: • [In patients with multiple sclerosis](https://cyberleninka.ru/article/n/nevralgiya-troynichnogo-nerva-u-bolnyh-rasseyannym-sklerozom) (experiencing TN, a recognized MS complication), topical DMSO mixed with anesthetics applied to trigger zones enabled reduction of carbamazepine to minimum doses or complete discontinuation and achievement of full remission during TN exacerbations.
content.cn: • 对于多发性硬化症患者（出现三叉神经痛，这是多发性硬化症的一种已知并发症），将二甲基亚砜（DMSO）与麻醉剂混合后局部涂抹于触发区，可在三叉神经痛发作期间将卡马西平的剂量减至最低或完全停药，并实现完全缓解。

content.en: •For orofacial pain syndromes involving masticatory muscle spasm, compresses of DMSO mixed with 2% lidocaine were applied to reduce muscle tone and alleviate pain as part of comprehensive management.<sup data-ref="275">275</sup>
content.cn: •对于伴有咀嚼肌痉挛的颌面部疼痛综合征，作为综合治疗的一部分，可使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）与2%利多卡因混合制成的敷料，以降低肌肉张力并缓解疼痛。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: •DMSO has also been incorporated into iontophoretic delivery systems for TN and facial neuritis, where electrode-wrapped sodium alginate wipes loaded with DMSO (among other agents) produced marked improvement in 93% of 154 patients.<sup data-ref="255">255</sup>
content.cn: •DMSO还被应用于三叉神经痛和面神经炎的电离子导入给药系统中，其中，包裹电极并载有DMSO（及其他药物）的海藻酸钠湿巾，使154名患者中的93%症状显著改善。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: *Note: [in one small series of three patients](https://europepmc.org/article/med/5232273), multiple daily applications of DMSO failed to provide any relief, though the same physician personally observed a dramatic response in a different patient treated by Stanley Jacob (suggesting TN treatment requires the correct DMSO protocol).
content.cn: 注：在一项仅涉及3名患者的小型研究中，每日多次使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）未能缓解症状，尽管同一位医生曾亲眼目睹另一名由斯坦利·雅各布（Stanley Jacob）治疗的患者出现了显著改善（这表明三叉神经痛的治疗需要采用正确的二甲基亚砜治疗方案）。*

content.en: Reader reports of trigeminal neuralgia responding to DMSO were among the most dramatic I received. One reader’s mother had been in “almost constant pain for years” with TN so severe she could not speak clearly, sing, or eat many foods. After starting daily DMSO on the back of the neck, “the pain was gone by the evening. That was three weeks ago and she has not had a flareup since.” <sup data-ref="276">276</sup> A reader’s wife with MS-related secondary trigeminal neuralgia (painful for over a year and a half) tested DMSO cream on a small spot on her face: “her pain dropped 90%. The next morning she put it all over the trigeminal area, and the pain is 99.9% gone. Even after three days without reapplication, the pain hasn’t come back.” <sup data-ref="277">277</sup> Another reader used DMSO on a TN flare and reported “80% resolved...I can manage the rest!” <sup data-ref="278">278</sup>
content.cn: 读者反馈的三叉神经痛对二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的反应，是我收到的最令人震撼的案例之一。一位读者的母亲因三叉神经痛“多年来几乎一直处于疼痛状态”，病情严重到无法清晰说话、唱歌，也无法进食许多食物。在开始每天将二甲基亚砜涂抹于颈后部后，“到了晚上疼痛就消失了。那是三周前的事，此后她再也没有出现过复发。” <sup>1</sup> 另一位读者的妻子患有与多发性硬化症相关的继发性三叉神经痛（疼痛持续了一年半以上），她在脸部一小块区域试用了二甲基亚砜（DMSO）乳膏：“疼痛减轻了90%。第二天早上，她将乳膏涂抹在整个三叉神经区域，疼痛消退了99.9%。 即使停用三天未重新涂抹，疼痛也没有复发。” <sup>1</sup> 另一位读者在三叉神经痛发作时使用了二甲基亚砜，并报告称“疼痛缓解了80%……剩下的我能自己应付！” <sup>1</sup>

content.en: Other readers also reported TN relief,<sup data-ref="279">279</sup>, <sup data-ref="280">280</sup> including one who had tried DMSO for tinnitus and then discovered it also treated their recently diagnosed cervical spondylitis, with TN-like symptoms resolving in 3–5 days.<sup data-ref="281">281</sup> One reader with vascular EDS and 18 years of TN and facial neuropathy reported success using DMSO on the face near the ear.<sup data-ref="282">282</sup>
content.cn: 其他读者也报告了三叉神经痛症状的缓解， <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 其中一位读者原本是为治疗耳鸣而尝试使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO），随后发现它还能治疗其新近确诊的颈椎病，类似三叉神经痛的症状在3至5天内便消失了。 <sup>1</sup> 一位患有血管型埃勒斯-丹洛斯综合征（EDS），且患有三叉神经痛和面神经病变长达18年的读者报告称，在耳部附近的脸部使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）取得了良好效果。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: *Note: a Russian literature review noted that treatment of trigeminal neuritis with DMSO is “long-term, from 1 to 6 months.” <sup data-ref="263">263</sup>
content.cn: 注：一篇俄罗斯文献综述指出，使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）治疗三叉神经炎的疗程“较长，为1至6个月”。 <sup>1</sup>*

content.en: Additionally, readers with occipital neuralgia have reported success with DMSO <sup data-ref="283">283</sup>, <sup data-ref="284">284</sup> (e.g., one who’d tried many treatments including nerve blocks experienced “amazing improvement” from DMSO).
content.cn: 此外，患有枕神经痛的读者报告称，使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO） <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 取得了良好效果（例如，一位曾尝试过包括神经阻滞在内的多种治疗方法的患者，在使用二甲基亚砜后获得了“惊人的改善”）。

content.en: One reader with superior oblique myokymia (a rare condition causing one eye’s visual field to jump, occasionally producing dangerous double vision while driving that often following TBIs that subsequently compress the nerve) found that 10% DMSO in distilled water used as an eye drop “does work to temporarily hit the off switch. It hasn’t cured it, but it’s reassuring to have an actual tool in the toolbox.” The condition had been deemed untreatable by the pre-eminent neuro-ophthalmologist in the country.<sup data-ref="285">285</sup>
content.cn: 一位患有上斜肌肌颤（一种罕见病症，会导致单侧视野跳动，有时在驾驶时会引发危险的重影，通常继发于颅脑损伤，随后导致神经受压）的读者发现，将10%的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）溶于蒸馏水制成眼药水，“确实能暂时‘关闭’这一症状。虽然这并未治愈该病，但工具箱里多了一件实用的工具，确实让人安心。” 该病症曾被国内顶尖的神经眼科专家认定为无法治疗。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: Combination Studies
content.cn: 联合研究

content.en:
A variety of agents dissolved in DMSO have shown benefit in TN models. [A JAK/STAT3 pathway inhibitor](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=r3g0b1Wd3tdPypdvV4ZLi-RuV6tbjrnYtCGwNX7aJmF3-dPsafku0qMI-KYPsUgMFoFSn8v8dXJ5aDgYqSMZcJ0lKMXffWcXxpxTW0tu_d8naW5iTB379lowSgf3EeYAdqpp3dif-XOj_jhmd1Nk8Z2o05c7ycW2m5brb0c27bIyb643P2RFT871fBUn4pZZ-hkJFN0eZZM=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) (AG490) increased mechanical sensitivity thresholds (decreasing pain) and reduced phosphorylated STAT3 and glial activation. [A protease-activated receptor 1 inhibitor](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=adNygMj_jVBuLscmTsXFTwMFqW7xvlkAIad0M4XtMqH0VG8Z_BfyJDuhaB5WLh7vYCUgXRzZOPIcKP7bw0_maDiqqrdqFuyX-DL-Lf4_sxUO2ngV9JPCzuB_ICXm6_RO8JU66WBG_5Ory5pwo0FFFVNBWCCYdp81maKUk3kFssmpXKGrHlUEJsiLDmcr0aHq87OXjpOAVSE=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) (SCH79797) modulated orofacial pain thresholds in a chronic compression model. [Intrathecal atypical antipsychotics](http://journals.lww.com/ejanaesthesiology/fulltext/2013/06001/effects_of_intrathecal_administration_of_atypical.670.aspx) (aripiprazole, quetiapine, olanzapine) produced dose-dependent reductions in mechanical allodynia in a trigeminal neuropathic pain model. [A P2X4R antagonist](https://pesquisa.bvsalud.org/portal/resource/pt/wpr-994152) relieved TN pain in rats via p38/BDNF inhibition. [Melatonin](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/00220345211026551) <sup>⬖</sup> reduced TMJ osteoarthritis chronic pain via MT2 receptors in trigeminal ganglion neurons.
*Note: TNF-a signaling ([which DMSO suppresses](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-treats-incurable-autoimmune)) has been shown to contribute to mechanical hypersensitivity in masseter muscle during temporomandibular joint inflammation (which is often linked to TN).<sup data-ref="286">286</sup>
content.cn:
多种溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的药物在三叉神经痛（TN）模型中显示出疗效。一种JAK/STAT3通路抑制剂（AG490）提高了机械敏感阈值（减轻疼痛），并降低了磷酸化STAT3水平及胶质细胞活化程度。一种蛋白酶激活受体1（PAR1）抑制剂（SCH79797）在慢性压迫模型中调节了口面部疼痛阈值。 在三叉神经病理性疼痛模型中，鞘内注射非典型抗精神病药物（阿立哌唑、奎硫平、奥氮平）可呈剂量依赖性地减轻机械性异痛症。 一种P2X4R拮抗剂通过抑制p38/BDNF途径缓解了大鼠的三叉神经痛。褪黑素 <sup>⬖</sup> 通过三叉神经节神经元中的MT2受体减轻了颞下颌关节骨关节炎的慢性疼痛。
注：已有研究表明，TNF-α信号传导（可被二甲基亚砜抑制）会导致颞下颌关节炎症期间（该炎症常与颞下颌关节紊乱相关）咀嚼肌出现机械性超敏反应。 <sup>1</sup>*

content.en: [A DMSO gel formulation](https://elibrary.ru/item.asp?id=37738078) (with sodium carmellose) was specifically developed and tested for conditions including TN, showing stable anti-inflammatory efficacy comparable to standard DMSO ointments (reducing kaolin-induced edema by approximately 63-74% at 5 hours) with superior convenience and no toxicity.
content.cn: 专门开发并测试了一种DMSO凝胶制剂（含卡梅洛斯钠），用于治疗包括三叉神经痛（TN）在内的多种病症。该制剂表现出稳定的抗炎疗效，可与标准DMSO软膏相媲美（在5小时内可减轻高岭土诱导的水肿约63%至74%），且使用更方便，且无毒性。

content.en: Post-Herpetic Neuralgia
content.cn: 带状疱疹后神经痛

content.en:
DMSO has consistently demonstrated significant efficacy against herpes simplex and herpes zoster (shingles) infections, with numerous studies (detailed [here](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-transforms-the-treatment-of)) and reader reports I’ve received showing DMSO consistently reduced pain and significantly accelerated disease resolution (which frequently was miraculous for readers).
*Note: for treatment of acute herpes, DMSO worked better in combination with idoxuridine (IDU, an antiviral which only worked if DMSO transported it through the skin). While this combination worked and was approved in Europe (e.g., as Herpid or Zostrum), acyclovir (which, while potentiated by DMSO did not require DMSO for delivery) was discovered not long after and displaced it—which is unfortunate, as while acyclovir is helpful, there are many herpes simplex and shingles cases that acyclovir alone does not sufficiently address.
content.cn:
二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在治疗单纯疱疹和带状疱疹感染方面始终表现出显著疗效，大量研究（详见此处）以及我收到的读者反馈均表明，DMSO能持续缓解疼痛并显著加速病情好转（这对读者而言往往堪称奇迹）。
注：在治疗急性疱疹时，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）与伊多苷（IDU，一种只有在DMSO将其通过皮肤输送时才起效的抗病毒药物）联合使用效果更佳。 虽然这种联合疗法有效且已在欧洲获批（例如以“Herpid”或“Zostrum”为商品名），但不久之后，阿昔洛韦（虽然其疗效可被二甲基亚砜增强，但无需二甲基亚砜作为载体）被发现并取代了它——这令人遗憾，因为尽管阿昔洛韦有效，但仍有许多单纯疱疹和带状疱疹病例仅靠阿昔洛韦无法得到充分治疗。*

content.en: In addition to treating herpes infections, DMSO also addresses the neurological complications they create (e.g., consider the previous Ramsay Hunt syndrome report where a reader successfully treated this challenging condition <sup data-ref="257">257</sup>). Likewise:
content.cn: 除了治疗疱疹感染外，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）还能缓解由此引发的神经系统并发症（例如，可参考此前关于拉姆齐-亨特综合征的报告，其中一位读者成功治愈了这一棘手的病症 <sup>1</sup> ）。同样地：

content.en: •Facial (trigeminal) herpes zoster—the form of shingles most likely to progress to postherpetic neuralgia if untreated—responded well to DMSO-IDU: pain duration was significantly shortened (median 13 days vs. 1–3 months in controls), pain persisting beyond 30 days in only 30% vs. 82%, with faster scab formation and less fever.<sup data-ref="287">287</sup>, <sup data-ref="288">288</sup>
content.cn: •面部（三叉神经）带状疱疹——这是若不经治疗最可能发展为带状疱疹后神经痛的带状疱疹类型——对二甲基亚砜（DMSO）经皮给药（IDU）疗法反应良好：疼痛持续时间显著缩短（中位数为13天，而对照组为1–3个月），疼痛持续超过30天的比例仅为30%，而对照组为82%；此外，结痂形成更快，发热情况也较少。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup>

content.en: •In a case series of [45 shingles patients](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-transforms-the-treatment-of), William Campbell Douglass reported that 79% had a “good” response and 14% had a fair response to DMSO. Of the 13 acute cases with concurrent neuralgia, 10 had a good response and 3 had a fair response.
content.cn: •在一项涉及45例带状疱疹患者的病例系列研究中，威廉·坎贝尔·道格拉斯报告称，79%的患者对二甲基亚砜（DMSO）治疗反应“良好”，14%的患者反应“一般”。在13例合并神经痛的急性病例中，10例反应良好，3例反应一般。

content.en: Post-herpetic neuralgia (PHN, persistent nerve pain after shingles resolves) is one of the most debilitating complications of shingles, disproportionately affecting patients over 60 and frequently does not respond to standard treatments. Fortunately, DMSO has shown consistent benefit for PHN across both prevention and treatment, with several clinicians finding it superior to other available options for chronic cases.
content.cn: 带状疱疹后神经痛（PHN，即带状疱疹痊愈后持续存在的神经痛）是带状疱疹最令人衰弱的并发症之一，该病在60岁以上患者中的发病率明显较高，且常对标准治疗无反应。幸运的是，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在PHN的预防和治疗方面均表现出持续的疗效，多位临床医生发现，对于慢性病例而言，其疗效优于其他现有治疗方案。

content.en: The most striking finding is that DMSO appears to largely prevent PHN when used during acute shingles. At [a 1980 Congressional Hearing](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-fdas-war-against-dmso-and-america), Dr. Scherbel of the Cleveland Clinic testified that with DMSO application during acute shingles, they never saw post-herpetic neuralgia follow.<sup data-ref="289">289</sup> This was corroborated by [a 1992 RCT](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/1560699/) of 171 patients showing topical 40% IDU (an antiviral) in DMSO was superior to acyclovir in preventing PHN development, and [a 1974 RCT](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/4600903/) of 118 patients finding the combination significantly improved post-herpetic neuralgia outcomes.<sup data-ref="290">290</sup>, <sup data-ref="291">291</sup>, <sup data-ref="292">292</sup> Earlier controlled studies similarly showed that both 5% and 40% IDU in DMSO dramatically reduced pain duration (patients were “delighted, for the pain disappeared within a median of two days”), with 40% IDU producing the strongest results.<sup data-ref="292">292</sup> Finally, a pooled analysis of controlled studies found that while acyclovir and corticosteroids showed no significant preventive effect on PHN, IDU in DMSO indicated possible benefit.<sup data-ref="293">293</sup>
content.cn: 最引人注目的发现是，在带状疱疹急性期使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）似乎能有效预防带状疱疹后神经痛（PHN）。在1980年的一次国会听证会上，克利夫兰诊所的舍贝尔博士作证称，在带状疱疹急性期使用DMSO后，他们从未观察到继发带状疱疹后神经痛的情况。 <sup>1</sup> 这一结论得到了1992年一项涉及171名患者的随机对照试验（RCT）的印证，该试验表明，在DMSO中配制的40% IDU（一种抗病毒药物）外用在预防PHN发生方面优于阿昔洛韦；此外，1974年一项涉及118名患者的随机对照试验也发现，该组合疗法显著改善了带状疱疹后神经痛的预后。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> 早期的对照研究同样表明，5%和40%浓度的IDU溶于DMSO均可显著缩短疼痛持续时间（患者“欣喜不已，因为疼痛在中位数为两天的时间内消失”），其中40%浓度的IDU效果最为显著。 <sup>1</sup> 最后，一项针对对照研究的荟萃分析发现，虽然阿昔洛韦和皮质类固醇对带状疱疹后神经痛（PHN）未显示出显著的预防效果，但二甲基亚砜（DMSO）中的IDU可能具有预防作用。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: *Note: Stanley Jacob noted that while [the FDA was stonewalling DMSO](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-fdas-war-against-dmso-and-america), DMSO plus IDU was an approved topical prescription in England and Ireland. Sadly, it is still not available in North America.
content.cn: 注：斯坦利·雅各布指出，尽管美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）对二甲基亚砜（DMSO）采取拖延态度，但在英格兰和爱尔兰，DMSO联合静脉注射用药物（IDU）已被批准作为外用处方药。遗憾的是，该药物在北美地区仍无法获得。*

content.en: For established PHN, DMSO also shows benefit. [In a large study of patients](https://nyaspubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/j.1749-6632.1967.tb34919.x) with various conditions being treated with DMSO, 6 of 9 PHN cases achieved complete remission within 2 months, with 2 achieving partial remission.<sup data-ref="294">294</sup> A German study reported positive results in 10 of 11 shingles and PHN cases,<sup data-ref="295">295</sup> and in Douglass’s case series of 22 PHN patients, 18 had a good response and 2 had a fair response.<sup data-ref="296">296</sup>, <sup data-ref="297">297</sup> One physician with extensive personal experience [noted](https://asma.kglmeridian.com/downloadpdf/view/journals/asem/53/1/article-p82.pdf) that “in post-herpetic neuralgia, particularly that which is chronic, pain relief is more striking with topical DMSO than with any other type of treatment,” and Stanley Jacob likewise reported successfully treating chronic PHN that had been present for over 2 years.<sup data-ref="298">298</sup>, <sup data-ref="299">299</sup> The Pain Center at Mount Sinai Medical Center (circa 1980) similarly used DMSO for PHN cases that had not responded to other therapies.<sup data-ref="300">300</sup>
content.cn: 对于确诊的带状疱疹后神经痛（PHN），二甲基亚砜（DMSO）也显示出疗效。在一项针对接受DMSO治疗的各类疾病患者的大型研究中，9例PHN病例中有6例在2个月内实现了完全缓解，另有2例实现了部分缓解。 <sup>1</sup> 一项德国研究报告称，11例带状疱疹和PHN病例中有10例取得了积极疗效， <sup>1</sup> 而在道格拉斯（Douglass）对22例PHN患者的病例系列研究中，18例反应良好，2例反应尚可。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 一位拥有丰富临床经验的医生指出：“对于带状疱疹后神经痛，尤其是慢性病例，局部使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的镇痛效果比任何其他治疗方式都更为显著”，斯坦利·雅各布同样报告了成功治疗病程超过2年的慢性带状疱疹后神经痛的案例。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 西奈山医疗中心疼痛中心（约1980年）也同样将二甲基亚砜用于对其他疗法无反应的带状疱疹后神经痛病例。 <sup>1</sup>

DMSO-based combinations have further improved herpetic neuralgia:  
以二甲基亚砜（DMSO）为基础的联合疗法进一步改善了带状疱疹神经痛：

content.en: •In 25 PHN patients, topical 40% DMSO with dyclonine and dexamethasone (applied 2-3 times daily, combined with oral B vitamins and mecobalamin) relieved pain within approximately 10 minutes, with significant improvement in 5 days and marked reduction after 2 weeks.<sup data-ref="301">301</sup>
content.cn: •在25例PHN患者中，外用含二氯尼定和地塞米松的40%二甲基亚砜溶液（每日涂抹2-3次，并配合口服B族维生素和甲钴胺），约10分钟内即可缓解疼痛，5天内症状显著改善，2周后疼痛明显减轻。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: •In 31 PHN patients, a (unspecified) topical Chinese herbal medicine combined with DMSO significantly reduced McGill pain scores and improved quality of life compared to 29 patients receiving standard Western medicine,<sup data-ref="302">302</sup> with 80 additional cases treated similarly.<sup data-ref="303">303</sup>
content.cn: •在31例PHN患者中，与接受标准西医治疗的29例患者相比，一种（未具体说明的）中草药外用制剂联合二甲基亚砜（DMSO）显著降低了麦吉尔疼痛评分并改善了生活质量， <sup>1</sup> 另有80例患者接受了类似治疗。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: •A complement-inhibiting formulation containing DMSO and glutaraldehyde produced rapid disappearance of acute herpetic neuralgia and accelerated remission of local symptoms, with the mechanism attributed to inhibition of local anaphylatoxin release.<sup data-ref="304">304</sup>
content.cn: •一种含有二甲基亚砜（DMSO）和戊二醛的补体抑制制剂，可迅速缓解急性带状疱疹神经痛，并加速局部症状的消退，其作用机制被认为在于抑制了局部过敏毒素的释放。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: •A severe case of trigeminal ganglionitis from herpes zoster (complicated by keratitis and cerebral vasculitis with hemiplegia) was treated with DMSO applications to scar areas as part of comprehensive therapy, contributing to pain management and reduced post-herpetic scar size at one year.<sup data-ref="305">305</sup>
content.cn: •一例由带状疱疹引起的三叉神经节炎重症病例（并发角膜炎和伴有偏瘫的脑血管炎），作为综合治疗的一部分，对瘢痕区域进行了二甲基亚砜（DMSO）局部涂抹治疗，这有助于缓解疼痛，并在一年后缩小了带状疱疹后瘢痕的大小。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: •One reader with three years of PHN reported DMSO and Frankincense, upon the first application, stopped all pain.<sup data-ref="306">306</sup>
content.cn: •一位拥有三年PHN病史的读者表示，首次使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）和乳香后，疼痛便完全消失了。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: Compression Neuropathies
content.cn: 压迫性神经病变

content.en: Compression neuropathies (tunnel syndromes) occur when peripheral nerves are compressed within anatomical tunnels, causing pain, numbness, weakness, and progressive nerve damage. The most common are carpal tunnel syndrome (median nerve at the wrist) and cubital tunnel syndrome (ulnar nerve at the elbow), but compression can affect nerves throughout the body including the sciatic nerve (piriformis syndrome) and upper extremity plexus (scalenus syndrome). Like the previously discussed nerve compressions, these also respond to DMSO:

content.en: • [In a 2008 study](https://elibrary.ru/item.asp?id=23416702) of patients with carpal and cubital tunnel syndromes in diabetes, topical applications of DMSO and 2% novocaine (gauze dressings applied for 40-60 minutes daily over 14 days) produced clinical improvement: 13.8% of affected hands showed significant improvement (primarily carpal tunnel), 69% showed slight improvement with reduced pain and paresthesia, and minor EMG improvements in distal latency were observed. Notably, unlike corticosteroid injections (the gold standard for non-diabetic patients), DMSO-novocaine applications had no impact on blood glucose levels, making them particularly suitable for diabetic patients.
