content.en: In experimental autoimmune neuritis (EAN, an animal model of Guillain-Barré syndrome), a prostaglandin E2-EP4 receptor antagonist (L-161982) dissolved in DMSO repeatedly delayed disease onset, reduced peak clinical scores, decreased inflammatory cell infiltration (IFN-γ, IL-17, TNF-α, IL-6), suppressed lymphocyte proliferation, and reduced chemokine expression (CXCL-12, MCP-1) in sciatic nerves, with immunization-phase treatment superior to onset-phase treatment.<sup data-ref="377">377</sup>, <sup data-ref="378">378</sup>, <sup data-ref="379">379</sup>, <sup data-ref="380">380</sup> Notably, in [a study of 11 patients](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/8957021/) with IgM monoclonal gammopathy-associated demyelinating polyneuropathy, the sole individual lacking detectable anti-myelin autoantibodies was the one previously treated with DMSO.
content.cn: 在实验性自身免疫性神经炎（EAN，一种吉兰-巴雷综合征的动物模型）中，溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的前列腺素E2-EP4受体拮抗剂（L-161982）多次推迟了疾病发作，降低了临床评分峰值，减少了坐骨神经中的炎性细胞浸润（IFN-γ、 IL-17、TNF-α、IL-6），抑制了淋巴细胞增殖，并降低了坐骨神经中趋化因子的表达（CXCL-12、MCP-1），其中免疫阶段的治疗效果优于发病阶段的治疗。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> 值得注意的是，在一项针对11例IgM单克隆γ球蛋白血症相关脱髓鞘性多发性神经病患者的研究中，唯一一名未检测到抗髓鞘自身抗体的患者正是此前接受过二甲基亚砜（DMSO）治疗的患者。

content.en: Additionally, DMSO has been repeatedly shown to address encephalitis and encephalomyelitis from a variety of causes including autoimmunity (detailed [here](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-heals-the-brain-and-transforms)), with one reader reporting it cured an incurable case,<sup data-ref="381">381</sup> while [one reader with Morvan’s syndrome](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/152884648), a rare and severe autoimmune channelopathy (that developed following viral encephalitis) reported that after two weeks of topical 70% DMSO cream, inflammation in his hands visibly decreased and pain was reduced by 75%. His case was particularly severe, having required multiple nerve decompression surgeries, four joint replacements, cervical fusion, and two nerve stimulator implants.
content.cn: 此外，已有多次研究表明，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可治疗由多种原因（包括自身免疫性疾病，详见此处）引起的脑炎和脑脊髓炎，其中一位读者报告称它治愈了一例被认为无法治愈的病例， <sup>1</sup> 另一位患有莫尔万综合征（一种罕见且严重的自身免疫性离子通道病，由病毒性脑炎引发）的读者则表示，在连续两周外用70%二甲基亚砜（DMSO）乳膏后，其手部炎症明显减轻，疼痛减轻了75%。他的病情尤为严重，此前曾接受过多次神经减压手术、四次关节置换术、颈椎融合术以及两次神经刺激器植入手术。

content.en: Myasthenia Gravis
content.cn: 重症肌无力

content.en: In order for skeletal muscles to fire, they need to receive acetylcholine from the nerve that directs them. In myasthenia gravis (MG) the body forms antibodies to the muscle’s acetylcholine receptors (AChRs), and as they are destroyed, the muscles need more and more acetylcholine to be sent by the nerves to activate. MG is hence managed by various immune-suppressing medications, filtering the AChR antibodies out of the blood, and acetylcholine esterase inhibitors (which boost acetylcholine levels)—suggesting DMSO’s anti-inflammatory and AChR-augmenting properties (via [acetylcholine esterase inhibition](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-is-a-miraculous-therapy-for)) may benefit the disease.
content.cn: 骨骼肌要收缩，就需要从控制它们的神经中接收乙酰胆碱。在重症肌无力（MG）中，人体会产生针对肌肉乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）的抗体，随着这些受体被破坏，肌肉需要神经传递越来越多的乙酰胆碱才能被激活。 因此，重症肌无力通常通过多种免疫抑制药物、从血液中过滤出AChR抗体以及乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制剂（可提高乙酰胆碱水平）来治疗——这表明二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的抗炎特性及其增强AChR功能的特性（通过抑制乙酰胆碱酯酶）可能对该疾病的治疗有益。

content.en: DMSO’s potential for MG [was initially discovered](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/7453805/) (accidentally) in 1980, when two researchers tested a variety of agents for their ability to reduce AChR antibodies, and realized that the DMSO being used as a vehicle for the various agents they were testing was independently reducing those antibodies. They then found that giving rats daily intraperitoneal injections of 1 mL DMSO for two weeks resulted in a 52% decrease in AChR antibodies (but not total IgG levels) that persisted for an additional six weeks after treatment was terminated.<sup data-ref="382">382</sup>, <sup data-ref="383">383</sup>
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在肌无力症（MG）治疗中的潜在作用最初于1980年（偶然）被发现。当时，两名研究人员在测试多种药物降低乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）抗体水平的能力时，发现作为这些测试药物载体的二甲基亚砜，本身也在独立地降低这些抗体水平。 随后他们发现，大鼠每日腹腔注射1毫升DMSO并持续两周后，乙酰胆碱受体抗体水平下降了52%（但总IgG水平未受影响），且该效果在停药后仍持续了六周。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup>

content.en: *Note: after this discovery, the researchers expressed their eagerness to test DMSO in humans with MG ([the New York Times even covered it](https://www.nytimes.com/1981/01/15/us/scientists-seek-to-test-controversial-solvent-on-disease-of-muscles.html)).
content.cn: 注：这一发现公布后，研究人员表示迫切希望对患有肌无力症（MG）的患者进行二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的人体试验（《纽约时报》甚至对此进行了报道）。*

content.en: [A follow-up rat study](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/3876185/) then found DMSO suppressed anti-AChR antibody levels by an average of 53%–76%, with the effect being similar regardless of whether DMSO was given orally, rectally, or intraperitoneally. Additionally, DMSO treatment suppressed the anti-AChR antibody response to a weak primary antigenic stimulus. Interestingly, when given during strong primary or secondary immune responses, DMSO instead enhanced antibody production 1.7–2.8-fold — indicating bidirectional immune modulation depending on timing and stimulus strength (or DMSO’s ability to potentiate allergens).
content.cn: 随后的一项大鼠研究发现，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可将抗乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）抗体水平平均抑制53%–76%，且无论采用口服、直肠给药还是腹腔注射给药，其抑制效果均相似。 此外，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）治疗还能抑制针对弱初级抗原刺激产生的抗AChR抗体反应。值得注意的是，当在强烈的初级或继发免疫应答期间给药时，DMSO反而会使抗体产生量增加1.7–2.8倍——这表明其免疫调节作用具有双向性，取决于给药时机和刺激强度（或DMSO增强过敏原活性的能力）。

content.en: These antibody findings were complemented by direct evidence that DMSO restores neuromuscular function. [In ex vivo](https://academic.oup.com/jpp/article-abstract/24/5/417/6200698?login=false) mouse nerve-muscle preparations where tubocurarine was used to mimic MG (reducing the strength of nerve-evoked muscle contractions), DMSO produced a rapid, dose-dependent, and sustained restoration of twitch force — with 0.1% restoring 20–30% of force and 0.75% achieving complete restoration that was sustained for over 150 minutes. Electrophysiology confirmed DMSO increased the amplitude of nerve signals at the muscle by ~25–30%, consistent with its acetylcholinesterase-inhibiting properties.
content.cn: 这些抗体研究结果得到了二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可恢复神经肌肉功能的直接证据的印证。 在利用管状库拉林模拟肌无力（降低神经诱发的肌肉收缩强度）的小鼠体外神经-肌肉制备模型中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可快速、剂量依赖性且持续地恢复肌肉颤动力量——0.1%浓度可恢复20–30%的力量，0.75%浓度则可实现完全恢复，且该恢复状态可持续超过150分钟。 电生理学研究证实，二甲基亚砜使肌肉处的神经信号振幅增加了约25–30%，这与其乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制特性相一致。

content.en: Additional studies in frog and mammalian nerve-muscle preparations confirmed that DMSO at concentrations ≤1% enhanced neuromuscular transmission through acetylcholinesterase inhibition, while concentrations above 1% began to have depressant effects in mammals, and that THC (but not CBD) counteracted this restoration of neuromuscular function.<sup data-ref="384">384</sup>, <sup data-ref="385">385</sup>, <sup data-ref="386">386</sup>10419-7/abstract), <sup data-ref="387">387</sup> DMSO has also been shown to reverse neuromuscular blockade caused by organophosphates (which poison the same acetylcholinesterase system that is therapeutically targeted in MG).<sup data-ref="388">388</sup>, <sup data-ref="389">389</sup>, <sup data-ref="390">390</sup>, <sup data-ref="391">391</sup>, <sup data-ref="392">392</sup>, <sup data-ref="393">393</sup>针对青蛙和哺乳动物神经-肌肉制备物的进一步研究证实，浓度≤1%的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可通过抑制乙酰胆碱酯酶来增强神经肌肉传导，而浓度超过1%时则开始对哺乳动物产生抑制作用；此外，四氢大麻酚（THC）（而非大麻二酚CBD）可抵消这种神经肌肉功能的恢复。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> 研究还表明，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能够逆转有机磷化合物引起的神经肌肉阻断（有机磷化合物会毒害乙酰胆碱酯酶系统，而该系统正是重症肌无力（MG）治疗的靶点）。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> <sup>5</sup> <sup>6</sup> ,

*Note: [this research inspired a 1982 study](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/0090122982901647) to determine if DMSO suppressed thyroid autoantibodies (which were experimentally induced in rats). It did, and also was found to increase the ratio of IgM to IgG plaque forming cells (which suggested a true immunoregulatory effect). In turn, some patients report that DMSO benefits autoimmune thyroiditis.
content.cn: 注：这项研究启发了一项1982年的研究，旨在确定二甲基亚砜（DMSO）是否能抑制甲状腺自身抗体（这些抗体是在大鼠身上通过实验诱导产生的）。研究结果表明，DMSO确实具有这种作用，并且还发现它能提高IgM与IgG斑块形成细胞的比例（这表明其具有真正的免疫调节作用）。因此，一些患者反映，DMSO对自身免疫性甲状腺炎有疗效。*

content.en: A variety of agents combined with DMSO have also shown benefit in experimental autoimmune MG models — including [resveratrol](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201501&filename=1015505513.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=niESZZtdnfQJix7RCRNDPc3QeEtwOjsD-eZRBzqexhicS6EHxSxVQhYul41-1Ope) <sup>⬖</sup> (which reduced anti-AChR antibodies and protected AChR density at the neuromuscular junction), [total glucosides of peony](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD202001&filename=1020017727.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=8aJLjug5upywrLTZWWsnQMmvgowRAmHDt12lV-uThFHN3I_aIjSGkrp2VdRewxqt) <sup>⬖</sup> and [artemisinin](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2016&filename=ZSMB201603002&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=dGIB7C0IJdp7odWkekWnwlL1AWAN4cusL04_kaWWG_kAYrlzoU4oGsa_sSgkohU6) <sup>⬖</sup> (both reduced clinical scores and anti-AChR antibodies while modulating regulatory T cells), atorvastatin-derived exosomes,<sup data-ref="394">394</sup>, <sup data-ref="395">395</sup>, <sup data-ref="396">396</sup> and [a caspase-1 inhibitor](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFDLAST2016&filename=1016164619.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=Ck0Kp9pDqxAT0I4lkKUTYtzquBWdxWgX5MzWQMjwK0_KKC8uKKkSEUYiwsiNH8Ns) (which suppressed disease progression via IL-1β/IL-17 pathways).
content.cn: 多种与二甲基亚砜（DMSO）联合使用的药物在实验性自身免疫性肌无力（MG）模型中也显示出疗效——包括白藜芦醇 <sup>⬖</sup> （可降低抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体水平并保护神经肌肉接头处的乙酰胆碱受体密度）、芍药总苷 <sup>⬖</sup> 和青蒿素 <sup>⬖</sup> （二者均能降低临床评分和抗AChR抗体水平，同时调节调节性T细胞），阿托伐他汀衍生的外泌体， <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> 以及一种半胱天冬酶-1抑制剂（该抑制剂通过IL-1β/IL-17通路抑制疾病进展）。

content.en: Separately, sepsis-induced disruption of acetylcholine receptor clustering on muscle cells was reversed by GSK3β inhibition, restoring the receptor aggregation needed for normal neuromuscular transmission.<sup data-ref="397">397</sup>, <sup data-ref="398">398</sup> In a rat sepsis model, [rapamycin](https://oversea.cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFDLAST2020&filename=1019659142.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=TM9sdtB4S_XSHfmiq6wArNzH2nckBzLH1NCOXgx7NcR4lSH3GPD1mCDwS0UZTe4f) similarly improved nerve conduction velocity, muscle action potential amplitude, and survival by restoring acetylcholine receptor homeostasis.
content.cn: 此外，脓毒症导致的肌肉细胞上乙酰胆碱受体聚集紊乱，可通过抑制GSK3β得到逆转，从而恢复正常神经肌肉传导所需的受体聚集。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 在大鼠脓毒症模型中，雷帕霉素同样通过恢复乙酰胆碱受体的稳态，改善了神经传导速度、肌肉动作电位振幅以及存活率。

content.en: Sadly, [while physicians have highlighted DMSO’s potential for human patients](https://asma.kglmeridian.com/downloadpdf/view/journals/asem/53/1/article-p82.pdf), no human studies have ever been performed for DMSO with MG. However, [one reader](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/80694307) with generalized MG reported that after starting oral and topical DMSO in 2022, her muscle fatigue, cognitive function, and vision dramatically improved, and she has not had a myasthenic crisis since. She noted that higher doses at night would wake her after an hour feeling alert and functional — which she attributed to DMSO boosting her acetylcholine levels — and described the effect as “better than the pyridostigmine I used to take 6x/day.” Another reader with generalized MG alongside multiple other autoimmune conditions reported no myasthenic crises since starting DMSO in 2022, along with dramatically reduced muscle fatigue, greatly improved cognition and near-normal vision — after having been on 30 prescription medications, she is now nearly off all of them <sup data-ref="399">399</sup>, <sup data-ref="400">400</sup> while a third reported “such amazing results” including “my swallowing and speaking goes back to normal” and “right side facial grimace reducing.” <sup data-ref="401">401</sup>, <sup data-ref="402">402</sup>
content.cn: 遗憾的是，尽管医生们已强调了二甲基亚砜（DMSO）对人类患者的潜在疗效，但迄今为止尚未针对肌无力症（MG）患者开展过任何涉及DMSO的人体研究。不过，一位患有全身性肌无力症的读者报告称，自2022年开始口服和外用DMSO后，她的肌肉疲劳、认知功能和视力均显著改善，且此后再未出现过肌无力危机。 她指出，晚上服用较高剂量后，一小时左右就会醒来，感觉神清气爽且行动自如——她认为这是因为二甲基亚砜提高了她的乙酰胆碱水平——并形容这种效果“比我以前每天服用6次的吡啶斯汀还要好”。另一位患有全身性肌无力症并伴有多种其他自身免疫性疾病的读者报告称，自2022年开始使用二甲基亚砜以来，不仅再未出现肌无力危象，肌肉疲劳也大幅减轻， 认知能力显著提升，视力接近正常——此前她曾服用30种处方药，如今已几乎停用所有药物 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> ；还有一位读者报告了“如此惊人的效果”，包括“吞咽和说话功能恢复正常”以及“右侧面部抽搐减轻” <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup>

content.en: Diabetic Neuropathy
content.cn: 糖尿病神经病变

content.en: Diabetic peripheral neuropathy is one of the most common (and challenging) complications of diabetes, affecting up to 50% of patients and causing progressive sensory loss, pain, and weakness that frequently leads to foot ulcers and amputations. Fortunately, DMSO’s therapeutic mechanisms are well suited to addressing it (without affecting blood sugar like conventional corticosteroid treatment <sup data-ref="403">403</sup>) and many readers have shared profound improvements for diabetic neuropathy.
content.cn: 糖尿病周围神经病变是糖尿病最常见（且最具挑战性）的并发症之一，影响高达50%的患者，并导致感觉逐渐丧失、疼痛和肌无力，这些症状常会引发足部溃疡甚至截肢。幸运的是，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的治疗机制非常适合应对这一病症（且不会像传统皮质类固醇治疗那样影响血糖水平 <sup>1</sup> ），许多读者也分享了糖尿病神经病变症状显著改善的案例。

content.en: As such, DMSO has been considered as a treatment for diabetic hand syndrome (which can include scleredema, sclerodactyly, and Dupuytren contractures involving both neuropathic and vascular components).<sup data-ref="404">404</sup> For example, in a clinical study of 250 diabetic patients (88 with tunnel neuropathies, often comorbid with diabetic polyneuropathy), DMSO applications with novocaine were recommended to improve blood flow and reduce edema, though the primary therapeutic focus in that study was Tiogamma <sup>⬖</sup> (intravenous alpha-lipoic acid), which showed superior overall efficacy.<sup data-ref="405">405</sup>, <sup data-ref="406">406</sup>
content.cn: 因此，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）一直被视为治疗糖尿病手综合征（可能包括硬皮水肿、指端硬化及杜普伊特伦挛缩，这些病变均涉及神经病变和血管病变）的一种方法。 <sup>1</sup> 例如，在一项针对250名糖尿病患者（其中88名患有隧道性神经病变，常伴有糖尿病多发性神经病变）的临床研究中，建议使用DMSO与诺卡因联合外用以改善血流并减轻水肿，尽管该研究的主要治疗重点是Tiogamma <sup>⬖</sup> （静脉注射α-硫辛酸），其总体疗效更佳。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup>

content.en: A substantial body of preclinical research has used DMSO to deliver agents targeting the specific pathways disrupted in diabetic neuropathy. Multiple studies in diabetic Schwann cell and mouse models found that HDAC inhibitors ([trichostatin A](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=Mz9udXFtQxmqqXBkT-_MSyIhScN6MZFD32j2nAmNCq86OpWmUhvVkgmZfd2CGdy6gErqtR5PmFFtBAjff1ICpxsOySbXLk62JO_EEAGT6d09Pv5l_RjBa52p_mm0G6rba-Dr5rf-zucelS_gHDqMpwF9s3y2R5OutP3qu5ZZ3Y1Hj6lIYFnUsCdMv5feEh8S&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup>) upregulated DCXR expression, increased nerve growth factor, and improved peripheral nerve function including mechanical and thermal thresholds, with the therapeutic mechanism operating through HDAC5/DCXR signaling. [High glucose was shown to upregulate DNMT1 expression](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=r3g0b1Wd3tfaAVNOhMrGWVIzErsGVATnvTv2xM6AmSLRswOfBfAX-6zVLUjDXhg4uPHdkRiZds4PKbZLdnWVr2_glICEdIVw4TH79nJNt1lepdd9nTXBznm_1Efln97PYkzqKo6MYT-48SM8FsluzCeks_01CLVUjK9bwJV-dB0St3iK9mA_zn6ra5cG9wGUhqa6GfoPFrI=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN), increase BDNF promoter methylation, and reduce BDNF in Schwann cells (with the DNMT inhibitor 5-Aza-2’-deoxycytidine reversing this suppression), while diabetic mice showed reduced sciatic nerve BDNF and myelin abnormalities. [NF-κB inhibition](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=r3g0b1Wd3tdBmBpICOdD0TmTgRe_WN2AZvnSaghoK5MAJyP31AckH-TwSSuAeQQrIRUrtIafThcSPp6RXemrQqdgl0mGxnglO6iB7A5gpheVpuH7oaXKSb_wFsG1YVaWNYlDZ8ijAfMa3CWU7XF3WQIfjrYI7k2bFv6JaRgVo09PKtTnts_ar6MA-SaEh20PNfGPlpMchBs=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) restored autophagy in high-glucose Schwann cells by increasing Rab5 expression. [Trichostatin A](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=r3g0b1Wd3tfmTgwhdvzZhoIMQyhrfSflh5W7OGWc1PRw6h5_2iav3K_uY0lvBUm2apIpT9_5wOiQ2_ddYod0Bu96Y4c7G9gyGNT6EGBrHFeecGGuE1Og1BiKZA69XxFWtbnZoE7M9EUH0j2Hn0-tLgD4hwF7_8m-xhmcxIEOIrzH9B_qQ1DizjvMy2HtfAET5EvZSaRRg6I=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> restored autophagy in high-glucose Schwann cells, increasing the LC3-II/LC3-I ratio by 1.6- to 1.74-fold.
content.cn: 大量临床前研究已利用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）递送针对糖尿病神经病变中受损特定通路的药物。多项针对糖尿病施万细胞和小鼠模型的研究发现，组蛋白去乙酰化酶（HDAC）抑制剂（三唑甲酸A <sup>⬖</sup> ）可上调DCXR表达，增加神经生长因子水平，并改善包括机械阈值和热阈值在内的周围神经功能，其治疗机制是通过HDAC5/DCXR信号通路发挥作用的。 研究表明，高血糖会上调施万细胞中DNMT1的表达，增加BDNF启动子的甲基化，并降低BDNF水平（DNMT抑制剂5-Aza-2’-脱氧胞苷可逆转这种抑制作用），而糖尿病小鼠则表现出坐骨神经BDNF水平降低及髓鞘异常。 NF-κB抑制通过增加Rab5的表达，恢复了高血糖施万细胞中的自噬。三氯乙酸 <sup>⬖</sup> 恢复了高血糖施万细胞中的自噬，使LC3-II/LC3-I比值增加了1.6至1.74倍。

content.en: [Exogenous BDNF](https://oversea.cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2019&filename=JNYY201904003&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=RV26SiqOHBLgZSxqqg9RCRKwSp1V3xHX0UB_wDiDnb5B8wdy04balvMiypWBOIZA) delivered intrathecally significantly elevated pain thresholds and inhibited hyperexcitability of dorsal root ganglion neurons in diabetic neuropathy rats (effects blocked by TrkB-Fc pretreatment). In chronic diabetic itch, [a P2Y12 antagonist](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=9r23aJBcv3YueRuMhustdepsvGMMqi8RrzFbxgpniLHEvbO-u7p2DMyPLyUP5E9Kib-78RqGTs7mzg-3FsCIwJxvVY1uGodOJQFIBnApEfpFxaTpugFxdMQ-89DA7CJ0r16ygySi9Uqk7xocJPNHSroxJGWCvBp0nq11MQ-QJ8YNtcM-VF-oUTTleKQMnWQo7haVSyAviJs=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) alleviated thermal and cold hyperalgesia and improved sciatic nerve conduction velocity.
content.cn: 通过蛛网膜下腔给药的外源性脑源性神经营养因子（BDNF）显著提高了糖尿病神经病变大鼠的痛阈，并抑制了背根神经节神经元的过度兴奋（该效应可被TrkB-Fc预处理所阻断）。在慢性糖尿病瘙痒模型中，P2Y12受体拮抗剂缓解了热痛和冷痛超敏反应，并改善了坐骨神经传导速度。

content.en: Additional agents showing neuroprotective effects in diabetic neuropathy models include [allopregnanolone](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/24176764/) (inhibited caspase-3, decreased the Bax/Bcl2 ratio, and prevented PC12 cell apoptosis from high glucose while ameliorating thermal hyperalgesia in diabetic rats), [resveratrol](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/33770763/) <sup>⬖</sup> (increased Nrf2 expression, inhibited NF-κB, reduced peripheral nerve apoptosis, and improved pain and temperature sensitivity), and [phloretin](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29635891/) <sup>⬖</sup> (improved behavioral outcomes and sciatic nerve antioxidant status while reducing inflammation).
content.cn: 在糖尿病神经病变模型中表现出神经保护作用的其他药物还包括：异孕甾酮（抑制caspase-3，降低Bax/Bcl2比值，防止PC12细胞因高血糖而凋亡，同时缓解糖尿病大鼠的热痛觉过敏），白藜芦醇 <sup>⬖</sup> （可上调Nrf2表达、抑制NF-κB、减少周围神经凋亡，并改善疼痛和温度敏感性）以及弗洛雷汀 <sup>⬖</sup> （可改善行为结果和坐骨神经的抗氧化状态，同时减轻炎症）。

content.en: Finally, in diabetic cardiac autonomic neuropathy, [Ferrostatin-1 and P2X7 inhibitors](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=dKcr_PZ1zcuihUEdD_oOr9_1oXK_ZtBjqKB4lV9PQhh5FHlMhjXA_sTPCZnm5JR2icgu_7Mph3qWMK0dr073mNIZVc00Xu6__lL3-Yl2ILIoQd-duJkeaPTkeBb2jQ7RUX39TkP7kyP6W3OdRUlvpFUvpkrmMpULFn0_QCkm2t4wwUgXSEFI2kAHQqEzrguBmJIM6M87VvU=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) (e.g., hypericin <sup>⬖</sup>) reduced heart rate abnormalities, sympathetic discharge frequency, cardiac injury markers, and ferroptosis indicators.
content.cn: 最后，在糖尿病性心脏自主神经病变中，铁调节蛋白-1和P2X7受体抑制剂（例如，超靛素 <sup>⬖</sup> ）可减轻心率异常、交感神经放电频率、心脏损伤标志物以及铁死亡指标。

content.en: Chemo neuropathy
content.cn: 化疗性神经病变

content.en: In chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy, [berberine](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/30536411/) <sup>⬖</sup> prevented paclitaxel-induced neuropathy in rats by improving pain thresholds, reducing sciatic nerve oxidative stress, and enhancing Nrf2 gene expression.
content.cn: 在化疗引起的周围神经病变中，小檗碱 <sup>⬖</sup> 通过提高疼痛阈值、减轻坐骨神经的氧化应激以及增强Nrf2基因的表达，成功预防了大鼠因紫杉醇引起的周围神经病变。

content.en: Likewise, DMSO, used as a transdermal delivery enhancer significantly enhanced the antihyperalgesic effect of [hyaluronan](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37467181/) <sup>⬖</sup>, reducing both prostaglandin E2 hyperalgesia and chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy, with prolonged effects upon repeated application.
content.cn: 同样，作为经皮给药促进剂的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）显著增强了透明质酸的抗痛觉过敏作用 <sup>⬖</sup> ，既减轻了前列腺素E2引起的痛觉过敏，又缓解了化疗引起的周围神经病变，且反复使用后其作用可持续较长时间。

content.en: Vibrational Disease
content.cn: 振动性疾病

content.en: Vibration disease is an occupational condition caused by prolonged exposure to local vibration (typically from power tools), resulting in vascular, nerve, and musculoskeletal damage in the upper extremities.
content.cn: 振动病是一种由长期暴露于局部振动（通常来自电动工具）引起的职业病，会导致上肢的血管、神经和肌肉骨骼系统受损。

content.en: In patients with vibration disease, DMSO water solution applied as skin compresses to affected upper extremities for 1–1.5 hours daily over 12–15 procedures produced positive effects in most cases of regional angiodystonia (impaired circulation) and sensory or autonomic polyneuropathy, with partial benefit for muscle dystonia (spasms) and stiff or frozen shoulders. The technique simplified therapy by eliminating physiotherapy procedures and reducing or eliminating the need for medications, lowering both treatment costs and clinical course duration.<sup data-ref="407">407</sup>, <sup data-ref="408">408</sup> DMSO was also used as a topical agent for vibration disease in Chinese clinical practice, leveraging its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, vasodilatory, microcirculation-improving, and immunosuppressive properties.<sup data-ref="409">409</sup>
content.cn: 对于患有振动病的患者，将二甲基亚砜（DMSO）水溶液作为皮肤敷料敷于受累的上肢，每天1–1.5小时，共进行12–15次治疗，对大多数局灶性血管紊乱（循环障碍）和感觉或自主神经多发性神经病变均产生了积极效果，并对肌肉痉挛（痉挛）以及肩周炎或冻结肩也具有部分疗效。 该疗法通过省去物理治疗步骤并减少或免除药物使用，简化了治疗流程，从而降低了治疗成本并缩短了临床病程。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 在中国的临床实践中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）也被用作振动病的局部用药，利用其镇痛、抗炎、血管扩张、改善微循环及免疫抑制等特性。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: Peripheral Neuropathy Reader Reports
content.cn: 关于周围神经病变的读者报告

content.en: Many readers reported that peripheral neuropathy (from a wide range of causes) responded to DMSO, with relief typically beginning within one to several days after topical application to the affected area (most commonly the feet) and responses ranging from partial improvement to near-complete resolution.
content.cn: 许多读者反映，外周神经病变（病因多种多样）对二甲基亚砜（DMSO）有反应，通常在患处（最常见的是脚部）局部涂抹后一至数天内开始缓解，疗效从部分改善到几乎完全痊愈不等。

content.en: Diabetic Neuropathy
content.cn: 糖尿病神经病变

content.en: A type 1 diabetic with burning, itching leg pain (suspected neuropathy and nerve damage) found that a gel made their “legs feel a whole lot better.” <sup data-ref="410">410</sup> Another with type 2 diabetes who had gotten their A1C from 11.4 to 5.0 but still had lymphedema and neuropathy started DMSO: “I had lost about 80% of feeling from my knees down. I now have about 85% feeling in my legs and feet.” <sup data-ref="411">411</sup> Another reported DMSO “has resulted in FEELING RETURNING to the feet!!!!” <sup data-ref="412">412</sup> A reader used DMSO cream on their feet at night; tingling improved by day one, and by the fourth morning “all the purple mottling was completely gone.” <sup data-ref="413">413</sup> Additional readers with diabetic neuropathy reported pain reduction and restored sensation.<sup data-ref="414">414</sup>, <sup data-ref="415">415</sup>, <sup data-ref="416">416</sup>, <sup data-ref="370">370</sup>, <sup data-ref="417">417</sup>, <sup data-ref="418">418</sup>
content.cn: 一名患有1型糖尿病、腿部出现灼热、瘙痒和疼痛（疑似神经病变和神经损伤）的患者发现，使用一种凝胶后“腿部感觉好多了”。 <sup>1</sup> 另一名2型糖尿病患者，其糖化血红蛋白（A1C）已从11.4降至5.0，但仍患有淋巴水肿和神经病变，于是开始使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）： “我膝盖以下的感觉已经丧失了约80%。现在我的腿和脚的感觉恢复到了约85%。” <sup>1</sup> 还有一位读者报告称，二甲基亚砜“让脚底的感觉回来了！！！！” <sup>1</sup> 另一位读者晚上在脚上涂抹二甲基亚砜乳膏；第一天刺痛感就有所缓解，到了第四天早晨，“所有的紫色斑驳完全消失了。” <sup>1</sup> 其他患有糖尿病神经病变的读者也报告了疼痛减轻和感觉恢复的情况。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> <sup>5</sup> <sup>6</sup>

content.en: Vaccine-Injury Neuropathy
content.cn: 疫苗致伤性神经病变

content.en: A reader developed acute inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy (on the Guillain-Barré spectrum) eight days after the Shingrix vaccine, leaving them with painful foot spasms and numbness for five years. Topical DMSO eliminated the spasms from the first night of use.<sup data-ref="419">419</sup>, <sup data-ref="420">420</sup> Another developed peripheral neuropathy in the feet within weeks of the Pfizer booster and has been using 70% DMSO with castor oil twice daily for six months with “slow steady improvement.” <sup data-ref="421">421</sup> The reader who reported the Moderna vaccine injury (gastroparesis, brain fog, SFN, MCAS, POTS, tinnitus, insomnia) described all symptoms “improving for the first time in 3 1/2 years” with DMSO.<sup data-ref="422">422</sup>
content.cn: 一名读者在接种Shingrix疫苗八天后患上了急性炎症性脱髓鞘性多发性神经病（属于吉兰-巴雷综合征谱系），此后五年间一直饱受足部痉挛和麻木的折磨。外用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）从使用第一晚起就消除了痉挛。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 另一位读者在接种辉瑞加强针数周内出现足部周围神经病变，过去六个月来每天两次使用70%二甲基亚砜（DMSO）混合蓖麻油进行治疗，症状呈现“缓慢而稳定的改善”。 <sup>1</sup> 报告莫德纳疫苗不良反应（胃轻瘫、脑雾、SFN、MCAS、POTS、耳鸣、失眠）的读者表示，在使用二甲基亚砜后，所有症状“3年半以来首次出现好转”。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: Chemotherapy-Induced Neuropathy
content.cn: 化疗引起的神经病变

content.en: A reader with chemotherapy-induced neuropathy used DMSO on the feet and reported elimination of neuropathy within two weeks of daily application (compared to the back pain that resolved with a single application).<sup data-ref="423">423</sup>,<sup data-ref="424">424</sup> Another with neuropathy in hands, feet, and face from immunotherapy found significant improvements.<sup data-ref="425">425</sup> Finally, one reported shooting pains from peripheral neuropathy (from chemo 10 years prior) were controlled with nightly DMSO foot wraps or oral DMSO at bedtime.<sup data-ref="426">426</sup>, <sup data-ref="427">427</sup>, <sup data-ref="428">428</sup>, <sup data-ref="429">429</sup>
content.cn: 一位患有化疗诱发神经病变的读者在脚部使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO），并报告称每天使用两周后神经病变便消失了（相比之下，背痛仅需一次使用即可缓解）。 <sup>1</sup> ， <sup>2</sup> 另一位因免疫治疗导致手、脚和面部出现神经病变的患者也获得了显著改善。 <sup>1</sup> 最后，还有一位读者报告称，因10年前化疗引发的周围神经病变所导致的刺痛感，通过每晚用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）进行足部热敷或睡前口服二甲基亚砜（DMSO）得到了控制。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup>

content.en: A reader shared 50% DMSO applied to the legs of a friend’s daughter born with Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease (a hereditary demyelinating neuropathy characterized by absent myelin sheath, painful leg bending, and buckling when standing) gave her immediate relief from the first application.<sup data-ref="515">515</sup>

The most visually striking report came from a reader whose 85-year-old mother’s toes and ankles had turned “a blackish blue color” from neuropathy, with nightly toe curling and cramping. After three weeks of daily DMSO, “the normal color has returned to her feet and legs. She has not had a cramp since the very first day of DMSO and she now has feeling back in both of her heels.” <sup data-ref="446">446</sup>
content.cn: 最引人注目的案例来自一位读者，他的85岁母亲因神经病变导致脚趾和脚踝呈现“黑蓝色”，且每晚都会出现脚趾蜷曲和抽筋的症状。 在连续三周每天使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）后，“她的脚和腿恢复了正常颜色。从开始使用DMSO的第一天起，她就再也没有出现过抽筋，现在双脚脚跟也恢复了知觉。” <sup>1</sup>

content.en: *Note: several readers noted that long-standing neuropathy improved more slowly than acute conditions, with some requiring weeks to months of consistent application,<sup data-ref="443">443</sup>, <sup data-ref="465">465</sup>, <sup data-ref="516">516</sup> while a few with very long-standing neuropathy reported only partial improvement.<sup data-ref="486">486</sup>, <sup data-ref="516">516</sup> One reader observed that while topical DMSO helped, switching to oral administration produced further benefit.<sup data-ref="517">517</sup>, <sup data-ref="454">454</sup>, <sup data-ref="456">456</sup>

content.en: Neuropathic Pain
content.cn: 神经病理性疼痛

content.en:
Medical management of pain typically revolves around identifying the pain generator and providing a medical therapy (e.g., an anti-inflammatory or opioid) which is known to temporarily counteract the type of pain present. While this model is sometimes quite useful (e.g., it can be used to identify emergency conditions like appendicitis **which require immediate treatment**, prevent permanent sensitization from a severe acute injury, or offer relief when the underlying cause is untreatable), it frequently results in patients needing to take increasingly toxic doses of partially effective pain medications.
Note: this helps explain why, from the start, the most popular use for DMSO was pain management, as it was able to **safely** address a wide range of pain conditions conventional therapies often could not improve (e.g., DMSO use for cancer pain is discussed [here](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/hundreds-of-studies-show-dmso-transforms)), and likewise why, sixty years later, [the most popular article in this series](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-is-a-miraculous-therapy-for) was on [DMSO’s uses for treating pain](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-is-a-miraculous-therapy-for) or why the most common testimonial I receive from readers was DMSO addressing some type of (often debilitating) source of pain nothing else had worked on. Sadly, despite immense needs for effective pain therapies (e.g., due to the opioid crisis), DMSO has languished in obscurity, something I believe boils down to pain management being one of the most reliable markets in medicine, and hence something many parties would not want to be displaced by an essentially free alternative.

疼痛的药物治疗通常围绕确定疼痛源，并采用已知能暂时缓解当前疼痛类型的药物治疗（例如抗炎药或阿片类药物）。 虽然这种模式有时非常有用（例如，可用于识别需要立即治疗的急症如阑尾炎，防止严重急性损伤导致的永久性痛觉敏感化，或在根本原因无法治疗时提供缓解），但它往往导致患者需要服用毒性日益增强且仅部分有效的止痛药物。*
注：这有助于解释为何从一开始，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）最常见的用途就是疼痛管理——因为它能够安全地缓解多种传统疗法往往难以改善的疼痛症状（例如， 本文讨论了DMSO在癌症疼痛中的应用），同样也能解释为何六十年后，本系列中最受欢迎的文章是关于DMSO用于治疗疼痛的，以及为何我收到的读者反馈中，最常见的便是DMSO成功缓解了其他方法均无效的某种（往往令人衰弱）疼痛。 遗憾的是，尽管对有效镇痛疗法的需求巨大（例如，由于阿片类药物危机），二甲基亚砜却一直默默无闻。我认为这归根结底是因为疼痛管理是医学领域最可靠的市场之一，因此许多利益相关方不愿被一种本质上免费的替代方案所取代。*

From a young age, I was able to feel others’ pain, and in medicine, this caused me to gravitate towards a functional perspective on treating pain where, I would focus on why a pain generator caused pain, and then try to either directly address the pain generator or the process it triggered which caused pain. Because of this, while studying DMSO, it immediately jumped out to me that many of DMSO’s mechanisms overlapped with the mechanisms of the approaches I would use to treat pain, but rather than strongly affecting one process, it would instead have a diffuse effect on a variety of processes, thereby making it a safe (not too strong) “DIY” therapy individuals could often use at home without requiring the precise targeting many of the modalities I used required (while conversely, in a subset of pain cases, that targeting or a stronger therapy than DMSO was needed). For example DMSO:
•As described above, resets hypersensitive neural circuits.
• [Relaxes muscles](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-heals-the-spine-and-reverses) (which, when tight, are often a root generator of pain)
• [Increases arterial, venous, and lymphatic circulation](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-heals-the-brain-and-transforms) (also often a root generator of pain when dysfunctional)
• [Is a powerful anti-inflammatory](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-treats-incurable-autoimmune), edema reducing and free radical scavenging agent (addressing another major subset of pain).
• [Heals injured tissues](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-is-a-miraculous-therapy-for) (addressing another major subset of pain—nociceptive pain).

从小我就能够感同身受他人的痛苦，这让我在医学领域倾向于采用功能性视角来治疗疼痛：我会着重探究疼痛源为何引发疼痛，然后尝试直接针对疼痛源，或针对其触发的导致疼痛的病理过程进行干预。 正因如此，在研究二甲基亚砜（DMSO）时，我立刻注意到其许多作用机制与我用于治疗疼痛的方法存在重叠。但与那些针对单一病理过程产生强烈作用的方法不同，DMSO会对多种病理过程产生广泛而温和的作用，因此成为一种安全的 （强度适中）的“DIY”疗法，人们通常可以在家中使用，而无需像我采用的许多疗法那样进行精准定位（当然，在部分疼痛病例中，则需要这种精准定位或比二甲基亚砜更强效的疗法）。例如二甲基亚砜：
•如上所述，可重置过度敏感的神经回路。
• 放松肌肉（肌肉紧张往往是疼痛的根本原因）
• 促进动脉、静脉和淋巴循环（当这些循环功能失调时，往往也是疼痛的根本诱因）
• 是一种强效的抗炎、消肿和清除自由基的物质（可缓解另一类主要疼痛）。
• 修复受损组织（从而缓解另一种主要类型的疼痛——伤害性疼痛）。

content.en: One of the most challenging types of pain to treat, neuropathic pain arises from a lesion or disease of the somatosensory nervous system and is often characterized by burning, shooting, or electric-shock sensations with heightened sensitivity to touch and temperature. A closely related and equally difficult condition is nociplastic pain, which stems from altered nociceptive processing without clear tissue damage or nerve lesions, yet shares many of the same features and treatment resistance. In both cases, conventional analgesics often fail, and analgesic options such as anticonvulsants, antidepressants, and opioids typically provide only partial relief with significant side effects (e.g., the issues with the seizure drugs gabapentin and Lyrica are discussed [here](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/what-they-dont-tell-us-about-treating)). DMSO, however, has consistently shown remarkable benefit for these pain states. This I attribute to it:
content.cn: 神经病理性疼痛是治疗难度最大的疼痛类型之一，源于躯体感觉神经系统的病变或疾病，通常表现为灼烧感、刺痛感或电击样感觉，并伴有触觉和温度敏感性增强。与之密切相关且同样难以治疗的病症是痛觉塑性性疼痛，其源于痛觉处理过程的改变，而无明显的组织损伤或神经病变，但两者具有许多共同特征，且均对治疗反应不佳。 在这两种情况下，传统镇痛药往往无效，而抗惊厥药、抗抑郁药和阿片类药物等镇痛选择通常只能提供部分缓解，且伴有显著的副作用（例如，本文讨论了抗癫痫药物加巴喷丁和利瑞卡的相关问题）。然而，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在治疗这些疼痛状态方面始终表现出显著的疗效。我认为这归因于以下原因：

content.en:
- Resetting hypersensitive nerve circuits that trigger and maintain pain sensitization.
- Restoring blood flow to nerves (improving endoneurial microcirculation, a key driver of neuropathic pain when impaired).<sup data-ref="4">4</sup>, <sup data-ref="3">3</sup>
- Improving fluid balance inside nerves by reducing swelling and pressure while supporting axoplasmic flow.
- Relieving compression on nerves (e.g., from tight muscles or edema).
- Promoting actual healing and regeneration of damaged nerves <sup data-ref="4">4</sup>, <sup data-ref="5">5</sup> (thereby reducing ectopic firing and hypersensitivity that generate neuropathic pain).
- Scavenging inflammatory free radicals that damage nerves and generate neuropathic pain.<sup data-ref="4">4</sup>, <sup data-ref="2">2</sup>
- Enhancing the body’s own pain-relieving systems (including stabilizing natural opioids like enkephalins and reducing pain transmitting substance P in the spinal cord).
- Balancing autonomic tone by reducing sympathetic overactivity and increasing parasympathetic activity via direct nerve-modulating effects and acetylcholinesterase inhibition (which is known to reduce postoperative pain, neuropathic pain, cancer pain, and chronic pain with opioid-sparing effects <sup data-ref="518">518</sup>, <sup data-ref="519">519</sup>, <sup data-ref="520">520</sup>, <sup data-ref="521">521</sup>).
*Note: in Merck’s early trials, the one type of pain DMSO did not help was psychiatric pain, though given that psychiatric disorders can worsen existing pain (e.g., by increasing sympathetic tone, arteriolar constriction, or muscle contraction), DMSO could potentially reduce the psychiatric exacerbation of pain (although this area remains largely unstudied).<sup data-ref="522">522</sup>
- Selectively blocking the transmission of neuropathic pain signals.
- Allowing other therapeutic agents to be delivered directly to sites of neuropathic pain (e.g., 5% DMSO hydrogels [were shown](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/28867811/) to facilitate permeation of gabapentin across human epidermal membranes, potentially enabling topical delivery for peripheral neuropathic pain and thereby bypassing the systemic complications of oral gabapentin and a Russian patent using a selective M1 inhibitor for topically treating neuropathic pain without weakening perception of normal stimuli.*<sup data-ref="523">523</sup>).*
*Note: [Safranal](https://pdfs.semanticscholar.org/7ad0/e5b9a111b920d05ab0d9c63f4c3f42b08abc.pdf) <sup>⬖</sup> in DMSO produced significant analgesia mediated entirely through the GABAergic pathway (unaffected by naloxone), confirming the existence of opioid-independent analgesic mechanisms accessible through DMSO-delivered natural compounds.<sup data-ref="524">524</sup>
