重置那些引发并维持疼痛敏感化的超敏神经回路。
恢复神经的血流（改善神经内膜微循环，该微循环一旦受损，便是神经病理性疼痛的主要诱因）。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup>
通过减轻水肿和压力，同时促进轴浆流动，改善神经内部的体液平衡。
缓解对神经的压迫（例如由肌肉紧张或水肿引起的）。
促进受损神经的实际愈合与再生 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> （从而减轻导致神经病理性疼痛的异位放电和超敏反应）。
清除会损伤神经并引发神经病理性疼痛的炎症自由基。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup>
增强人体自身的镇痛系统（包括稳定内源性阿片类物质（如脑啡肽）的水平，以及减少脊髓中传递疼痛的物质P的含量）。
通过直接的神经调节作用和乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制作用（已知可减轻术后疼痛、神经病理性疼痛、癌症疼痛和慢性疼痛，并具有减少阿片类药物用量的效果 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> ），减少交感神经过度活跃并增强副交感神经活动，从而平衡自主神经张力。
注：在默克公司早期的临床试验中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）唯一无法缓解的疼痛类型是精神性疼痛；不过，鉴于精神障碍可能会加剧现有疼痛（例如通过增加交感神经张力、小动脉收缩或肌肉收缩），DMSO 或许能够减轻精神因素对疼痛的加剧作用（尽管这一领域目前仍缺乏充分研究）。 <sup>1</sup>*
有选择性地阻断神经病理性疼痛信号的传导。
允许其他治疗药物直接输送至神经病理性疼痛部位（例如，研究表明5%二甲基亚砜水凝胶可促进加巴喷丁穿过人体表皮膜，这可能为外周神经病理性疼痛提供局部给药途径，从而避免口服加巴喷丁带来的全身性并发症；此外，一项俄罗斯专利利用选择性M1受体抑制剂进行神经病理性疼痛的局部治疗，且不会削弱对正常刺激的感知。 <sup>1</sup> ）。
注：二甲基亚砜（DMSO）中的萨弗纳尔（Safranal） <sup>⬖</sup> 产生了显著的镇痛作用，该作用完全通过γ-氨基丁酸能（GABAergic）通路介导（不受纳洛酮影响），这证实了通过二甲基亚砜递送的天然化合物可发挥与阿片类药物无关的镇痛机制。 <sup>1</sup>*

content.en: As many of these (e.g., circulatory improvements and healing of nerves) were discussed in the [first](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-heals-the-brain-and-transforms) and [second](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-heals-the-spine-and-reverses) parts of this series (or previously in this article), I will now focus on a few of DMSO’s pain reducing mechanisms that were not previously discussed and specifically relate to neuropathic pain and nociplastic pain.
content.cn: 由于其中许多内容（例如改善血液循环和神经修复）已在本系列的第一、二部分（或本文前文）中讨论过，因此我将重点介绍DMSO的几种此前未曾提及的镇痛机制，这些机制特别与神经病理性疼痛和痛觉塑性性疼痛有关。

content.en: *Note: I believe a significant portion of nociplastic pain results from brain tissue injury (e.g., a loss of blood flow to pain-dampening regions or direct compression of brain tissue). Many of the mechanisms listed above [also operate in the brain](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-heals-the-brain-and-transforms) (e.g., [Russian researchers extensively demonstrated](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-heals-the-brain-and-transforms) DMSO's ability to reduce the brain tissue injury and functional loss resulting from chronic stress).
content.cn: 注：我认为，相当一部分神经塑性性疼痛源于脑组织损伤（例如，镇痛区域的血流减少或脑组织的直接受压）。上述列举的许多机制在脑内同样起作用（例如，俄罗斯研究人员已通过大量研究证实，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能够减轻慢性应激导致的脑组织损伤和功能丧失）。*

content.en: Preventing Pain Transmission
content.cn: 阻断疼痛传导

content.en: Many different nerve fibers exist in the body. One group, known as the “small fibers,” is responsible for transmitting specific sensations. In particular, C fibers are frequently linked to debilitating chronic pain syndromes. For example, in small fiber neuropathy they commonly produce sensations of pins-and-needles, pricks, tingling, and numbness alongside burning pain and electrical shocks, while in nociplastic pain C fibers transmit slow, diffuse, dull, aching, or burning sensations.
content.cn: 人体内存在许多不同类型的神经纤维。 其中一类被称为“小纤维”，负责传递特定的感觉。特别是C纤维，常与令人衰弱的慢性疼痛综合征相关。例如，在小纤维神经病变中，C纤维通常会产生针刺感、刺痛、麻木等感觉，同时伴有灼痛和电击样疼痛；而在痛觉塑性性疼痛中，C纤维则传递缓慢、弥漫、钝痛、酸痛或灼痛等感觉。

content.en: *Note: the five most common symptoms of COVID vaccine injuries, in order, are fatigue, post-exertional malaise, brain fog (discussed further [here](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/we-now-have-proof-the-covid-vaccines) and [here](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/yales-censored-vaccine-injury-research)), small fiber neuropathy, and dysautonomia.
content.cn: 注：新冠疫苗不良反应最常见的五种症状依次为：疲劳、运动后不适、脑雾（详见此处和此处）、小纤维神经病变以及自主神经功能障碍。*

content.en: Due to DMSO affecting nerves in a biophysical manner, at therapeutic concentrations it selectively blocks the conduction of small nerve fibers <sup data-ref="525">525</sup> (the C fibers) while not affecting larger nerve fibers <sup data-ref="525">525</sup> thereby allowing it to address neuropathic pain without altering the other functions of the nervous system (which may explain why rather than developing a resistance to it, chronic pain patients often find DMSO’s efficacy increases over time). Specifically:
content.cn: 由于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）以生物物理学的方式作用于神经，因此在治疗浓度下，它会选择性地阻断小神经纤维 <sup>1</sup> （即C纤维）的传导，却不会影响较粗的神经纤维 <sup>1</sup> ，从而使其能够在不改变神经系统其他功能的情况下缓解神经病理性疼痛（这或许可以解释，为什么慢性疼痛患者往往不会对DMSO产生耐受性，反而会发现其疗效随时间推移而增强）。具体而言：

content.en: •In cat sural nerves, 5% DMSO slowed C fiber conduction velocity and decreased amplitude, 9% blocked conduction entirely, and the block was instantaneous at 15%, with all effects reversing once DMSO was washed off.<sup data-ref="525">525</sup>, <sup data-ref="526">526</sup>
content.cn: •在猫的胫神经中，5%的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）会减慢C纤维的传导速度并降低其振幅；9%的DMSO会完全阻断传导；而当浓度达到15%时，阻断作用是瞬时的；一旦洗去DMSO，所有这些效应都会逆转。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup>

content.en: •In cat radial nerves, lower concentrations selectively blocked C fibers and then Aδ fibers (the two fiber types responsible for pain transmission), while higher concentrations were required to affect the larger Aβ and Aγ fibers, with 5-10% DMSO also blocking C-fiber afterdischarges (a process associated with painful stimuli).<sup data-ref="527">527</sup> At much higher concentrations (75–100%), this preferential pattern persisted and was reversible if washed off early.<sup data-ref="528">528</sup>
content.cn: •在猫的桡神经中，较低浓度的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）会选择性地阻断C纤维，随后阻断Aδ纤维（这两种纤维类型负责疼痛传导），而要影响较粗的Aβ和Aγ纤维则需要更高浓度；此外，5%–10%的DMSO还会阻断C纤维的后放电（这一过程与疼痛刺激相关）。 <sup>1</sup> 在更高浓度（75–100%）下，这种选择性阻断模式依然存在，且若能及早冲洗掉，该效应可逆。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en:
•In isolated frog sciatic nerves, 6% DMSO significantly slowed conduction velocity (which reversed once the nerves were washed).*<sup data-ref="529">529</sup>*
*Note: this author concluded the conduction blocking was likely due to mechanisms such as cholinesterase inhibition rather than direct nerve blockade.
content.cn:
•在离体的青蛙坐骨神经中，6%的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）显著降低了传导速度（但经冲洗后该现象即恢复正常）。 <sup>1</sup>
注：该作者认为，传导阻滞很可能是由胆碱酯酶抑制等机制引起的，而非直接的神经阻滞。*

content.en: •One detailed review found DMSO’s analgesic effects lasted approximately 6 hours (compared with 2 hours for morphine), and intrathecal (into the CSF) 50% DMSO produced 30 minutes of complete anesthesia in cats with full recovery. The same review confirmed that 5-10% DMSO rapidly blocked pain-conducting C fibers and that 6% DMSO reduced sciatic nerve conduction velocity by 40%.<sup data-ref="530">530</sup>
content.cn: •一项详细综述发现，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的镇痛作用可持续约6小时（而吗啡仅为2小时），且向猫的脑脊液中注射50%二甲基亚砜溶液可产生30分钟的完全麻醉，且猫能完全恢复。 该综述还证实，5%-10%的DMSO可迅速阻断传导疼痛的C纤维，而6%的DMSO可使坐骨神经传导速度降低40%。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: These nerve-blocking properties suggest DMSO could be combined with natural substances that independently block nerve conduction. [In isolated frog sciatic nerves](https://www.jstage.jst.go.jp/article/pain/29/1/29_3/_pdf/-char/ja), various aroma oil compounds dissolved in DMSO concentration-dependently and reversibly inhibited compound action potentials through mechanisms independent of TRP channel activation, with linalyl acetate <sup>⬖</sup> showing efficacy comparable to lidocaine, ropivacaine, and cocaine, and linalool,<sup>⬖</sup> citral,<sup>⬖</sup> and citronellal <sup>⬖</sup> also demonstrating significant blocking activity.<sup data-ref="531">531</sup> Capsaicin and related vanilloid compounds <sup>⬖</sup> (including eugenol <sup>⬖</sup> and dihydrocapsaicin <sup>⬖</sup>) similarly blocked nerve conduction independent of TRPV1 activation, through direct sodium channel blockade with potency determined by the hydrophobic side chain length.<sup data-ref="532">532</sup> Likewise, Kampo herbal formulations (particularly daikenchuto,<sup>⬖</sup> containing processed ginger, ginseng, and Japanese pepper) concentration-dependently inhibited nerve conduction (~70% reduction at 2 mg/ml) partly through plant-derived TRP agonists (piperine,<sup>⬖</sup> cinnamaldehyde <sup>⬖</sup>) but also through TRP-independent mechanisms, with 1% DMSO alone having no effect on compound action potentials.<sup data-ref="533">533</sup>, <sup data-ref="534">534</sup>
content.cn: 这些神经阻断特性表明，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可与能够独立阻断神经传导的天然物质结合使用。在离体的青蛙坐骨神经中，溶解于DMSO中的各种香薰油化合物通过独立于TRP通道激活的机制，以浓度依赖性和可逆的方式抑制了复合动作电位，其中乙酸芳樟酯 <sup>⬖</sup> 的功效可与利多卡因、罗哌卡因和可卡因相媲美，而芳樟醇、 <sup>⬖</sup> 柠檬醛、 <sup>⬖</sup> 以及香茅醛 <sup>⬖</sup> 也表现出显著的阻断活性。 <sup>1</sup> 辣椒素及相关香草酮类化合物 <sup>⬖</sup> （包括丁香酚 <sup>⬖</sup> 和二氢辣椒素 <sup>⬖</sup> ）同样通过直接阻断钠通道来阻断神经传导，其效力取决于疏水侧链的长度，且该作用与TRPV1激活无关。 <sup>1</sup> 同样，汉方制剂（特别是含有加工生姜、人参和山椒的大建中汤 <sup>⬖</sup> ）以浓度依赖性方式抑制了神经传导（2 mg/ml 时减少约 70%），部分是通过植物来源的 TRP 激动剂 （胡椒碱、 <sup>⬖</sup> 肉桂醛 <sup>⬖</sup> ），但也通过TRP独立机制发挥作用，而单独使用1%二甲基亚砜（DMSO）对复合动作电位则无影响。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup>

content.en: *Note: an insect study found DMSO preferentially inhibits peripheral sensory receptor activity over axonal conduction: in a proprioceptive organ, DMSO blocked sensory neuron responses to mechanical stimulation at just 0.85% (50% block in 18-20 minutes), while blocking sensory axon conduction required roughly five times higher concentration (4.6%), demonstrating sensory receptor inactivation as a distinct analgesic mechanism separate from C fiber conduction block.<sup data-ref="535">535</sup>
content.cn: 注：一项昆虫研究发现，DMSO 优先抑制外周感觉受体的活动，而非轴突传导： 在一种本体感觉器官中，DMSO仅需0.85%的浓度即可阻断感觉神经元对机械刺激的反应（18-20分钟内阻断率达50%），而阻断感觉轴突传导则需要大约五倍的浓度（4.6%），这表明感觉受体的失活是一种与C纤维传导阻断不同的独特镇痛机制。 <sup>1</sup>*

content.en: Receptor and Ion Channel Modulation
content.cn: 受体和离子通道的调节

content.en: DMSO suppresses NMDA and AMPA induced ion fluxes in neurons, each of which are receptors linked to chronic pain (e.g., NMDA is linked to central pain sensitization),<sup data-ref="536">536</sup>, <sup data-ref="537">537</sup> a property I believe may partly account for why DMSO treats complex regional pain syndrome and which has also been proposed to explain [its utility in treating cancer pain](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/hundreds-of-studies-show-dmso-transforms).<sup data-ref="538">538</sup>, <sup data-ref="6">6</sup>
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可抑制神经元中由NMDA和AMPA受体诱导的离子流，这两种受体均与慢性疼痛相关（例如，NMDA受体与中枢性疼痛敏感化相关）， <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 我认为这一特性或许能部分解释为何DMSO能治疗复杂性区域疼痛综合征，且该特性也被认为可解释其在治疗癌症疼痛方面的功效。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup>

content.en: Like local anesthetics, DMSO has also been observed to block sodium and calcium ions’ entry into cells, which has been proposed to explain how DMSO can help cancer pain.<sup data-ref="539">539</sup>, <sup data-ref="538">538</sup> Likewise, in whole-cell voltage-clamp studies on differentiated neuroblastoma × glioma hybrid cells, DMSO (0.5–1%) reversibly blocked voltage-gated Na⁺, K⁺, and Ca²⁺ currents, with effects resembling those of local and general anesthetics.<sup data-ref="540">540</sup>
content.cn: 与局部麻醉药类似，研究还发现二甲基亚砜（DMSO）也能阻断钠离子和钙离子进入细胞，据推测这可以解释DMSO为何能缓解癌症疼痛。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 同样，在针对分化后的神经母细胞瘤×胶质瘤杂交细胞进行的全细胞电压钳研究中，二甲基亚砜（0.5–1%）可逆地阻断了电压门控的Na⁺、K⁺和Ca²⁺电流，其作用与局部麻醉剂和全身麻醉剂的作用相似。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: Finally, detailed electrophysiological studies in unmyelinated neurons confirm that DMSO blocks nerve impulses at approximately 8–15% concentrations and that small-diameter C fibers are preferentially affected at lower doses than larger myelinated fibers.¹ This blockade was found to arise partly from depolarization of the resting membrane potential caused by reduced permeability to potassium and chloride ions, together with suppression of the delayed potassium current that prolongs spike repolarization.<sup data-ref="541">541</sup>
content.cn: 最后，针对无髓鞘神经元的详细电生理研究证实，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在浓度约为8%–15%时会阻断神经冲动，且在小剂量下，小直径C纤维受影响的程度比大直径有髓鞘纤维更为显著。¹ 研究发现，这种阻断部分源于钾离子和氯离子通透性降低导致的静息膜电位去极化，同时伴随延迟钾电流的抑制，从而延长了动作电位的复极化时间。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: Central analgesic effects
content.cn: 中枢镇痛作用

content.en: Beyond interrupting peripheral nerve pain transmission, DMSO exerts direct pain-suppressing effects within the spinal cord and brain:
content.cn: 除了阻断周围神经的疼痛传导外，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）还在脊髓和大脑内发挥直接的镇痛作用：

content.en:
•Intraperitoneal DMSO (50%) reduced the nociceptive response to capsaicin injection by 73.1% and independently raised pain thresholds in the tail-flick test, with DMSO’s analgesic effect attributed to central (likely NMDA receptor-mediated) mechanisms rather than peripheral afferent modulation.<sup data-ref="542">542</sup>, <sup data-ref="543">543</sup>, <sup data-ref="544">544</sup>
•DMSO microinjected into the rostral ventromedial medulla (a part of the brain) potentiated swim stress-induced analgesia across all phases of the formalin test, likely by increasing neuronal excitability in descending inhibitory pain pathways.<sup data-ref="545">545</sup>
content.cn:
•腹腔注射二甲基亚砜（50%）可将辣椒素注射引起的痛觉反应降低73.1%，并在尾部闪避试验中独立提高疼痛阈值；二甲基亚砜的镇痛作用归因于中枢（可能由NMDA受体介导）机制，而非外周传入神经的调节。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup>
•将二甲基亚砜（DMSO）微量注射入脑干前腹内侧部（大脑的一部分）后，在福尔马林试验的所有阶段均增强了游泳应激诱导的镇痛效应，这很可能是通过增加下行抑制性疼痛通路中神经元的兴奋性来实现的。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: •In rats, intrathecal DMSO reduced pain transmitting substance P and calcitonin gene-related peptide levels in the spinal cord and increased hot plate latency, indicating direct central antinociception.<sup data-ref="546">546</sup> In another study (modeling bone cancer pain) it increased mechanical and thermal pain thresholds and decreased spinal microglial markers (OX-42 and Iba-1), confirming DMSO’s central anti-neuroinflammatory and analgesic properties even in severe pain states**.<sup data-ref="547">547</sup>** Finally, DMSO injected directly into the cerebrospinal fluid has been shown to induce total anesthesia in animals without causing any adverse reactions.<sup data-ref="548">548</sup> Additionally, direct application of DMSO into surgical wounds relieved acute pain in rats, providing further evidence of DMSO's independent analgesic properties at the site of tissue injury.<sup data-ref="549">549</sup>
content.cn: •在大鼠实验中，鞘内注射二甲基亚砜（DMSO）降低了脊髓中疼痛传递物质P和降钙素基因相关肽的水平，并延长了热板试验的潜伏期，表明其具有直接的中枢抗痛觉作用。 <sup>1</sup> 在另一项研究（骨癌疼痛模型）中，它提高了机械痛和热痛阈值，并降低了脊髓小胶质细胞标志物（OX-42 和 Iba-1）的水平，证实了即使在严重疼痛状态下，DMSO 仍具有中枢抗神经炎症和镇痛特性。 <sup>1</sup> 最后，研究表明，将二甲基亚砜直接注入脑脊液可诱导动物进入完全麻醉状态，且不会引起任何不良反应。 <sup>1</sup> 此外，将二甲基亚砜直接涂抹于手术伤口可缓解大鼠的急性疼痛，这进一步证明了二甲基亚砜在组织损伤部位具有独立的镇痛特性。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: •Topical DMSO can also activate spinal inhibitory circuits. Cutaneous application activated Aδ-afferents, which then suppressed C-afferent pain transmission through an intersegmental mechanism mediated by presynaptic GABA(B) receptors on C-afferent central terminals.<sup data-ref="550">550</sup>
content.cn: •外用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）也能激活脊髓抑制回路。经皮肤给药可激活Aδ传入纤维，进而通过C传入纤维中枢末梢上的突触前GABA(B)受体介导的节间机制，抑制C传入纤维的疼痛传导。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: •Additionally, in the spinal nerve ligation (SNL) model of peripheral nerve injury, intrathecal DMSO prevented GABAergic neuron dysfunction and loss in the dorsal horn, central sensitization of dorsal horn neurons, and mechanical hypersensitivity through its free radical scavenging properties.<sup data-ref="551">551</sup>00286-2/fulltext) This suggests that DMSO may help mitigate central sensitization following certain peripheral nerve injuries.
content.cn: •此外，在脊神经结扎（SNL）这一周围神经损伤模型中，鞘内注射二甲基亚砜（DMSO）通过其清除自由基的特性，防止了背角中γ-氨基丁酸能神经元的功能障碍和丧失、背角神经元的中枢敏感化以及机械性痛觉过敏。 <sup>1</sup> 这表明，DMSO 可能有助于缓解某些周围神经损伤后出现的中枢敏感化。

content.en: Dose-dependence
content.cn: 剂量依赖性

content.en: Since DMSO also enhances the function of nerves, in some studies, at low concentrations, it increased rather than reduced pain transmission:
content.cn: 由于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）还能增强神经功能，因此在某些研究中，低浓度的DMSO反而会增强而非减弱疼痛传导：

content.en: •At very low concentrations (0.3-1%), DMSO enhanced rather than blocked nociceptive transmission in isolated neonatal rat spinal cord, potentiating substance P- and capsaicin-induced depolarization through cholinesterase inhibition (while having no effect on myelinated A-fiber reflexes).<sup data-ref="552">552</sup>
content.cn: •在极低浓度（0.3-1%）下，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在离体新生大鼠脊髓中增强了痛觉传导，而非阻断它，通过抑制胆碱酯酶，增强了P物质和辣椒素诱导的去极化（但对有髓A纤维反射无影响）。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: •In mice, DMSO injected directly into the brain produced strong antinociception (pain reduction), oral administration produced slight antinociception with anti-inflammatory effects, but subcutaneous local administration (which delivers the smallest amount of DMSO to the central nervous system) it increased nociceptive (pain sensing) responses.<sup data-ref="553">553</sup>
content.cn: •在小鼠实验中，直接注入脑内的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）产生了强烈的抗痛觉作用（减轻疼痛）；口服给药则产生了轻微的抗痛觉作用并具有抗炎效应；但皮下局部给药（这种给药方式向中枢神经系统输送的DMSO量最少）却增强了痛觉（疼痛感知）反应。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: •Cutaneous DMSO enhanced the nociceptive response to capsaicin (a TRPV1 agonist) in a time- and dose-dependent manner: at 30 minutes pre-application, 10-100% DMSO dose-dependently increased the pain reaction, while at 1 minute pre-application (when DMSO had not yet had time to diffuse away to a lower concentration) no effect was seen at any concentration.<sup data-ref="554">554</sup>
content.cn: •经皮肤给药的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）以时间和剂量依赖性方式增强了对辣椒素（一种TRPV1激动剂）的痛觉反应：在应用前30分钟给药时，10%–100%浓度的DMSO会以剂量依赖性方式增强痛觉反应；而在应用前1分钟给药时（此时DMSO尚未有时间扩散至较低浓度），无论何种浓度均未观察到影响。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: Conversely, low doses of DMSO also have been shown to reduce pain. For example, 0.3% DMSO prevented acetic acid-induced pain behaviors in zebrafish larvae, performing comparably to Tylenol and outperforming ibuprofen (which showed no analgesic effect), likely operating via a Pannexin-1-related pathway.<sup data-ref="555">555</sup>, <sup data-ref="556">556</sup> *Note: [low concentrations of DMSO](https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Amany-Hasanin/publication/259801977) masked the antinociceptive activity of Tylenol in the mouse formalin test—however I am not aware of any similar reports in humans.*
content.cn: 相反，研究还表明低剂量的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）也能缓解疼痛。例如，0.3%的DMSO可抑制斑马鱼幼鱼的醋酸诱导性疼痛行为，其效果与泰诺相当，且优于布洛芬（后者未显示出镇痛作用），其作用机制很可能与Pannexin-1相关通路有关。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 注：在小鼠福尔马林试验中，低浓度的二甲基亚砜掩盖了泰诺的抗痛觉作用——但我尚未发现有关人类的类似报道。

content.en: Lastly, I have not received reports from readers of low doses of topical DMSO worsening pain. However, I am including this section for individuals with challenging pain cases seeking additional insights for developing an effective treatment protocol.
content.cn: 最后，我尚未收到读者反馈称低剂量的外用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）会加剧疼痛。不过，我还是增设了这一部分内容，供那些面临棘手疼痛病例、并希望获得更多见解以制定有效治疗方案的医生参考。

content.en: Opioid-independent analgesia and endogenous pain modulation
content.cn: 非阿片类镇痛与内源性疼痛调节

content.en: Opioids work by stimulating pain-blocking receptors that evolved to respond to opioid-like molecules the body naturally produces (endorphins). In 1985, a clinician discovered that giving low doses of an opioid receptor blocker (naltrexone) triggered the body to increase its own endorphin and enkephalin production, and that beyond modulating pain, low-dose naltrexone (LDN) broadly improved immune function, reducing inflammation while increasing resistance to both infections and cancer. As such, LDN (discussed further [here](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-do-we-determine-the-correct-dose)) has become an immensely popular integrative therapy (e.g., for fibromyalgia and a variety of autoimmune or chronic inflammatory disorders). Conversely, in opioid users, beyond addiction resulting from the down regulation of the body’s opioid system, a variety of other health issues also emerge such as increased pain sensitivity (opioid-induced hyperalgesia), persistent low mood and anhedonia (loss of ability to enjoy life), hormonal disruptions (such as low testosterone), weakened immune function, reduced bone density, and poorer stress resilience.
content.cn: 阿片类药物的作用机制是刺激那些能够阻断疼痛的受体，这些受体在进化过程中形成，用于响应人体自然产生的类似阿片类分子的物质（内啡肽）。 1985年，一位临床医生发现，给予低剂量的阿片受体拮抗剂（纳曲酮）会促使人体增加自身内啡肽和脑啡肽的分泌；而且，除了调节疼痛外，低剂量纳曲酮（LDN）还能广泛改善免疫功能，在减轻炎症的同时增强对感染和癌症的抵抗力。 因此，LDN（本文将进一步探讨）已成为一种广受欢迎的整合疗法（例如，用于治疗纤维肌痛以及各种自身免疫性或慢性炎症性疾病）。 相反，在阿片类药物使用者中，除了因机体阿片系统下调而导致的成瘾外，还会出现多种其他健康问题，例如疼痛敏感性增加（阿片类药物诱导的痛觉过敏）、持续情绪低落和快感缺失（丧失享受生活的能力）、激素紊乱（如睾酮水平低下）、免疫功能减弱、骨密度降低以及应激韧性下降。

content.en: DMSO addresses both sides of this equation. As early as 1974, [a Nature article](https://www.nature.com/articles/247421a0) noted DMSO held “significant promise for neurological injuries and incapacitating pain” but that it had been “held to an unduly rigorous standard for testing,” leaving it unclear whether its potential would ever be properly studied in humans. Fifty years later, that question remains unanswered, but the evidence for DMSO’s opioid-independent analgesia has only grown stronger.
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）同时解决了这一方程式的两个方面。早在1974年，《自然》杂志上的一篇文章就指出，DMSO在“神经损伤和致残性疼痛的治疗方面具有显著潜力”，但其“被要求达到过分严格的测试标准”，因此尚不清楚其潜力是否能最终在人体上得到妥善研究。 五十年后的今天，这个问题依然悬而未决，但关于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）具有阿片类药物独立镇痛作用的证据却日益确凿。

content.en: In direct comparison, DMSO produced analgesic effects comparable in magnitude to morphine, but with a duration of 6–7 hours or sometimes much longer (versus 2 hours for morphine), and this effect was rarely reversed by naloxone, indicating the mechanism is likely independent of opioid receptors.<sup data-ref="557">557</sup>, <sup data-ref="558">558</sup>, <sup data-ref="559">559</sup>, <sup data-ref="560">560</sup> Likewise, in horses, IV DMSO produced analgesia clinically similar to phenylbutazone (a potent NSAID), acting via blockade of glutamatergic pathways and NMDA receptors in the CNS rather than through opioid mechanisms, with a half-life of approximately 8.53 hours allowing safe twice-daily administration.<sup data-ref="561">561</sup>
content.cn: 直接比较发现，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）产生的镇痛效果在强度上可与吗啡媲美，但持续时间为6–7小时，有时甚至更长（而吗啡仅持续2小时），且这种效果极少被纳洛酮逆转，这表明其作用机制很可能与阿片受体无关。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> 同样， 在马身上，静脉注射二甲基亚砜（DMSO）产生的镇痛效果在临床上与苯丁唑（一种强效非甾体抗炎药）相似，其作用机制是通过阻断中枢神经系统中的谷氨酸能通路和NMDA受体，而非通过阿片类机制，其半衰期约为8.53小时，因此可安全地每日给药两次。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: Beyond providing opioid-independent pain relief, DMSO appears to amplify the body’s own opioid signaling through multiple mechanisms. NMR studies show that enkephalins (the body’s natural opioids) adopt a compact bioactive conformation in DMSO that pre-organizes their key residues into a morphine-like shape capable of activating opioid receptors (potentially enhancing the efficacy of even trace amounts of endogenous enkephalins).<sup data-ref="562">562</sup>, <sup data-ref="563">563</sup> Additionally, in cell culture, 2% DMSO increased functional μ-opioid receptor expression up to 6-fold (while also upregulating κ-opioid receptors) without altering receptor affinity.<sup data-ref="564">564</sup> Complementing this, DMSO enables topical opioid delivery. When morphine or enkephalin analogs were dissolved in DMSO and applied topically to mouse tails, they produced potent, dose-dependent analgesia with no detectable systemic absorption, and repeated exposure induced only local (not systemic) tolerance that was blocked by NMDA antagonism.<sup data-ref="565">565</sup> This suggests DMSO could enable targeted localized opioid pain relief without the systemic side effects, tolerance, and addiction that make chronic opioid use so problematic.
content.cn: 除了提供不依赖阿片类药物的镇痛作用外，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）似乎还能通过多种机制增强人体自身的阿片类信号传导。核磁共振（NMR）研究表明，内啡肽（人体内源性阿片类物质）在DMSO中会呈现紧凑的生物活性构象，这种构象将关键残基预先组织成类似吗啡的形状，从而能够激活阿片受体（甚至可能增强微量内源性内啡肽的功效）。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 此外，在细胞培养实验中，2% 的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可将功能性 μ-阿片受体的表达水平提高至 6 倍（同时上调 κ-阿片受体），且不会改变受体的亲和力。 <sup>1</sup> 与此相辅相成的是，DMSO 还能实现阿片类药物的局部给药。 当吗啡或脑啡肽类似物溶解于二甲基亚砜并局部涂抹于小鼠尾部时，它们产生了强效的、剂量依赖性的镇痛作用，且未检测到全身吸收；重复给药仅诱导局部（而非全身）耐受性，且该耐受性可被NMDA拮抗剂阻断。 <sup>1</sup> 这表明二甲基亚砜能够实现靶向局部阿片类镇痛，同时避免了导致慢性阿片类药物使用问题严重的全身性副作用、耐受性和成瘾性。

content.en: Together, these findings may suggest DMSO enhances endogenous opioid signaling at both the peptide and receptor level, potentially benefitting chronic opioid users whose endorphin production has been downregulated while also offering some of the benefits of LDN therapy to chronically ill patients.
content.cn: 综合来看，这些研究结果可能表明，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能在肽和受体两个层面增强内源性阿片类物质的信号传导，这不仅可能惠及因内啡肽分泌受抑制的慢性阿片类药物使用者，还能为慢性病患者带来低剂量纳洛酮（LDN）疗法的一些益处。

content.en: *Note: from the start, DMSO was recognized to potentiate insulin (making diabetics require lower insulin doses to avoid hypoglycemia), and this effect is frequently postulated to result from DMSO’s protein stabilizing qualities making insulin receptors more sensitive to insulin (**suggesting it could do the same for opioid receptors**). However, while studies show DMSO can promote insulin secretion,<sup data-ref="566">566</sup>, <sup data-ref="567">567</sup> and the disassembly of insulin amyloid fibrils,<sup data-ref="568">568</sup>, <sup data-ref="569">569</sup>03334-7), <sup data-ref="568">568</sup> I have not found any studies showing it improves receptor function (rather, only ones that show in combination with another agent such as resveratrol, ginger, DHC, allicin or DHEA that insulin sensitivity is increased <sup data-ref="570">570</sup>, <sup data-ref="571">571</sup>, <sup data-ref="572">572</sup>, <sup data-ref="573">573</sup>, <sup data-ref="574">574</sup>, <sup data-ref="575">575</sup>, <sup data-ref="576">576</sup>, <sup data-ref="577">577</sup>, <sup data-ref="578">578</sup> or that at higher concentrations DMSO impairs insulin binding <sup data-ref="579">579</sup>).
content.cn: 注：从一开始，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）就被认为具有增强胰岛素作用的效果（使糖尿病患者在避免低血糖的情况下所需胰岛素剂量降低），人们通常推测这种效果源于DMSO的蛋白质稳定特性，该特性使胰岛素受体对胰岛素更为敏感（这表明它对阿片受体可能也有同样的作用）。 然而，尽管研究表明二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能够促进胰岛素分泌， <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 并能分解胰岛素淀粉样纤维， <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> 但我尚未发现任何研究表明它能改善受体功能（相反，仅有研究显示，当与白藜芦醇、生姜、DHC、大蒜素或DHEA等其他物质联合使用时，胰岛素敏感性会提高 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> <sup>5</sup> <sup>6</sup> <sup>7</sup> <sup>8</sup> <sup>9</sup> 或者表明高浓度的二甲基亚砜会阻碍胰岛素结合 <sup>1</sup> ）。*

content.en: DMSO also directly counteracts the paradoxical pain sensitization that develops with chronic opioid use. In a morphine-induced hyperalgesia model, DMSO inhibited thermal hyperalgesia by reducing spinal dorsal horn TNF-α expression.<sup data-ref="580">580</sup>, <sup data-ref="581">581</sup> A large number of agents dissolved in DMSO have similarly been shown to reverse opioid-induced hyperalgesia, tolerance, and withdrawal across numerous animal models (such as β-elemene⬖ and curcumin⬖), targeting overlapping central pathways including amygdalar glutamatergic signaling, spinal NMDA receptor trafficking, and neuroinflammatory cascades.<sup data-ref="582">582</sup>, <sup data-ref="583">583</sup>, <sup data-ref="584">584</sup>, <sup data-ref="585">585</sup>, <sup data-ref="586">586</sup>, <sup data-ref="587">587</sup>, <sup data-ref="588">588</sup>, <sup data-ref="589">589</sup>, <sup data-ref="590">590</sup> GSK3 inhibitors SB216763 and SB415286 prevented morphine-induced antinociceptive tolerance and alleviated withdrawal symptoms (grooming, chewing, ptosis) without affecting other withdrawal behaviors.<sup data-ref="591">591</sup>
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）还能直接对抗慢性阿片类药物使用所导致的悖论性疼痛敏感化。在吗啡诱导的痛觉过敏模型中，DMSO通过降低脊髓后角的TNF-α表达，抑制了热痛觉过敏。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 大量溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的药物在众多动物模型中也显示出类似的功效，能够逆转阿片类药物诱导的痛觉过敏、耐受性和戒断症状（例如β-莰烯⬖和姜黄素⬖），其作用靶点涉及多个重叠的中枢通路，包括杏仁核谷氨酸能信号传导、脊髓NMDA受体的转运以及神经炎症级联反应。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> <sup>5</sup> <sup>6</sup> <sup>7</sup> <sup>8</sup> <sup>9</sup> GSK3抑制剂SB216763和SB415286可预防吗啡诱导的抗痛觉耐受性，并缓解戒断症状 （梳理毛发、咀嚼、眼睑下垂），且未影响其他戒断行为。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: Finally, opioids have been recognized to be one of the medications potentiated by DMSO (acute co-administration of 2% DMSO enhanced morphine antinociception *<sup data-ref="592">592</sup>),* potentially allowing chronic opioid users to reduce their doses. In instances where the strongest potentiation occurs (IV administration of both concurrently—which occurred during stem cell infusions), there have been reported instances in children and adults of temporary morphine overdose symptoms.<sup data-ref="593">593</sup> This opioid-potentiating effect has also been demonstrated clinically: when DMSO was added to intramuscular pethidine in patients with acute pancreatitis, it significantly enhanced pain relief, with 57% of patients pain-free within 12 hours, attributed to DMSO scavenging oxygen-derived free radicals.<sup data-ref="594">594</sup> *Note: conversely repeated higher doses of DMSO (via microinjections) was found to decrease morphine potency for at least one week (comparably to morphine tolerance).<sup data-ref="592">592</sup>*
content.cn: 最后，阿片类药物已被公认为二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可增强其药效的药物之一（急性联合给药2% DMSO可增强吗啡的抗痛觉作用 <sup>1</sup> ），这可能使慢性阿片类药物使用者得以减少用药剂量。在药效增强最显著的情况下（即两者同时静脉给药——这在干细胞输注过程中曾发生），已有儿童和成人出现暂时性吗啡过量症状的报道。 <sup>1</sup> 这种增强阿片类药物作用的效果在临床上也得到了证实：当对急性胰腺炎患者肌肉注射哌替啶时加入二甲基亚砜，其镇痛效果显著增强，57%的患者在12小时内疼痛消失，这归因于二甲基亚砜能清除氧自由基。 <sup>1</sup> 注：相反，研究发现反复使用较高剂量的二甲基亚砜（通过微量注射）会降低吗啡的效力，且这种影响至少持续一周（类似于吗啡耐受性）。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: In short, research into DMSO’s interactions with opioids, beyond potentially benefitting opioid users, provides additional insights into how DMSO is independently able to improve a variety of chronic pain conditions.
content.cn: 简而言之，关于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）与阿片类药物相互作用的研究，除了可能对阿片类药物使用者带来益处外，还进一步揭示了DMSO如何能够独立地改善多种慢性疼痛病症。

content.en: Potentiation of local anesthetics
content.cn: 局部麻醉药的增效作用

content.en: DMSO significantly enhances the potency of local anesthetics,<sup data-ref="595">595</sup>, <sup data-ref="596">596</sup>, <sup data-ref="597">597</sup>, <sup data-ref="598">598</sup> potentiating lidocaine’s nerve conduction blocking effect at concentrations as low as 0.1-0.2% (where DMSO alone has no anesthetic effect), through an allosteric mechanism independent of increased intracellular drug levels.<sup data-ref="599">599</sup>, <sup data-ref="600">600</sup>, <sup data-ref="166">166</sup>, <sup data-ref="601">601</sup> In a human study, 50% DMSO alone produced partial anesthesia (numbness) to pinpricking sensation (while 20% produced a smaller reduction),<sup data-ref="602">602</sup> and long-term (but fully reversible) blockade of nerve endings and trunks can be achieved by mixing DMSO with local anesthetics at a final concentration of 30-50%.<sup data-ref="263">263</sup> In a bilateral CCI (chronic constriction injury) neuropathic pain model, intrathecal procaine dissolved in DMSO significantly improved mechanical and thermal pain thresholds while downregulating JAK2/STAT3 signaling in the spinal dorsal horn, with JAK2 overexpression reversing procaine's analgesic effect.<sup data-ref="603">603</sup>
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能显著增强局部麻醉药的效力， <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> 即使在低至0.1%-0.2%的浓度下（此时DMSO单独使用并无麻醉作用），也能通过一种与细胞内药物浓度升高无关的别构机制，增强利多卡因对神经传导的阻断作用。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> 在一项人体研究中，50%的DMSO单独使用即可对针刺感产生部分麻醉（麻木）作用（而20%的浓度仅产生较小的减弱作用）， <sup>1</sup> 将二甲基亚砜与局部麻醉药混合，使最终浓度达到30%-50%，可实现对神经末梢和神经干的长期（但完全可逆）阻断。 <sup>1</sup> 在双侧CCI（慢性压迫损伤）神经病理性疼痛模型中，溶于DMSO的普鲁卡因鞘内给药显著提高了机械痛和热痛阈值，同时下调了脊髓背角中的JAK2/STAT3信号通路；而JAK2的过表达则会逆转普鲁卡因的镇痛作用。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: DMSO also markedly enhances transdermal anesthetic penetration (producing higher skin concentrations, greater flux, and shorter lag times compared to other vehicles.<sup data-ref="604">604</sup> This penetration-enhancing property led to the early development of tetracaine dissolved in DMSO for topical skin anesthesia,<sup data-ref="605">605</sup>, <sup data-ref="606">606</sup> which did not gain widespread dermal use due to the temporary skin irritation DMSO can cause. However, it found a niche in otology as myringotomies (e.g., for ear tubes) first require the painful injection of an anesthetic into the eardrum (which is avoided with a topical DMSO application), with one paper reporting this combination was well tolerated and effective in 164 cases (with tetracaine inducing anesthesia within 10 minutes).<sup data-ref="607">607</sup>, <sup data-ref="608">608</sup>, <sup data-ref="609">609</sup>50562-8/fulltext#con) *Note: DMSO has also been listed among injectable solutions (alongside lidocaine, procaine, corticosteroids, and B vitamins) for trigger point therapy.<sup data-ref="610">610</sup>*
content.cn: DMSO 还能显著增强麻醉药的经皮渗透（与其他载体相比，可产生更高的皮肤浓度、更大的通量以及更短的滞后时间）。 <sup>1</sup> 这一增强渗透的特性促使人们早期就开发出溶于 DMSO 的四卡因用于皮肤局部麻醉， <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 但由于 DMSO 可能会引起暂时性的皮肤刺激，该方法并未在皮肤应用中得到广泛使用。 然而，它在耳科领域找到了应用空间，因为鼓膜切开术（例如放置耳管）通常需要先向鼓膜注射麻醉剂（这会引起疼痛，而局部使用DMSO可避免此步骤）；有篇论文报道，在164例病例中，这种组合耐受性良好且有效（四卡因可在10分钟内起麻醉作用）。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> 注：二甲基亚砜（DMSO）也被列入用于触发点疗法的注射液清单（与利多卡因、普鲁卡因、皮质类固醇和B族维生素并列）。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: In one trial, topical DMSO combined with lidocaine provided effective analgesia during extracorporeal shock wave lithotripsy (outperforming EMLA cream with lower pain scores and fewer interruptions from intolerable pain,<sup data-ref="611">611</sup> offering a cost-effective alternative to opioids and injectable analgesics while reducing the need for general anesthesia.<sup data-ref="612">612</sup> In another, topical lidocaine in DMSO-ethanol safely achieved 51% anesthesia during pulsed dye laser treatment of vascular malformations.<sup data-ref="613">613</sup> Likewise, in veterinary practice, topical bupivacaine-DMSO applied to trimmed chicken beaks improved feed intake compared to untreated birds,<sup data-ref="614">614</sup>
content.cn: 在一项试验中，外用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）联合利多卡因在体外冲击波碎石术期间提供了有效的镇痛效果（表现优于EMLA乳膏，疼痛评分更低，因无法忍受的疼痛而中断治疗的情况更少， <sup>1</sup> 不仅为阿片类药物和注射用镇痛药提供了一种经济高效的替代方案，还减少了对全身麻醉的需求。 <sup>1</sup> 在另一项试验中，在脉冲染料激光治疗血管畸形时，DMSO-乙醇溶液中的局部利多卡因安全地实现了51%的麻醉效果。 <sup>1</sup> 同样，在兽医临床实践中，将布比卡因-DMSO溶液涂抹于修剪过的鸡喙上，与未处理的鸡相比，可提高采食量， <sup>1</sup>

content.en: *Note: DMSO was anticipated as a dedicated nerve pain drug by Searle, but its development was halted by the FDA.<sup data-ref="615">615</sup>
content.cn: 注：塞尔公司曾将二甲基亚砜（DMSO）视为一种专门用于治疗神经痛的药物，但其研发工作被美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）叫停。 <sup>1</sup>*

content.en: Unusual Pain Types
content.cn: 不寻常的疼痛类型

content.en: DMSO also treats a variety of pain types that are challenging to treat with conventional options. For example, extensive evidence and numerous reader testimonials <sup data-ref="616">616</sup>, <sup data-ref="617">617</sup>, <sup data-ref="618">618</sup> show DMSO treats cancer bone metastasis pain.<sup data-ref="6">6</sup> Likewise, in 21 patients with acute alcohol-induced pancreatitis [rectal DMSO](https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jamasurgery/article-abstract/595169) (500 mg every 8 hours) achieved complete pain relief within 12 hours in 57% of patients (vs. 17% controls) and within 24 hours in 100% (vs. 52% controls), enabling hospital discharge after 3 days vs. only 22% of controls by day 5.<sup data-ref="619">619</sup>, <sup data-ref="620">620</sup>
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）还可治疗多种常规疗法难以治愈的疼痛类型。例如，大量证据和众多读者反馈 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> 表明，DMSO可缓解癌症骨转移引起的疼痛。 <sup>1</sup> 同样， 在一项针对21例急性酒精性胰腺炎患者的临床研究中，经直肠给药的二甲基亚砜（每8小时500毫克）使57%的患者在12小时内完全缓解疼痛（对照组为17%），100%的患者在24小时内完全缓解（对照组为52%），使患者能在3天后出院，而对照组中仅有22%的患者能在第5天出院。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup>

content.en: Likewise, one author reported DMSO treating challenging phantom limb pain,<sup data-ref="621">621</sup> and readers here have as well,<sup data-ref="622">622</sup>, <sup data-ref="623">623</sup>, <sup data-ref="624">624</sup> including a wheelchair-confined amputee (due to previous strokes and vascular issues) who had a complete resolution of the pain.<sup data-ref="622">622</sup> Similarly, DMSO has been consistently observed to treat the severe neuropathic pain quadraplegics frequently experience (which is why Jackson’s mother felt it was so noteworthy he did not need to take any pain medications).
content.cn: 同样，有位作者曾报道二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可治疗顽固性幻肢痛， <sup>1</sup> 本专栏的读者也有类似反馈， <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> 其中包括一位因既往中风和血管问题而不得不依靠轮椅生活的截肢者，其疼痛症状已完全消失。 <sup>1</sup> 同样，研究一致表明，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可治疗四肢瘫痪患者常出现的严重神经病理性疼痛（这也正是杰克逊的母亲认为他无需服用任何止痛药这一事实如此值得注意的原因）。

content.en: Readers have also reported that DMSO was the only thing that helped other challenging types of pain, such as from polymyalgia,<sup data-ref="625">625</sup> horrific gadolinium-induced bone pain,<sup data-ref="626">626</sup> or EDS (hypermobility),<sup data-ref="627">627</sup>, <sup data-ref="628">628</sup>, <sup data-ref="282">282</sup> with one reader sharing DMSO “Gives me a chance to feel what “normal” might be like.” <sup data-ref="627">627</sup>
content.cn: 读者们还反映，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）是唯一能缓解其他顽固性疼痛的方法，例如多肌痛、 <sup>1</sup> 由钆引起的剧烈骨痛、 <sup>1</sup> 或Ehlers-Danlos综合征（关节过度活动症）， <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> 其中一位读者分享道，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）“让我有机会体验一下‘正常’的感觉。” <sup>1</sup>

content.en: Clinical pain data
content.cn: 临床疼痛数据

content.en: DMSO has been used clinically for a variety of neuropathic pain conditions, most extensively, as mentioned above for complex regional pain syndrome. Additionally:
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）已在临床上用于治疗多种神经病理性疼痛，其中应用最广泛的是如上所述的复杂性区域疼痛综合征。此外：

content.en: •In one study of patients with peripheral neuritis and segmental neuralgia, DMSO gave 66% a full remission and 22% a partial remission.<sup data-ref="294">294</sup>
content.cn: •在一项针对周围神经炎和节段性神经痛患者的研究中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）使66%的患者达到完全缓解，22%的患者达到部分缓解。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: •In another study, DMSO was used to treat glossalgia (burning tongue syndrome).<sup data-ref="629">629</sup>
content.cn: •在另一项研究中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）被用于治疗舌痛症（灼舌综合征）。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: •DMSO applications are widely recommended across Russian clinical guidelines for neuralgia and neuropathic conditions, where its mechanisms are described as including inactivation of hydroxyl radicals, improvement of metabolic processes at inflammation sites, reduction of excitatory impulse conduction in peripheral neurons, and moderate fibrinolytic activity, while simultaneously enhancing the penetration of analgesic and anti-inflammatory drugs.<sup data-ref="630">630</sup>, <sup data-ref="631">631</sup>
content.cn: •在俄罗斯关于神经痛和神经病变的临床指南中，广泛推荐使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）。指南中描述其作用机制包括：惰化羟基自由基、改善炎症部位的代谢过程、减少外周神经元中兴奋性冲动的传导，以及具有适度的纤溶活性，同时还能增强镇痛药和抗炎药的渗透性。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup>

content.en: Finally, DMSO is generally more effective for treating pain above the waist and is less likely to help larger joints (e.g., the hips, which have the smallest response—although many readers have still reported benefit there). In chronic pain patients who do not respond to topical DMSO, a lower concentration of injectable DMSO or oral DMSO often helps. In some cases, it can take weeks for chronic pain to improve, and it has been noted that for some chronic pain patients, periodic breaks (e.g., 1-2 days a week) are needed to avoid developing a tolerance to DMSO.
content.cn: 最后，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）通常对治疗腰部以上的疼痛更有效，而对较大关节（例如髋关节，其反应最为微弱——尽管仍有许多读者报告称该部位也获得了改善）的帮助较小。 对于对局部外用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）无反应的慢性疼痛患者，低浓度的注射用二甲基亚砜或口服二甲基亚砜通常能起到帮助作用。在某些情况下，慢性疼痛的改善可能需要数周时间，且有研究指出，部分慢性疼痛患者需要定期停用（例如每周停用1-2天），以避免对二甲基亚砜产生耐受性。

content.en: Reader Reports (Nerve Pain)
content.cn: 读者反馈（神经痛）

content.en: Readers, in turn, report DMSO relieving nerve pain from a wide variety of causes. Several described immediate or near-immediate relief: “Just started DMSO. It’s relieving chronic nerve pain,” <sup data-ref="632">632</sup> “It works for me for nerve pain,” <sup data-ref="633">633</sup> and a reader with nerve damage from a bad wreck 10 years ago found significant relief.<sup data-ref="634">634</sup> One with a pinched nerve and bursitis reported “instant relief,” <sup data-ref="364">364</sup>, <sup data-ref="347">347</sup> while a nurse with a post-surgical pinched nerve from an ankle repair found “pain was gone” overnight after combining DMSO with magnesium.<sup data-ref="635">635</sup>
content.cn: 读者们则纷纷反馈，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能缓解由多种原因引起的神经痛。有几位读者描述了立竿见影或几乎立竿见影的缓解效果：“刚开始用DMSO，它正在缓解我的慢性神经痛”， <sup>1</sup> “对我来说，它对神经痛很有效”， <sup>1</sup> 还有一位因10年前严重车祸导致神经受损的读者也感到症状显著缓解。 <sup>1</sup> 一位患有神经受压和滑囊炎的读者报告说“疼痛瞬间缓解”， <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 而一位因脚踝修复手术后出现神经受压的护士发现，在将二甲基亚砜与镁结合使用后，疼痛一夜之间“消失了”。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: Post-Surgical Nerve Damage
content.cn: 术后神经损伤

content.en: Readers with post-surgical nerve damage reported nerve regeneration over time. A reader who lost all feeling in the back of the left arm after a 2003 lumpectomy started using DMSO on the arm: “feeling is returning. Great improvement.” <sup data-ref="484">484</sup> Another with nerve damage from ankle surgery hardware found DMSO helpful, and after hardware removal, continued using it for residual nerve effects.<sup data-ref="636">636</sup> One reader’s nerve pain from ankle surgery (six years prior) responded the first night of topical DMSO application.<sup data-ref="637">637</sup> A reader who had lymph nodes removed under the arm for breast cancer and was left with complete numbness found that after four DMSO applications, feeling returned: “I could not shave my armpit without a mirror as I could not feel anything and last night, shaving with feeling.” <sup data-ref="638">638</sup> Another with 15 years of numbness and a persistent weeping wound from a surgical incision found “both issues resolved very quickly” with DMSO.<sup data-ref="639">639</sup>
content.cn: 有术后神经损伤的读者报告称，随着时间推移，神经逐渐再生。一位读者在2003年接受乳房肿块切除术后，左臂后侧完全丧失知觉，开始在手臂上使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）：“感觉正在恢复。改善很大。” <sup>1</sup> 另一位因踝关节手术植入的金属固定装置导致神经损伤的读者发现DMSO很有帮助，在取出金属固定装置后，仍继续使用它来缓解残留的神经症状。 <sup>1</sup> 一位读者因踝关节手术（六年前）导致的神经疼痛，在使用DMSO外敷的第一晚就得到了缓解。 <sup>1</sup> 另一位因乳腺癌接受腋下淋巴结切除术后出现完全麻木的读者发现，在连续使用四次DMSO后，感觉恢复了： “之前我完全感觉不到腋下，没有镜子根本无法剃毛，但昨晚剃毛时已经能感觉到触感了。” <sup>1</sup> 还有一位读者，因手术切口导致长达15年的麻木和持续渗液的伤口，发现使用DMSO后“这两个问题都很快得到了解决”。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: Post-Joint-Replacement Nerve Pain
content.cn: 关节置换术后的神经痛

content.en: Two readers reported DMSO resolving electrical pins-and-needles sensations at shoulder replacement sites. One applied DMSO along the scar “and the electrical pins and needles sensation has not returned,” <sup data-ref="640">640</sup> while another “put it there once and it went away.” <sup data-ref="641">641</sup>
content.cn: 有两位读者反映，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）缓解了肩关节置换术后部位出现的刺痛感。其中一位在疤痕处涂抹了DMSO，“刺痛感便再也没有出现过”， <sup>1</sup> 而另一位则表示“只涂了一次，症状就消失了”。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: Burning Pain
content.cn: 灼痛

content.en: A reader’s mother with burning feet “swears by” DMSO for pain relief and has used it for years.<sup data-ref="642">642</sup> Another with burning wrist pain found DMSO “mostly taken care of it.” <sup data-ref="643">643</sup> An aircraft mechanic with severe neuropathic pain ("like an electrical shock on fire") in his palm and thumb applied DMSO topically once; the pain resolved and had not recurred over a year later despite continued daily manual work.<sup data-ref="644">644</sup>
content.cn: 一位读者的母亲因脚部灼痛而“对DMSO赞不绝口”，并已使用多年。 <sup>1</sup> 另一位手腕有灼痛感的读者发现，二甲基亚砜“基本解决了这个问题”。 <sup>1</sup> 一位飞机维修技师的手掌和拇指曾有严重的神经病理性疼痛（“就像被电击又像着火一样”），他局部涂抹了一次二甲基亚砜；疼痛随即消失，尽管之后一年多他每天仍在进行体力劳动，但疼痛再未复发。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en:
Additional readers reported relief from pinched nerves,<sup data-ref="645">645</sup>, <sup data-ref="646">646</sup>, <sup data-ref="647">647</sup>, <sup data-ref="648">648</sup>, <sup data-ref="364">364</sup>, <sup data-ref="347">347</sup>, <sup data-ref="649">649</sup>, <sup data-ref="650">650</sup>, <sup data-ref="651">651</sup>, <sup data-ref="652">652</sup> muscle overuse,<sup data-ref="505">505</sup> and neuropathic (nerve) pain of unspecified cause,<sup data-ref="653">653</sup>, <sup data-ref="648">648</sup>, <sup data-ref="654">654</sup>, <sup data-ref="655">655</sup>, <sup data-ref="656">656</sup>, <sup data-ref="657">657</sup>, <sup data-ref="658">658</sup>, <sup data-ref="659">659</sup>, <sup data-ref="660">660</sup>,  <sup data-ref="661">661</sup>, <sup data-ref="662">662</sup>, <sup data-ref="663">663</sup>, <sup data-ref="664">664</sup>, <sup data-ref="665">665</sup>, <sup data-ref="666">666</sup>, <sup data-ref="667">667</sup>, <sup data-ref="668">668</sup>, <sup data-ref="669">669</sup>, <sup data-ref="670">670</sup>,  <sup data-ref="671">671</sup>, <sup data-ref="672">672</sup>, <sup data-ref="673">673</sup>, <sup data-ref="674">674</sup>, <sup data-ref="675">675</sup>, <sup data-ref="676">676</sup>, <sup data-ref="677">677</sup>, <sup data-ref="678">678</sup>, <sup data-ref="679">679</sup>, <sup data-ref="680">680</sup>,  <sup data-ref="681">681</sup>, <sup data-ref="682">682</sup>, <sup data-ref="683">683</sup>, <sup data-ref="684">684</sup>, <sup data-ref="685">685</sup>, <sup data-ref="652">652</sup>, <sup data-ref="686">686</sup>, <sup data-ref="687">687</sup>, <sup data-ref="687">687</sup>, <sup data-ref="492">492</sup>, <sup data-ref="480">480</sup> with many noting that nerve pain was particularly responsive to DMSO compared to other types of pain.<sup data-ref="688">688</sup>, <sup data-ref="667">667</sup>  
还有读者反映，该产品缓解了神经受压、 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> <sup>5</sup> <sup>6</sup> <sup>7</sup> <sup>8</sup> <sup>9</sup> <sup>10</sup> 肌肉过度使用、 <sup>1</sup> 以及原因不明的神经病理性（神经）疼痛， <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> <sup>5</sup> <sup>6</sup> <sup>7</sup> <sup>8</sup> <sup>10</sup> ,  <sup>11</sup> <sup>12</sup> <sup>13</sup> <sup>14</sup> <sup>15</sup> <sup>16</sup> <sup>17</sup> <sup>18</sup> <sup>19</sup> <sup>20</sup> <sup>21</sup> <sup>22</sup> <sup>23</sup> <sup>24</sup> <sup>25</sup> <sup>26</sup> <sup>27</sup> <sup>28</sup> <sup>29</sup> <sup>30</sup> ,  <sup>31</sup> <sup>32</sup> <sup>33</sup> <sup>34</sup> <sup>35</sup> <sup>36</sup> <sup>37</sup> <sup>38</sup> <sup>39</sup> <sup>40</sup> <sup>41</sup> 许多人指出，与其他类型的疼痛相比，神经痛对二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的反应尤为显著。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup>
content.cn: 注：一位患有“神秘”感觉障碍（全身灼热和麻木持续9个月，所有检查结果均为阴性）的读者发现，外用70%二甲基亚砜（DMSO）仅能带来暂时性改善，这表明更深层或更具全身性的神经系统疾病可能需要口服或静脉注射治疗。 <sup data-ref="688">688</sup>*

content.en: *Note: one reader with a “mysterious” sensory issue (burning and numbness throughout the body for 9 months, all tests negative) found only temporary improvement from topical 70% DMSO, suggesting that deeper or more systemic neurological conditions may require oral or IV administration.<sup data-ref="486">486</sup>
Spinal Pain
content.cn: 脊柱疼痛

content.en: Nerve pain from a spinal issue (e.g., nerve root compressions and radiculopathies) is highly responsive to DMSO, with hundreds of studies and reader reports attesting to this. This extensive body of evidence is detailed in [the previous article](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-heals-the-spine-and-reverses) (which can be read [here](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-heals-the-spine-and-reverses)).
content.cn: 由脊柱问题引起的神经痛（例如神经根受压和神经根病变）对二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的反应极佳，已有数百项研究和读者报告对此予以证实。这大量证据的详细内容已在上一篇文章中阐述（可点击此处阅读）。

content.en: Combination Studies in Neuropathic Pain Models
content.cn: 神经病理性疼痛模型中的联合研究

content.en: A large number of therapeutic agents dissolved in DMSO have demonstrated efficacy across various neuropathic pain models. For example, [one study found](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/10490883/) that DMSO co-administration with the cannabinoid analgesic CT-3 (which alone produced dose-dependent analgesia comparable to morphine without GI ulceration) reduced analgesia while increasing both toxicity and ulceration.
content.cn: 大量溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的治疗药物已在多种神经病理性疼痛模型中显示出疗效。例如，一项研究发现，将DMSO与大麻素类镇痛药CT-3（该药物单独使用时可产生与吗啡相当的剂量依赖性镇痛效果，且不会引起胃肠道溃疡）联合给药，不仅降低了镇痛效果，还同时增加了毒性和溃疡发生率。

content.en: Since DMSO served as the vehicle control in these studies, the agents’ benefits are measured against DMSO’s own baseline analgesic properties, meaning the actual therapeutic gap between treatment and no treatment is likely larger than these studies report. For example, in one study using DMSO as the vehicle for the A3 adenosine receptor agonist IB-MECA, the DMSO vehicle control group showed full reversal of mechanical allodynia in CCI rats, an effect the authors **did not comment on** but which is consistent with DMSO’s independent analgesic properties.<sup data-ref="689">689</sup>
content.cn: 由于在这些研究中DMSO被用作溶剂对照组，因此这些药物的疗效是相对于DMSO本身的基线镇痛特性来衡量的，这意味着治疗组与未治疗组之间的实际治疗差距很可能比这些研究报告的要大。 例如，在一项将二甲基亚砜用作A3腺苷受体激动剂IB-MECA载体的研究中，二甲基亚砜载体对照组显示出CCI大鼠机械性异痛症的完全逆转，尽管作者未对此效果进行评论，但这与二甲基亚砜的独立镇痛特性是一致的。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: *Note: one reader cautioned against using DMSO to “transport” CBD cream: “You’ll get hit with a sledgehammer that will make you question life itself.” <sup data-ref="690">690</sup> This is consistent with DMSO’s known ability to dramatically enhance the absorption and potency of topical agents, and readers should be aware that combining DMSO with other active topical substances (including CBD, essential oils, and capsaicin) may produce effects far stronger than either alone. Conversely, topical WIN 55,212-2 (a cannabinoid agonist) enhanced topical morphine analgesia via CB1 receptor mechanisms,<sup data-ref="691">691</sup> and DMSO combined with anandamide <sup>⬖</sup> (an endogenous cannabinoid) also effectively reduced pain,<sup data-ref="692">692</sup> suggesting cannabinoid-DMSO-opioid combinations can be synergistic when properly dosed.
content.cn: 注：有位读者提醒不要使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）来“输送”CBD乳霜：“你会像被大锤狠狠砸中一样，甚至会让你对生命本身产生怀疑。” <sup>1</sup> 这与二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能显著增强外用制剂吸收率和效力的已知特性相符，读者应注意，将DMSO与其他外用活性物质（包括CBD、精油和辣椒素）结合使用，可能产生远强于单独使用任何一种物质的效果。 相反，外用WIN 55,212-2（一种大麻素激动剂）通过CB1受体机制增强了外用吗啡的镇痛效果， <sup>1</sup> 而二甲基亚砜与阿南达米德 <sup>⬖</sup> （一种内源性大麻素）的组合也有效缓解了疼痛， <sup>1</sup> 这表明，在剂量适当的情况下，大麻素-二甲基亚砜-阿片类药物组合可产生协同作用。*

content.en: Common Neuropathic Pain Combinations
content.cn: 常见的神经病理性疼痛联合用药方案

content.en: Curcumin <sup>⬖</sup> is the most extensively studied natural agent for neuropathic pain in combination with DMSO. Across CCI models, intrathecal and intraperitoneal curcumin <sup>⬖</sup> repeatedly improved mechanical and thermal pain thresholds through multiple pathways: upregulating cannabinoid receptor 1 while downregulating NMDAR2B, inhibiting the inflammatory TLR4/TNF-α/IL-1β cascade, suppressing TAK1-mediated astrocyte activation, and inhibiting spinal microglial inflammation.<sup data-ref="693">693</sup>, <sup data-ref="694">694</sup>, <sup data-ref="695">695</sup>, <sup data-ref="696">696</sup> In spared nerve injury models, curcumin <sup>⬖</sup> achieved analgesic effects comparable to pregabalin (likely through reduced CCL2 expression in dorsal root ganglia) and suppressed spinal p38 driven inflammatory cytokine signaling.<sup data-ref="697">697</sup>, <sup data-ref="698">698</sup> With forced exercise, curcumin <sup>⬖</sup> prevented peripheral nerve conduction deficits in CCI rats,<sup data-ref="699">699</sup> and in diabetic neuropathic pain, attenuated mechanical allodynia with the opioid system implicated in its mechanism.<sup data-ref="700">700</sup>
content.cn: 姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 是目前研究最为广泛的一种与二甲基亚砜（DMSO）联合用于治疗神经病理性疼痛的天然活性物质。 在各种CCI模型中，鞘内和腹腔注射姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 通过多种途径反复提高了机械痛阈和热痛阈：上调大麻素受体1的同时下调NMDAR2B，抑制炎症性TLR4/TNF-α/IL-1β级联反应，抑制TAK1介导的星形胶质细胞活化，并抑制脊髓小胶质细胞炎症。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> 在保留神经损伤模型中，姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 实现了与普瑞巴林相当的镇痛效果（可能通过降低背根神经节中CCL2的表达），并抑制了脊髓中由p38驱动的炎症细胞因子信号传导。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 在强制运动条件下，姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 预防了CCI大鼠的外周神经传导功能障碍， <sup>1</sup> 并在糖尿病神经病理性疼痛中减轻了机械性异痛症，其作用机制与阿片系统有关。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: Resveratrol <sup>⬖</sup> combinations also showed consistent benefits across neuropathic pain models. In CCI rats, intrathecal resveratrol <sup>⬖</sup> attenuated thermal hyperalgesia by activating anti-inflammatory SIRT1 and reducing inflammatory acetylated NF-κB, while intracerebroventricular delivery inhibited hippocampal astrocyte activation and NF-κB expression (demonstrating that neuropathic pain involves supraspinal neuroinflammation amenable to treatment).<sup data-ref="701">701</sup>, <sup data-ref="702">702</sup>, <sup data-ref="703">703</sup> In paclitaxel-induced neuropathy, resveratrol <sup>⬖</sup> increased spinal SIRT1 and improved mechanical pain thresholds.<sup data-ref="704">704</sup> Sulforaphane <sup>⬖</sup> and resveratrol <sup>⬖</sup> together produced synergistic analgesia in an orofacial formalin pain model at doses lower than either agent alone required for equivalent effect.<sup data-ref="705">705</sup>
content.cn: 白藜芦醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 复方制剂在各种神经病理性疼痛模型中也表现出一致的疗效。 在CCI大鼠模型中，鞘内给药的白藜芦醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 通过激活抗炎因子SIRT1并降低炎症性乙酰化NF-κB，从而减轻了热痛觉过敏；而脑室给药则抑制了海马区星形胶质细胞的活化和NF-κB的表达（这表明神经病理性疼痛涉及可治疗的脊髓上段神经炎症）。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> 在紫杉醇诱导的神经病变中，白藜芦醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 增加了脊髓中的 SIRT1 水平，并提高了机械痛阈值。 <sup>1</sup> 在口面部福尔马林疼痛模型中，硫代葡萄糖苷 <sup>⬖</sup> 与白藜芦醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 联合使用时，其镇痛作用呈现协同效应，且所需剂量低于单独使用任一药物达到同等效果所需的剂量。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en:
Numerous p38 MAPK inhibitors reduced neuropathic pain across virtually every model tested, including CCI (reducing P2X7 and P2Y13 receptor expression, suppressing COX-2, and inhibiting microglial inflammation),<sup data-ref="706">706</sup>, <sup data-ref="707">707</sup>, <sup data-ref="708">708</sup>, <sup data-ref="709">709</sup> spinal nerve ligation (attenuating allodynia and hyperalgesia both preventively and in established pain),<sup data-ref="710">710</sup> ventral rhizotomy,<sup data-ref="710">710</sup> diabetic neuropathy (alleviating hyperalgesia and reducing P2X7/TRPV1/PKCε signaling),<sup data-ref="711">711</sup>, <sup data-ref="712">712</sup> and nucleus pulposus-induced radicular pain.<sup data-ref="713">713</sup> One, licochalcone A <sup>⬖</sup> achieved comparable p38/NF-κB inhibition and microglial suppression in CCI rats.<sup data-ref="707">707</sup>  
多种p38 MAPK抑制剂在几乎所有测试模型中均减轻了神经病理性疼痛，包括CCI模型（通过降低P2X7和P2Y13受体的表达、抑制COX-2以及抑制小胶质细胞炎症）， <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> 脊神经结扎（在预防阶段和已确立的疼痛阶段均可减轻异痛症和痛觉过敏）， <sup>1</sup> 腹侧根切断术、 <sup>1</sup> 糖尿病神经病变（缓解痛觉过敏并降低P2X7/TRPV1/PKCε信号传导）、 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 以及髓核诱发的神经根痛。 <sup>1</sup> 其中，甘草查尔酮A <sup>⬖</sup> 在CCI大鼠模型中实现了与之相当的p38/NF-κB抑制作用及小胶质细胞抑制作用。 <sup>1</sup>
CCI (chronic constriction injury) modelsCCI（
content.cn: 慢性压迫性损伤）模型

content.en: Among natural compounds, 1,8-cineole <sup>⬖</sup> (the primary component of eucalyptus oil) dose-dependently alleviated neuropathic pain and inhibited P2X3 and P2X2 receptor overexpression in dorsal root ganglia and spinal cord across three studies.<sup data-ref="714">714</sup>, <sup data-ref="715">715</sup>, <sup data-ref="716">716</sup> Cardamonin <sup>⬖</sup> exerted antiallodynic and antihyperalgesic effects (counteracting excessive sensitivity to pain) comparable or superior to amitriptyline through central and peripheral opioidergic system activation.<sup data-ref="717">717</sup> Additional natural agents improving pain thresholds in CCI models include astragalin <sup>⬖</sup> (which inhibited P2X4/ERK1/2/TNF-R1 signaling and glial activation),<sup data-ref="718">718</sup> luteolin <sup>⬖</sup> (via the sirt1/FOXO1 pathway),<sup data-ref="719">719</sup> carnosic acid <sup>⬖</sup> (via Sirt1/p66shc),<sup data-ref="720">720</sup> and tetramethylpyrazine <sup>⬖</sup> (which dose-dependently inhibited non-L-type calcium currents in dorsal root ganglion neurons).<sup data-ref="721">721</sup> Silymarin <sup>⬖</sup> produced significant antinociception with a favorable safety profile and low cost.<sup data-ref="722">722</sup> Cimifugin <sup>⬖</sup> (from Saposhnikovia) reduced formalin-induced flinch responses dose-dependently, with ED50 values of 696 μg for acute pain and 1,243 μg for inflammatory pain.<sup data-ref="723">723</sup>
content.cn: 在天然化合物中，三项研究均表明，1,8-桉叶素 <sup>⬖</sup> （桉树油的主要成分）能以剂量依赖性方式缓解神经病理性疼痛，并抑制背根神经节和脊髓中P2X3和P2X2受体的过表达。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> 豆蔻酮 <sup>⬖</sup> 通过激活中枢和外周阿片能系统，发挥了与阿米替林相当或更优的抗异痛和抗痛觉过敏作用（抵消对疼痛的过度敏感）。 <sup>1</sup> 其他可在CCI模型中提高疼痛阈值的天然活性物质包括蒺藜素 <sup>⬖</sup> （其抑制了P2X4/ERK1/2/TNF-R1信号传导和胶质细胞活化）、 <sup>1</sup> 木犀草素 <sup>⬖</sup> （通过sirt1/FOXO1通路）， <sup>1</sup> 肉豆蔻酸 <sup>⬖</sup> （通过 Sirt1/p66shc 途径）， <sup>1</sup> 以及四甲基吡嗪 <sup>⬖</sup> （其以剂量依赖性方式抑制了背根神经节神经元中的非 L 型钙电流）。 <sup>1</sup> 水飞蓟素 <sup>⬖</sup> 具有显著的抗痛觉作用，且安全性良好、成本低廉。 <sup>1</sup> 西米福金 <sup>⬖</sup> （源自沙棘）以剂量依赖性方式减轻了福尔马林诱导的畏缩反应，其ED50值在急性疼痛中为696 μg，在炎症性疼痛中为1,243 μg。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: CB2 receptor agonists (AM1241) consistently improved mechanical and thermal thresholds in CCI rats across multiple studies, operating through suppression of purinergic receptor signaling (P2X4, P2X7, P2Y12, P2Y13), p38 MAPK/NF-κB pathways, and BDNF, with microRNA-124-3p identified as a mediating mechanism.<sup data-ref="724">724</sup>, <sup data-ref="725">725</sup>, <sup data-ref="726">726</sup> The synthetic cannabinoid CP55940 similarly dose-dependently suppressed neuropathic pain through CB1 and CB2 receptor activation, inhibiting PKA upregulation, reducing P2X2R and P2X3R expression in dorsal root ganglia, and suppressing intracellular calcium increases in cultured DRG neurons.<sup data-ref="727">727</sup>, <sup data-ref="728">728</sup>, <sup data-ref="729">729</sup>, <sup data-ref="730">730</sup>
content.cn: 多项研究表明，CB2受体激动剂（AM1241）能持续提高CCI大鼠的机械痛阈和热痛阈，其作用机制在于抑制嘌呤能受体信号传导（P2X4、P2X7、P2Y12、P2Y13）、p38 MAPK/NF-κB信号通路以及脑源性神经营养因子（BDNF），其中微RNA-124-3p被确认为其介导机制。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> 合成大麻素CP55940同样通过激活CB1和CB2受体，以剂量依赖性方式抑制神经病理性疼痛，其作用机制包括抑制PKA上调、降低背根神经节中P2X2R和P2X3R的表达，以及抑制培养的背根神经节神经元中细胞内钙浓度的升高。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup>

content.en: Riluzole attenuated mechanical allodynia and induced long-term depression of C and Aδ fiber-evoked excitatory postsynaptic currents in spinal dorsal horn neurons, while also downregulating P2X7 receptor expression and inhibiting microglial activation through a mechanism distinct from sodium channel blockade.<sup data-ref="731">731</sup>, <sup data-ref="732">732</sup>, <sup data-ref="733">733</sup> Necrostatin-1 improved mechanical and thermal thresholds by inhibiting the RIP1/RIP3/MLKL necroptosis pathway and reducing IL-1β, TNF-α, and IL-6.<sup data-ref="734">734</sup>
content.cn: 利鲁唑减轻了机械性异痛，并诱导了脊髓背角神经元中C纤维和Aδ纤维诱发的兴奋性突触后电流的长期抑制，同时通过一种与钠通道阻断不同的机制下调了P2X7受体的表达并抑制了小胶质细胞的活化。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> 奈克罗司汀-1 通过抑制 RIP1/RIP3/MLKL 坏死性凋亡通路并降低 IL-1β、TNF-α 和 IL-6 的水平，提高了机械和热痛阈值。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: Additional pharmaceutical agents showing analgesic effects in CCI models include an ERK1/2 inhibitor (U0126, which attenuated neuropathic pain and VEGF/ERK/CREB signaling across multiple studies),<sup data-ref="735">735</sup>, <sup data-ref="736">736</sup>, <sup data-ref="737">737</sup>, <sup data-ref="738">738</sup>, <sup data-ref="739">739</sup> an aquaporin 4 inhibitor (TGN-020, which inhibited ERK/JNK/p38 MAPK signaling),<sup data-ref="740">740</sup>, <sup data-ref="741">741</sup> a Sigma-1 receptor antagonist (BD-1047, which modulated P2X3 receptor co-expression in DRG neurons),<sup data-ref="742">742</sup> wortmannin (which alleviated pain via PI3K/Akt/mTOR pathway inhibition and microglial suppression),<sup data-ref="743">743</sup> a caspase-1 inhibitor (VX-765, which reduced spinal NLRP1 and IL-1β),<sup data-ref="744">744</sup> and a monocarboxylate transporter inhibitor (4-CIN, which completely prevented neuropathic pain development).<sup data-ref="745">745</sup> Additional agents reducing pain thresholds through glial or inflammatory suppression include a GSK3β inhibitor and eIF2α agonist (reduced ER stress in DRG),<sup data-ref="746">746</sup> a STAT3 inhibitor (WP1066),<sup data-ref="747">747</sup> pioglitazone (suppressed astrocyte activation and inflammatory cytokines via PPARγ),<sup data-ref="748">748</sup> roscovitine (a CDK5 inhibitor that suppressed astrocyte activation),<sup data-ref="749">749</sup> a PKCε inhibitor (BIM I, which reduced astrocyte-mediated central pain sensitization),<sup data-ref="750">750</sup> a MIF antagonist (ISO-1, which suppressed TNF-α and IL-1β in DRG),<sup data-ref="751">751</sup> a GABA transporter 3 inhibitor (transiently improved pain thresholds by targeting GAT3 upregulation in DRG),<sup data-ref="752">752</sup> liproxstatin-1 (mitigated ferroptosis in DRG Schwann cells and astrocytes),<sup data-ref="753">753</sup> a HO-1 agonist (cobalt protoporphyrin IX, which increased μ-opioid receptor expression),<sup data-ref="754">754</sup> astaxanthin <sup>⬖</sup> (elevated HO-1 and antioxidant enzymes while reducing inflammatory cytokines),<sup data-ref="755">755</sup> a CB1 agonist (AM841),<sup data-ref="756">756</sup> PKA/CaMKII/HCN4 pathway inhibitors,<sup data-ref="757">757</sup> dual σ1/μ opioid receptor small molecules,<sup data-ref="758">758</sup> a PKC inhibitor (which reduced P2X3R expression),<sup data-ref="759">759</sup> and triptolide <sup>⬖</sup> (which suppressed T cell activation and spinal inflammation without motor dysfunction).<sup data-ref="760">760</sup>
content.cn: 在CCI模型中表现出镇痛作用的其他药物还包括一种ERK1/2抑制剂（U0126，多项研究表明其可减轻神经病理性疼痛并抑制VEGF/ERK/CREB信号传导）， <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> <sup>5</sup> 一种水通道蛋白4抑制剂（TGN-020，该药物抑制了ERK/JNK/p38 MAPK信号通路）， <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 一种Sigma-1受体拮抗剂（BD-1047，可调节DRG神经元中P2X3受体的共表达）， <sup>1</sup> 沃特曼宁（通过抑制PI3K/Akt/mTOR通路及抑制小胶质细胞活性来缓解疼痛）， <sup>1</sup> 一种caspase-1抑制剂（VX-765，可降低脊髓中NLRP1和IL-1β的水平）， <sup>1</sup> 以及一种单羧酸转运体抑制剂（4-CIN，可完全阻止神经病理性疼痛的发生）。 <sup>1</sup> 其他通过抑制胶质细胞或炎症反应来降低疼痛阈值的药物包括一种GSK3β抑制剂和一种eIF2α激动剂（可减轻DRG中的内质网应激）、 <sup>1</sup> 一种STAT3抑制剂（WP1066）、 <sup>1</sup> 吡格列酮（通过PPARγ抑制星形胶质细胞活化和炎症细胞因子）， <sup>1</sup> 罗斯科维汀（一种抑制星形胶质细胞活化的CDK5抑制剂）， <sup>1</sup> 一种PKCε抑制剂（BIM I，可减轻星形胶质细胞介导的中枢疼痛敏感化）， <sup>1</sup> 一种MIF拮抗剂（ISO-1，可抑制DRG中的TNF-α和IL-1β）， <sup>1</sup> 一种GABA转运蛋白3抑制剂（通过靶向DRG中GAT3的上调，暂时提高了疼痛阈值）， <sup>1</sup> 利普罗克司他汀-1（减轻了DRG施万细胞和星形胶质细胞中的铁死亡）， <sup>1</sup> 一种HO-1激动剂（钴原卟啉IX，可增加μ-阿片受体的表达）， <sup>1</sup> 虾青素 <sup>⬖</sup> （在降低炎性细胞因子的同时，提高了HO-1和抗氧化酶的水平）， <sup>1</sup> 一种CB1激动剂（AM841）， <sup>1</sup> PKA/CaMKII/HCN4通路抑制剂， <sup>1</sup> 双重σ1/μ阿片受体小分子药物， <sup>1</sup> 一种PKC抑制剂（可降低P2X3R的表达）， <sup>1</sup> 以及三萜醇 <sup>⬖</sup> （可在不引起运动功能障碍的情况下抑制T细胞活化和脊髓炎症）。 <sup>1</sup>
