content.cn: 脊神经结扎）模型

content.en: Koumine <sup>⬖</sup> (from Gelsemium) dose-dependently reversed mechanical allodynia by acting as a positive allosteric modulator of the translocator protein (TSPO) on spinal astrocytes, stimulating pregnenolone and allopregnanolone production; in a separate study, its analgesic effect was mediated by upregulating spinal 3α-HSD expression, increasing local neurosteroid synthesis.<sup data-ref="761">761</sup>, <sup data-ref="762">762</sup> Sec-O-glucosylhamaudol <sup>⬖</sup> (from coastal hog fennel) alleviated mechanical allodynia by inhibiting the p38/JNK MAPK and NF-κB pathways and reducing autophagy, with antinociceptive effects reversed by naloxone (indicating μ-opioid receptor involvement).<sup data-ref="763">763</sup>, <sup data-ref="764">764</sup> Tetrahydropalmatine <sup>⬖</sup> significantly increased mechanical and thermal pain thresholds at medium and high doses.<sup data-ref="765">765</sup>
content.cn: 库敏 <sup>⬖</sup> （源自金丝桃）通过作为脊髓星形胶质细胞上转运蛋白（TSPO）的正向别构调节剂，刺激孕烯醇酮和异孕烯醇酮的生成，从而以剂量依赖性方式逆转了机械性异痛症； 在另一项研究中，其镇痛作用是通过上调脊髓中3α-羟基甾酮脱氢酶（3α-HSD）的表达，从而增加局部神经类固醇的合成来实现的。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> Sec-O-葡萄糖基哈马多尔 <sup>⬖</sup> （源自海岸猪茴香）通过抑制 p38/JNK MAPK 和 NF-κB 信号通路以及减少自噬来缓解机械性异痛症，其抗痛觉作用可被纳洛酮逆转（表明与 μ-阿片受体有关）。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 四氢帕马汀 <sup>⬖</sup> 在中、高剂量下显著提高了机械痛和热痛阈值。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: Rapamycin was the most extensively studied pharmaceutical agent in SNL models, consistently improving pain thresholds across five studies by enhancing spinal autophagy (increasing LC3-II and Beclin-1, decreasing p62), reducing neuronal apoptosis (decreasing caspase-3, increasing NeuN), and suppressing astrocyte activation (reducing GFAP). At the molecular level, rapamycin reduced mTOR/NR2B signaling, and autophagy activation reduced spinal IL-1β, TNF-α, and reactive oxygen species via the JNK/NF-κB pathway, with NRF2 partially mediating autophagy’s regulation of ROS. Conversely, the autophagy inhibitor 3-MA worsened pain behaviors and increased neuronal apoptosis.<sup data-ref="766">766</sup>, <sup data-ref="767">767</sup>, <sup data-ref="768">768</sup>, <sup data-ref="769">769</sup>, <sup data-ref="770">770</sup>
content.cn: 雷帕霉素是SNL模型中研究最为广泛的药物，在五项研究中均通过增强脊髓自噬（增加LC3-II和Beclin-1，减少p62）、减少神经元凋亡（减少caspase-3，增加NeuN）以及抑制星形胶质细胞活化（减少GFAP），持续提高了疼痛阈值。 在分子水平上，雷帕霉素可抑制mTOR/NR2B信号传导；自噬的激活通过JNK/NF-κB通路降低了脊髓中的IL-1β、TNF-α和活性氧（ROS）水平，其中NRF2部分介导了自噬对ROS的调节。相反，自噬抑制剂3-MA则加剧了疼痛行为并增加了神经元凋亡。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> <sup>5</sup>

content.en: Trichostatin A (TSA) and other HDAC inhibitors repeatedly attenuated mechanical allodynia in SNL and related models by reversing differential miRNA expression, upregulating BDNF, and modulating histone acetylation in the spinal cord.<sup data-ref="771">771</sup>, <sup data-ref="772">772</sup>, <sup data-ref="773">773</sup> Additional agents demonstrating efficacy in SNL models include a KDM6B inhibitor (GSK-J4, which epigenetically regulated IL-6 via H3K27me3 demethylation and STAT3 signaling),<sup data-ref="774">774</sup> a BRD4 inhibitor (I-BET762, which identified the miR-200a/c-myc/ROS axis as a regulatory mechanism),<sup data-ref="775">775</sup> a P2Y12 receptor antagonist (MRS2395, which suppressed P2X4 and p38 MAPK),<sup data-ref="776">776</sup> meloxicam (which prevented allodynia development when administered early after injury, supporting a role for COX-2 in neuropathic pain pathogenesis),<sup data-ref="777">777</sup> and an AKT inhibitor (which enhanced autophagy and provided analgesic effects by modulating the AKT/TSC2/mTOR pathway).<sup data-ref="778">778</sup> In bone cancer pain models, aspirin-triggered lipoxin significantly increased paw withdrawal threshold with analgesic duration exceeding equimolar morphine,<sup data-ref="779">779</sup> while [baicalein](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFDLAST2015&filename=1014446730.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=gKLtDQwwPuk3Of_k8-BUL-d0PuQg3ahN0AYY6k2if2tILo2gW5pr1Ra99YEzZwFP) <sup>⬖</sup> (attenuated mechanical allodynia; both reduced 5-lipoxygenase and p-JNK in the spinal cord).<sup data-ref="779">779</sup>
content.cn: 三羟基苯甲酸A（TSA）和其他组蛋白去乙酰化酶（HDAC）抑制剂通过逆转微RNA（miRNA）表达的差异、上调脑源性神经营养因子（BDNF）以及调节脊髓中组蛋白乙酰化，在SNL及相关模型中反复减轻了机械性异痛症。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> 在SNL模型中显示出疗效的其他药物还包括一种KDM6B抑制剂（GSK-J4，其通过H3K27me3去甲基化和STAT3信号传导对IL-6进行表观遗传调控）， <sup>1</sup> 一种BRD4抑制剂（I-BET762，其揭示了miR-200a/c-myc/ROS轴作为调控机制）， <sup>1</sup> 一种P2Y12受体拮抗剂（MRS2395，其抑制了P2X4和p38 MAPK）， <sup>1</sup> 美洛昔康（在损伤后早期给药可预防异痛症的发生，支持COX-2在神经病理性疼痛发病机制中的作用）， <sup>1</sup> 以及一种AKT抑制剂（通过调节AKT/TSC2/mTOR通路增强自噬并产生镇痛效应）。 <sup>1</sup> 在骨癌疼痛模型中，阿司匹林诱导的脂氧素显著提高了足部撤回阈值，其镇痛持续时间超过了等摩尔量的吗啡， <sup>1</sup> 而黄芩素 <sup>⬖</sup> （减轻了机械性异痛症；两者均降低了脊髓中的5-脂氧合酶和p-JNK水平）。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: *Note: garcinol (a p300 acetyltransferase inhibitor) reduced thermal hyperalgesia and suppressed NF-κB pathway activation via reduced p300-mediated acetylation of p65 in SNL rats.<sup data-ref="780">780</sup>, <sup data-ref="781">781</sup> A TRPM8 blocker (AMTB) reversed both cold hyperalgesia and mechanical hyperalgesia in SNI rats while simultaneously restoring scratching behavior suppressed by nerve injury, revealing that neuropathic pain and itch share overlapping spinal mechanisms.<sup data-ref="782">782</sup> Among agents combined with DMSO for spinal nerve injury models,* *[a TSPO agonist](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2015&filename=ZTYZ201505009&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=f3eduwCM3imWhwBLU5f9a8Orjk-dobJCTbV3zcg_zDyfZrRUwOQ_SNMmIfnEFgok)* *(Ro5-4864) reduced spinal astrocyte activation (GFAP) and TNF-α for up to 21 days after nerve injury,<sup data-ref="783">783</sup>* *tetramethylpyrazine <sup>⬖</sup> inhibited non-L-type calcium currents in dorsal root ganglion neurons,<sup data-ref="721">721</sup>* *a p38 MAPK inhibitor* *reduced spinal p-p38 and serum IL-6 while upregulating glucocorticoid receptors,<sup data-ref="784">784</sup> and* *rufinamide* *selectively suppressed C-fiber (but not Aδ-fiber) excitatory transmission in spinal substantia gelatinosa neurons.<sup data-ref="785">785</sup>*
content.cn: 注：加尔西诺尔（一种p300乙酰转移酶抑制剂）通过减少p300介导的p65乙酰化，减轻了SNL大鼠的热痛觉过敏，并抑制了NF-κB通路的激活。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 一种 TRPM8 拮抗剂（AMTB）不仅逆转了 SNI 大鼠的冷痛觉过敏和机械痛觉过敏，同时还恢复了因神经损伤而受抑制的抓挠行为，这表明神经病理性疼痛和瘙痒在脊髓中具有重叠的机制。 <sup>1</sup> 在与二甲基亚砜（DMSO）联合用于脊髓神经损伤模型的药物中，一种TSPO激动剂（Ro5-4864）在神经损伤后长达21天内降低了脊髓星形胶质细胞的活化（GFAP）和TNF-α水平， <sup>1</sup> 四甲基吡嗪 <sup>⬖</sup> 抑制了背根神经节神经元中的非L型钙电流， <sup>1</sup> 一种p38 MAPK抑制剂在降低脊髓p-p38和血清IL-6水平的同时，上调了糖皮质激素受体， <sup>1</sup> 而鲁菲那米德则选择性地抑制了脊髓胶质质神经元中C纤维（但不抑制Aδ纤维）的兴奋性传导。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: SNI (spared nerve injury) modelsSNI（
content.cn: 保留神经损伤）模型

content.en: In addition to the curcumin <sup>⬖</sup> and p38 inhibitor studies described above, agents improving pain thresholds in SNI models include protectin D1 (which dose-dependently increased paw withdrawal threshold via PPARγ activation while reducing TNF-α and IL-6),<sup data-ref="786">786</sup> bardoxolone methyl (an Nrf2 activator),<sup data-ref="787">787</sup> memantine (which dose-dependently attenuated mechanical hyperalgesia and allodynia via NMDA open-channel blockade at clinically tolerable doses without motor deficits often seen with this medication class),<sup data-ref="788">788</sup> and intrathecal modulators of nNOS phosphorylation sites (identifying CaMKII and Akt as key regulators of nitric oxide-mediated neuropathic pain).<sup data-ref="789">789</sup> A D2 receptor antagonist (sulpiride) partially reversed tramadol’s analgesic effect in CCI rats, demonstrating that tramadol’s pain relief operates partly through dopamine D2 receptor upregulation in the nucleus accumbens.<sup data-ref="790">790</sup> A calpain inhibitor reduced mechanical hyperalgesia in a postoperative pain model by reversing KCC2 downregulation in the spinal cord.<sup data-ref="791">791</sup>
content.cn: 除了上文所述的姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 和 p38 抑制剂研究外，在 SNI 模型中可提高疼痛阈值的药物还包括：protectin D1（该药物通过激活 PPARγ 以剂量依赖性方式提高了足垫撤回阈值，同时降低了 TNF-α 和 IL-6 水平）、 <sup>1</sup> 甲基巴多索隆（一种 Nrf2 激活剂）、 <sup>1</sup> 美金诺（在临床可耐受剂量下，通过阻断NMDA开放通道以剂量依赖性方式减轻机械性痛觉过敏和异痛症，且不会出现该类药物常伴随的运动功能障碍）， <sup>1</sup> 以及鞘内给药的nNOS磷酸化位点调节剂（证实CaMKII和Akt是一氧化氮介导的神经病理性疼痛的关键调节因子）。 <sup>1</sup> 一种 D2 受体拮抗剂（舒必利）在 CCI 大鼠模型中部分逆转了曲马多的镇痛作用，这表明曲马多的镇痛作用部分是通过伏隔核中多巴胺 D2 受体的上调实现的。 <sup>1</sup> 一种钙蛋白酶抑制剂通过逆转脊髓中KCC2的下调，减轻了术后疼痛模型中的机械性痛觉过敏。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: Diabetic neuropathic pain
content.cn: 糖尿病神经病变性疼痛

content.en: Among natural compounds, berberine <sup>⬖</sup> dose-dependently reduced blood glucose, alleviated mechanical and thermal hyperalgesia, reduced spinal cord and DRG oxidative stress and inflammation, and upregulated μ-opioid receptor expression.<sup data-ref="792">792</sup> Osthole <sup>⬖</sup> improved pain thresholds while reducing P2X4 receptor expression, GFAP, BDNF, and p38 MAPK phosphorylation in DRG.<sup data-ref="793">793</sup> Additional agents include Urtica dioica <sup>⬖</sup> and pioglitazone (each improved oxidative stress markers and mitochondrial function while reducing pain scores),<sup data-ref="794">794</sup> a TrkB inhibitor (k252a, which significantly increased pain thresholds by decreasing BDNF and increasing KCC2 expression),<sup data-ref="795">795</sup> and PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway inhibition (which promoted spinal autophagy and improved hyperalgesia thresholds).<sup data-ref="796">796</sup> Calcitriol (vitamin D) <sup>⬖</sup> significantly increased pain tolerance in both tail flick and hot plate tests at 30 and 60 minutes.<sup data-ref="797">797</sup> Lastly, alpha-lipoic acid <sup>⬖</sup> significantly corrected established hypoalgesia (lost sensation) after 90 minutes, suggesting that once hypoalgesia develops, different therapeutic approaches are needed.<sup data-ref="798">798</sup>
content.cn: 在天然化合物中，小檗碱 <sup>⬖</sup> 以剂量依赖性方式降低了血糖水平，缓解了机械性及热性痛觉过敏，减轻了脊髓和DRG的氧化应激和炎症，并上调了μ-阿片受体的表达。 <sup>1</sup> 奥斯托尔 <sup>⬖</sup> 提高了痛阈，同时降低了DRG中P2X4受体的表达、GFAP、BDNF以及p38 MAPK的磷酸化水平。 <sup>1</sup> 其他药物包括二叶荨麻 <sup>⬖</sup> 和吡格列酮（二者均改善了氧化应激标志物和线粒体功能，同时降低了疼痛评分）， <sup>1</sup> 一种TrkB抑制剂（k252a，通过降低BDNF和增加KCC2表达显著提高了疼痛阈值）， <sup>1</sup> 以及PI3K/AKT/mTOR通路的抑制（该处理促进了脊髓自噬并提高了痛觉过敏阈值）。 <sup>1</sup> 钙三醇（维生素D） <sup>⬖</sup> 在30分钟和60分钟时，显著提高了尾部闪避试验和热板试验中的疼痛耐受性。 <sup>1</sup> 最后，α-硫辛酸 <sup>⬖</sup> 在90分钟后显著纠正了已形成的痛觉减退（感觉丧失），这表明一旦出现痛觉减退，就需要采取不同的治疗方法。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: Chemotherapy-induced neuropathy
content.cn: 化疗引起的神经病变

content.en: Among natural compounds, glucoraphanin <sup>⬖</sup> and sulforaphane <sup>⬖</sup> dose-dependently reduced oxaliplatin-induced neuropathic pain through H₂S release and Kv7 potassium channel modulation, with daily administration preventing neuropathy development entirely.<sup data-ref="799">799</sup> Tanshinone IIA,<sup>⬖</sup> cryptotanshinone <sup>⬖</sup>, and Danshen extract <sup>⬖</sup> from Salvia miltiorrhiza alleviated oxaliplatin-induced neuropathic pain while showing selective neuroprotective effects (inhibiting glioblastoma cells with no effect on healthy cells).<sup data-ref="800">800</sup> Paeoniflorin,<sup>⬖</sup> attenuated paclitaxel-induced mechanical allodynia and demyelination via adenosine A1 receptor activation while downregulating ER stress in Schwann cells.<sup data-ref="801">801</sup> Gastrodin <sup>⬖</sup> combined with vincristine not only improved tumor inhibition rates but also dose-dependently inhibited vincristine-induced neuropathic pain by suppressing the Notch/CX3CR1/p38 pathway.<sup data-ref="802">802</sup> 4-Dimethylamino chalcone inhibited myeloperoxidase activity, produced acute antinociception via muscarinic and opioid receptors, and prevented proinflammatory macrophage polarization in vincristine-induced peripheral neuropathy.<sup data-ref="803">803</sup> Systemic cannabidiol <sup>⬖</sup> (CBD) produced antinociceptive effects in CCI neuropathic pain through peripheral μ- and δ-opioid receptor activation, with the aminopeptidase inhibitor bestatin potentiating CBD’s analgesic effects at lower doses.<sup data-ref="804">804</sup> CB2 receptor agonists in DMSO dose-dependently suppressed established paclitaxel-induced mechanical allodynia, normalizing thresholds to pre-paclitaxel baseline.<sup data-ref="805">805</sup>
content.cn: 在天然化合物中，葡萄糖萝卜硫素 <sup>⬖</sup> 和硫代葡萄糖萝卜硫素 <sup>⬖</sup> 通过释放 H₂S 及调节 Kv7 钾通道，以剂量依赖性方式减轻了奥沙利铂诱导的神经病理性疼痛，且每日给药可完全预防神经病变的发生。 <sup>1</sup> 丹参中的丹参酮IIA、 <sup>⬖</sup> 隐丹参酮 <sup>⬖</sup> 以及丹参提取物 <sup>⬖</sup> 不仅能缓解奥沙利铂诱导的神经病理性疼痛，还表现出选择性神经保护作用（抑制胶质母细胞瘤细胞，对健康细胞无影响）。 <sup>1</sup> 芍花苷 <sup>⬖</sup> 通过激活腺苷A1受体，减轻了紫杉醇诱导的机械性异痛和脱髓鞘，同时下调了施万细胞中的内质网应激。 <sup>1</sup> 胃苷 <sup>⬖</sup> 与长春新碱联合使用，不仅提高了肿瘤抑制率，还通过抑制 Notch/CX3CR1/p38 信号通路，以剂量依赖性方式抑制了长春新碱诱导的神经病理性疼痛。 <sup>1</sup> 4-二甲基氨基查尔酮可抑制髓过氧化物酶活性，通过胆碱能和阿片受体产生急性抗痛觉作用，并能防止长春新碱诱导的外周神经病变中促炎性巨噬细胞极化。 <sup>1</sup> 全身给药的大麻二酚 <sup>⬖</sup> (CBD) 通过激活外周μ-和δ-阿片受体，对CCI神经病理性疼痛产生抗痛觉作用，且氨基肽酶抑制剂贝斯他汀可在较低剂量下增强CBD的镇痛效果。 <sup>1</sup> 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）中的CB2受体激动剂以剂量依赖性方式抑制了已确立的紫杉醇诱导的机械性异痛症，将痛阈恢复至紫杉醇治疗前的基线水平。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: Other pain models
content.cn: 其他疼痛模型

content.en: Intrathecal cannabinoid receptor agonists (anandamide <sup>⬖</sup> and WIN 55,212-2) suppressed allodynia and spontaneous pain attacks in rats with central pain syndrome, with WIN 55,212-2 producing more pronounced and longer-lasting analgesia (80% arrest rate) while high-dose intravenous anandamide <sup>⬖</sup> mitigated visceral nociception through CB1 receptor activation in sensitized rats.<sup data-ref="806">806</sup>, <sup data-ref="807">807</sup> Dexmedetomidine attenuated remifentanil-induced hyperalgesia by downregulating NR1 and NR2B subunit expression and membrane trafficking while reducing PKCγ and CaMKIIα phosphorylation in the spinal cord.<sup data-ref="808">808</sup> CDDO (a synthetic triterpenoid) exerted analgesic and neuroprotective effects in a postherpetic neuralgia model by reducing TRPV1-positive nociceptive neurons, decreasing neuronal apoptosis, reversing glial cell activation (including the first reported role of oligodendrocytes in postherpetic neuralgia), and suppressing PKC-δ and phosphorylated Akt signaling.<sup data-ref="809">809</sup> Sesamin <sup>⬖</sup> reduced both acute and chronic formalin-induced pain while downregulating TLR4/NF-κB/NLRP3 inflammatory signaling in brain tissue.<sup data-ref="810">810</sup> Intraperitoneal nifedipine dissolved in DMSO produced significant dose-dependent antinociception (5-15 mg/kg) in rats, with a positive dose-response correlation suggesting involvement of spinal calcium channel mechanisms.<sup data-ref="811">811</sup> Among agents studied in bone cancer pain models, [resveratrol](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=nRANE_nPmUqjMaFTVS1EhYflVwuhKg6ALS38rIrr4m4os4M_I-V45bx1qv0ch1yXybazSbWZ3oEo92X5UuW_e2HJoUEKzuqe03KpieleON3k6djDhiLw8ET477qY2eVRyDpeeY0oQuJp7ivQtvLwwLrK6jLIcv9ZJTm23eseGwdc9TBpzhdO2Mok66DtgDLt&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> increased pain thresholds and modulated OPG/RANK/RANKL while decreasing TNF-α, IL-6, IL-1β, and CCL2,<sup data-ref="812">812</sup> [koumine](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=nRANE_nPmUpY7Bv6R2k8eRJjicXa6H0QKpUhhWiiO2nWWNJ38VCXXVAXYGClckCHK9Lr0Nqmlr8HpOUmSloP8gq3P-j18avwu_2_41HIYhO95ngu773s8GLDMPuX4n195PrI7Xcl3pAhKbwukikq6olkTHwXfWGe6CkpgkO1fA0Ztq8PvNljpICKGP-bMwIV&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> decreased spinal GFAP, Iba-1, IL-6, IL-1β, and TNF-α,<sup data-ref="813">813</sup> [tanshinone IIA](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25867360/) <sup>⬖</sup> reduced spinal IL-1β, IL-6, and TNF-α,<sup data-ref="814">814</sup> [curcumin](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=mX7l0X-lXK2DwvaSHmm5uDMKR-hYvsJMBYR9a_5BfefqHfSgkVI-cPNveLo9BJeT9R60ufdjBNvZT_-c_OcaBXbcKY7kMeYleXxm7QewhQ-Uc2kGozm9k6H1AfBRTDdcQB_QSncfRs9nl5s9A0jYLOSbGKAlm_MvXgQug1-xHD3xwcns7KOvcw==&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> elevated mechanical withdrawal threshold and reduced spinal p-CaMKII,<sup data-ref="815">815</sup> and the [CB2 agonist JWH015](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22490961/) relieved both mechanical and thermal hyperalgesia with CB2 receptor expression upregulating over time.<sup data-ref="816">816</sup>
content.cn: 蛛网膜下腔给药的大麻素受体激动剂（阿南达米德 <sup>⬖</sup> 和 WIN 55,212-2）抑制了中枢性疼痛综合征大鼠的异痛症和自发性疼痛发作，其中 WIN 55,212-2 产生的镇痛作用更为显著且持续时间更长（80% 的镇痛率）；而在敏感化大鼠中，高剂量静脉注射阿南达米德 <sup>⬖</sup> 则通过激活 CB1 受体减轻了内脏痛觉。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 德美沙多米丁通过下调NR1和NR2B亚基的表达及膜转运，同时降低脊髓中PKCγ和CaMKIIα的磷酸化水平，从而减轻了瑞芬太尼诱导的痛觉过敏。 <sup>1</sup> 在带状疱疹后神经痛模型中，CDDO（一种合成三萜类化合物）通过减少TRPV1阳性痛觉神经元、降低神经元凋亡、逆转胶质细胞活化（包括首次报道的少突胶质细胞在带状疱疹后神经痛中的作用），以及抑制PKC-δ和磷酸化Akt信号传导，发挥了镇痛和神经保护作用。 <sup>1</sup> 芝麻素 <sup>⬖</sup> 既减轻了福马林诱导的急性疼痛和慢性疼痛，又下调了脑组织中的 TLR4/NF-κB/NLRP3 炎症信号传导。 <sup>1</sup> 溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的尼非地平腹腔注射在大鼠中产生了显著的剂量依赖性抗痛觉作用（5-15 mg/kg），其正的剂量-反应相关性表明脊髓钙通道机制参与其中。 <sup>1</sup> 在骨癌疼痛模型中研究的各种药物中，白藜芦醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 提高了疼痛阈值，调节了OPG/RANK/RANKL的表达，同时降低了TNF-α、IL-6、IL-1β和CCL2的水平， <sup>1</sup> 莪术酮 <sup>⬖</sup> 降低了脊髓中GFAP、Iba-1、IL-6、IL-1β和TNF-α的水平， <sup>1</sup> 丹参酮IIA <sup>⬖</sup> 降低了脊髓中IL-1β、IL-6和TNF-α的水平， <sup>1</sup> 姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 提高了机械性痛阈，并降低了脊髓中p-CaMKII的水平， <sup>1</sup> 而CB2激动剂JWH015既缓解了机械性痛觉过敏，也缓解了热痛觉过敏，且CB2受体的表达随时间推移呈上调趋势。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: Lastly, a Russian “Espol” ointment containing DMSO combined with capsicum extract <sup>⬖</sup> and coriander essential oil <sup>⬖</sup> was formulated for neuralgias, radiculitis, myositis, and bruises, providing hyperemia alongside analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects.<sup data-ref="817">817</sup> A veterinary remedy for pain in arthritis, arthrosis, and neuralgia in dogs was formulated with DMSO, menovasin (containing menthol, procaine, and benzocaine), May honey, egg yolk, and ghee butter.<sup data-ref="818">818</sup>
content.cn: 最后，一种含有二甲基亚砜（DMSO）、辣椒提取物 <sup>⬖</sup> 和芫荽精油 <sup>⬖</sup> 的俄罗斯“Espol”软膏被研制出来，用于治疗神经痛、神经根炎、肌炎和挫伤，除具有镇痛和抗炎作用外，还能促进局部充血。 <sup>1</sup> 一种用于治疗犬类关节炎、骨关节炎和神经痛的兽用制剂，其配方包含二甲基亚砜（DMSO）、美诺瓦辛（含薄荷醇、普鲁卡因和苯佐卡因）、五月蜂蜜、蛋黄和酥油。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: Fibromyalgia
content.cn: 纤维肌痛

content.en: [A Russian study](https://europepmc.org/article/med/9011284) on primary fibromyalgia syndrome found that combined therapy using DMSO with non-hormonal anti-inflammatory agents and acupuncture sessions promoted normalization of dysfunctions and was noted as “easy-to-use, available, and inexpensive.”
content.cn: 一项关于原发性纤维肌痛综合征的俄罗斯研究发现，将二甲基亚砜（DMSO）与非激素类抗炎药物联合使用并配合针灸治疗，有助于促进功能障碍的恢复，且被认为“使用方便、易于获得且价格低廉”。

content.en:
Over the years, numerous cases of individuals with fibromyalgia having massive improvements in quality of life from DMSO have been reported, but simultaneously, quite a few cases have required starting slowly for [sensitive patients](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/constitutional-archtypes-in-medicine) with pre-existing toxicity (as otherwise the initial fluid mobilization within their body was too much for the individual—which synopsizes two of the three significant adverse reactions to DMSO I’ve seen within the roughly 10,000 reader reports I’ve reviewed).
While no formal studies have been published beyond the Russian one, Stanley Jacob (whom I consider to be extremely honest) [attested](https://dmso.org/articles/fibromyalgia/fibromyalgia.htm):
content.cn:
多年来， 已有大量病例报告显示，纤维肌痛患者通过使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）使生活质量得到了显著改善；但与此同时，对于已有毒性反应的敏感患者，不少病例需要从低剂量开始逐步增加（否则，体内初期产生的体液移动量对患者而言会过于剧烈——这概括了我审阅的约10,000份读者报告中所见到的DMSO三种主要不良反应中的两种）。
虽然除那项俄罗斯研究外尚未发表过其他正式研究，但斯坦利·雅各布（我认为他非常诚实）证实道：

content.text:
“Over the last few years, we have been treating patients with fibromyalgia. Seventy percent of the patients have experienced benefit. No serious side effects have been encountered. The properties of our regime contributing to benefit included free-radical scavenging, analgesia, anti-inflammation, softening of scar tissue, reduction of muscle spasm, and stimulation of healing.”  
> “在过去的几年里，我们一直为纤维肌痛患者提供治疗。70%的患者从中获益。尚未出现任何严重副作用。我们治疗方案中有助于改善症状的特性包括：清除自由基、镇痛、抗炎、软化瘢痕组织、缓解肌肉痉挛以及促进愈合。”

content.en:
*Note: Jacob’s student later published one particularly profound fibromyalgia improvement.<sup data-ref="819">819</sup>
*Readers, in turn, have reported DMSO’s life-changing utility for fibromyalgia. One reader, pain-free for the first time in 25 years, wrote: “I sought out DMSO and it has completely eliminated all of my pain. For reference, I’m a fibromyalgia chronic pain sufferer, in early stages of rheumatoid arthritis, with a connective tissue disorder.” <sup data-ref="820">820</sup> Numerous readers credited DMSO with eliminating or greatly reducing longstanding fibromyalgia pain,<sup data-ref="821">821</sup>, <sup data-ref="822">822</sup>, <sup data-ref="823">823</sup>, <sup data-ref="824">824</sup>, <sup data-ref="825">825</sup>, <sup data-ref="826">826</sup>, <sup data-ref="827">827</sup>, <sup data-ref="477">477</sup>, <sup data-ref="243">243</sup>, <sup data-ref="828">828</sup>, <sup data-ref="829">829</sup>, <sup data-ref="830">830</sup>, <sup data-ref="821">821</sup> with one’s mother “shocked at how quickly the pain lessened” from the 70% gel.<sup data-ref="824">824</sup>
content.cn:
注：雅各布的一位学生后来发表了一项特别有深远意义的纤维肌痛症改善案例。 <sup>1</sup>
读者们也纷纷反馈，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）对纤维肌痛症的治疗效果堪称改变人生。一位读者在25年来首次摆脱疼痛后写道：“我尝试了二甲基亚砜，它彻底消除了我所有的疼痛。需要说明的是，我是一名纤维肌痛症慢性疼痛患者，正处于类风湿性关节炎的早期阶段，同时还患有结缔组织疾病。” <sup>1</sup> 许多读者都表示，正是二甲基亚砜（DMSO）消除了或大大减轻了他们长期以来的纤维肌痛， <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> <sup>5</sup> <sup>6</sup> <sup>7</sup> <sup>8</sup> <sup>9</sup> <sup>10</sup> <sup>11</sup> <sup>12</sup> <sup>13</sup> 其中一位读者的母亲表示，使用70%浓度的二甲基亚砜凝胶后，“疼痛缓解得如此之快，令她大吃一惊”。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: Several readers noted the importance of starting slowly with fibromyalgia. One experienced three days of feeling better followed by a return to baseline, a pattern they had seen with many treatments,<sup data-ref="831">831</sup> while another found that a three-day oral course (a small teaspoon daily) reduced pain by about 25% and made other pain protocols more effective, with no subsequent loss of efficacy.<sup data-ref="825">825</sup>
content.cn: 几位读者指出，对于纤维肌痛患者来说，循序渐进地开始治疗非常重要。其中一位读者经历了三天症状缓解，随后又恢复到原状，这种模式在许多治疗中都曾出现过， <sup>1</sup> 而另一位读者则发现，为期三天的口服疗程（每天一小茶匙）可将疼痛减轻约25%，并能提高其他镇痛方案的疗效，且此后疗效不会减弱。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: A reader with fibromyalgia for 16 years who had been on gabapentin (which stopped working) and could not get Lyrica from the VA described remarkable results: pain in the left shoulder and blade, cervical and low back pain, knee arthritis, hip pain, scoliosis, neuropathy in both feet, and asthma all improved with topical DMSO, allowing discontinuation of multiple medications including inhalers.<sup data-ref="477">477</sup> Another reader used DMSO topically and orally and “had no fibromyalgia or pain for almost 5 years.” <sup data-ref="830">830</sup>
content.cn: 一位患有纤维肌痛症长达16年的读者，此前一直服用加巴喷丁（但已失效），且无法从退伍军人事务部（VA）获得利瑞卡，他描述了令人惊叹的效果：左肩和肩胛骨疼痛、颈部和下背部疼痛、膝关节炎、髋部疼痛、脊柱侧弯、双足神经病变以及哮喘等症状，在局部使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）后均有所改善，从而得以停用包括吸入剂在内的多种药物。 <sup>1</sup> 另一位读者通过局部外用和口服二甲基亚砜（DMSO），表示“近5年来没有纤维肌痛或疼痛”。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en: Headaches & Migraines
content.cn: 头痛与偏头痛

content.en: Headaches are among the most common and challenging neurological complaints, and one of the conditions for which DMSO was first recognized as effective. Tension headaches (arising from muscular tension in the neck and scalp) and sinus headaches tend to respond well to DMSO, whereas migraine and cluster headaches are less consistently responsive, although some mechanistic evidence has now emerged supporting DMSO’s use in migraines.
content.cn: 头痛是最常见且最难处理的神经系统症状之一，也是二甲基亚砜（DMSO）最早被公认为有效的适应症之一。紧张性头痛（由颈部和头皮肌肉紧张引起）和鼻窦性头痛通常对二甲基亚砜反应良好，而偏头痛和丛集性头痛的反应则不那么一致，尽管目前已有一些机制证据支持将二甲基亚砜用于治疗偏头痛。

content.en: Clinical Evidence
content.cn: 临床证据

content.en: DMSO’s use for headaches has been documented since the mid-1960s. [A 1985 survey](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/pdf/10.1080/00970050.1985.10614465) of DMSO users found headaches among the most commonly self-treated conditions, and papers from the early 1980s noted that DMSO was used for headaches among its many applications and [a 2005 paper](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/19338814/) reported that migraine improvements had been attributed to DMSO.<sup data-ref="832">832</sup>, <sup data-ref="833">833</sup>, <sup data-ref="834">834</sup>
content.cn: 自20世纪60年代中期以来，已有文献记载二甲基亚砜（DMSO）用于治疗头痛。 1985年对二甲基亚砜（DMSO）使用者的调查发现，头痛是人们最常自行治疗的症状之一；20世纪80年代初的论文指出，在二甲基亚砜的众多用途中，治疗头痛是其中之一；而2005年的一篇论文则报告称，偏头痛症状的改善被归因于二甲基亚砜。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup>

content.en: The most comprehensive clinical data comes from Stanley Jacob, [who reported on 59 patients with headaches from a variety of causes](https://headachejournal.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1111/j.1526-4610.1965.hed0503078.x), of whom over 75% responded to topical DMSO. This included 13 out of 17 patients with chronic cervical arthritis-triggered headaches (who then required gradually decreasing doses), 4 out of 5 patients with sinus headaches, both patients with temporal arteritis (complete recovery), and 26 out of 35 patients with trigeminal neuralgia of more than a year’s duration (13 achieving full recovery).
content.cn: 最全面的临床数据来自斯坦利·雅各布（Stanley Jacob），他报告了59例由各种原因引起的头痛患者，其中超过75%的患者对局部使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）产生了疗效。 其中包括17例慢性颈椎关节炎引发的头痛患者中的13例（此后需逐渐减少剂量）、5例鼻窦性头痛患者中的4例、2例颞动脉炎患者（均完全康复），以及35例病程超过一年的三叉神经痛患者中的26例（其中13例完全康复）。

content.en: *Note: [one anecdotal report describes](https://health-matrix.net/2011/03/15/dmso-the-real-miracle-solution/) a splitting headache resolving within minutes of DMSO application by Dr. Jacob, returning after four hours, and then leaving permanently after a second application.
content.cn: 注：有一则轶事报道称，雅各布医生使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）后，患者剧烈的头痛在几分钟内缓解，但四小时后又复发，随后在第二次使用后彻底消失。*

content.en: In a study where DMSO was found (via electromyography) to relax cervical musculature within 60 minutes of topical application, this relaxation also alleviated associated tension headaches.<sup data-ref="835">835</sup>, <sup data-ref="836">836</sup> Their combined results were as follows:
content.cn: 在一项研究中，通过肌电图发现，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在局部涂抹后60分钟内可使颈部肌肉放松，这种放松作用同时也缓解了相关的紧张性头痛。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 各项结果综合如下：

content.en: Another study of 10 patients with headaches from various causes (primarily frontal) found DMSO significantly helped all 10, including those who had had headaches for more than a day, with relief times ranging from 1 minute to about 3 hours.<sup data-ref="837">837</sup>, <sup data-ref="838">838</sup> In [a study of 15 patients](https://nyaspubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1111/j.1749-6632.1975.tb25389.x) with tinnitus who had concurrent headaches, DMSO produced complete headache recovery in 7, less intense headaches in 1, only occasional headaches in 2, and no response in 1.
content.cn: 另一项针对10名因各种原因（主要是额部）导致头痛的患者的研究发现，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）对这10名患者均产生了显著疗效，包括那些头痛持续超过一天的患者，症状缓解时间从1分钟到约3小时不等。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 在一项针对15名同时伴有头痛的耳鸣患者的研究中，二甲基亚砜使其中7名患者的头痛完全缓解，1名患者的头痛程度减轻，2名患者仅偶尔出现头痛，另有1名患者未见疗效。

content.en: In [a larger observational series of 190 patients](https://nyaspubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1111/j.1749-6632.1967.tb34927.x) (286 conditions), topical 90% DMSO for headache and neck pain produced poor results in 59, good in 60, and excellent in 35, with better responses in tension, post-traumatic, cervical disc, and sinusitis-related cases, while vascular headaches (migraine, cluster) generally responded poorly.
content.cn: 在一项涉及190名患者（286种病症）的大型观察性研究中，外用90%二甲基亚砜（DMSO）治疗头痛和颈部疼痛的效果表现为：59例效果不佳，60例效果良好，35例效果极佳；其中，紧张性头痛、创伤后头痛、颈椎间盘病变及与鼻窦炎相关的病例反应较好，而血管性头痛（偏头痛、丛集性头痛）的反应普遍较差。

content.en: [For sinus-associated headaches](https://www.annualreviews.org/content/journals/10.1146/annurev.pa.12.040172.002033), 0.5 ml of 50% DMSO instilled into each nostril was found effective. [In children with headaches and cervical spine disorders](https://cyberleninka.ru/article/n/osobennosti-kliniki-i-terapii-golovnyh-boley-u-detey-s-funktsionalnymi-narusheniyami-pozvonochno-dvigatelnyh-segmentov-sheynogo-otdela) (105 patients aged 5-18), DMSO applications mixed with novocaine and ATP were recommended when cervicalgia was complicated by myotonic and neurodystrophic syndromes, with 10-15 applications as part of adjunctive therapy.
content.cn: 对于与鼻窦相关的头痛，将0.5毫升50%二甲基亚砜（DMSO）滴入每个鼻孔被证实有效。对于患有头痛和颈椎疾病的儿童（105名5至18岁患者），当颈痛并发肌强直综合征和神经营养不良综合征时，建议使用与诺卡因和ATP混合的DMSO进行局部治疗，作为辅助治疗的一部分，疗程为10至15次。

content.en: Lastly, it is important to remember DMSO’s headache reducing qualities often reflect it shifting systemic issues within the body. For example, [a case report](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/000331977002100304?url_ver=Z39.88-2003&rfr_id=ori:rid:crossref.org&rfr_dat=cr_pub%20%200pubmed) of a 38-year-old woman with refractory systemic lupus erythematosus documented that topical DMSO resolved severe headaches alongside dramatic improvement in skin lesions and other lupus manifestations, with sustained remission after tapering prednisone.
content.cn: 最后，需要记住的是，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）缓解头痛的作用往往反映了它正在调节体内的系统性问题。例如，一份关于一名38岁女性难治性系统性红斑狼疮病例的报告显示，外用二甲基亚砜不仅缓解了严重的头痛，还显著改善了皮肤病变和其他狼疮症状，且在逐渐减量泼尼松后，病情仍保持持续缓解。

content.en: Migraine Mechanisms
content.cn: 偏头痛的发病机制

content.en: While DMSO’s clinical effects on migraines have been inconsistent, research on cortical spreading depression (CSD, the electrophysiological wave underlying migraine aura) has revealed that DMSO directly modulates the hemodynamic events thought to drive migraine headache.
content.cn: 尽管二甲基亚砜（DMSO）对偏头痛的临床疗效尚无定论，但关于皮层扩散性抑制（CSD，即偏头痛先兆背后的电生理波）的研究表明，DMSO可直接调节被认为会引发偏头痛的血流动力学事件。

content.en: [In rats](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/17329631/), 10% DMSO applied to the brain interrupted the dilating vascular changes caused by CSD, likely preventing or attenuating migraine attacks. A more detailed study using laser speckle and optical intrinsic signal imaging found that topical DMSO (0.1-4%) increased resting pial arteriolar diameter and blood velocity in a dose-dependent manner while attenuating the additional hyperemic surge that accompanies CSD. The core CSD wave itself was unaffected; DMSO appeared to stabilize baseline cerebral perfusion, leaving less capacity for the exaggerated vascular overshoot thought to contribute to headache development.<sup data-ref="839">839</sup>, <sup data-ref="840">840</sup> Separately, [daily intraperitoneal lamotrigine](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/20977938/) in DMSO suppressed rat CSD frequency by 37-60% (depending on brain region) over four weeks, outperforming valproate and riboflavin given in saline.
content.cn: 在大鼠实验中，将10%的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）涂抹于大脑，可阻断CSD引起的血管扩张变化，这可能预防或减轻偏头痛发作。 一项利用激光散斑成像和光学内源信号成像进行的更详细研究发现，局部应用二甲基亚砜（0.1%-4%）以剂量依赖性方式增加了静息状态下软脑膜小动脉的直径和血流速度，同时减弱了伴随CSD出现的额外充血峰值。CSD的核心波形本身未受影响；二甲基亚砜似乎稳定了基线脑灌注，从而减少了被认为会导致头痛发生的过度血管超调现象的发生空间。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 此外，在为期四周的实验中，每日腹腔注射溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的拉莫三嗪，可将大鼠CSD的发作频率抑制37%-60%（具体取决于脑区），其效果优于用生理盐水给药的丙戊酸和核黄素。

content.en: In a clinical study of 120 patients with combined migraine and cervicogenic headache, comprehensive cervical treatment including 10 topical applications of DMSO mixed with novocaine reduced migraine attack frequency by up to 50%, decreased pain intensity, and improved quality of life. An accompanying in vitro experiment using isolated rat skulls demonstrated that DMSO at 1% and 10% dose-dependently increased action potential frequency in trigeminal afferents followed by desensitization (similar to capsaicin), providing a mechanistic explanation for DMSO’s analgesic action in blocking trigeminal pain conduction relevant to headache pathogenesis.<sup data-ref="841">841</sup>, <sup data-ref="842">842</sup>, <sup data-ref="843">843</sup>
content.cn: 在一项针对120例兼有偏头痛和颈源性头痛患者的临床研究中，包括10次局部涂抹二甲基亚砜（DMSO）与诺卡因混合物在内的综合颈部治疗，使偏头痛发作频率降低了高达50%，减轻了疼痛强度，并改善了生活质量。 一项使用分离大鼠颅骨进行的配套体外实验表明，1%和10%浓度的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）会以剂量依赖性方式增加三叉神经传入纤维的动作电位频率，随后引发脱敏（类似于辣椒素的作用），这为DMSO通过阻断与头痛发病机制相关的三叉神经疼痛传导而发挥镇痛作用提供了机制上的解释。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup>

content.en: *Note: I believe [blood stasis](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/what-makes-all-vaccines-so-dangerous) (which [DMSO addresses](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-heals-the-brain-and-transforms)) plays a key role in migraines.
content.cn: 注：我认为血瘀（二甲基亚砜可针对这一问题）在偏头痛中起着关键作用。*

content.en: Reader Headache Reports
content.cn: 读者反映的头痛问题

content.en: Readers consistently reported rapid headache relief from topical DMSO (with a variety of application developed depending on the type of headache <sup data-ref="844">844</sup>, <sup data-ref="845">845</sup>, <sup data-ref="846">846</sup> such as those from an acute viral illness <sup data-ref="846">846</sup>). Many readers described headache relief, often within minutes using DMSO,<sup data-ref="847">847</sup>, <sup data-ref="848">848</sup>, <sup data-ref="849">849</sup> (e.g., “DMSO is the only thing that stops my headaches in their tracks.” <sup data-ref="849">849</sup>). A reader with chronic headaches for two years following carbon monoxide exposure found DMSO “ended the headaches within two months” when doctors had nothing for the condition.<sup data-ref="850">850</sup> Multiple readers described DMSO replacing their regular use of aspirin, NSAIDs, or other headache medications.<sup data-ref="848">848</sup>, <sup data-ref="851">851</sup>
content.cn: 读者们一致反映，外用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能迅速缓解头痛（根据头痛类型的不同，有各种不同的使用方法 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> ，例如由急性病毒性疾病引起的头痛 <sup>1</sup> ）。 许多读者描述了使用二甲基亚砜后头痛得到缓解的情况，通常仅需几分钟， <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> （例如：“二甲基亚砜是唯一能立马止住我头痛的东西。” <sup>1</sup> ）。 一位因一氧化碳中毒而持续头痛两年的读者表示，当医生对此病症束手无策时，二甲基亚砜“在两个月内就治好了头痛” <sup>1</sup> 。多位读者表示，二甲基亚砜已取代了他们平时使用的阿司匹林、非甾体抗炎药（NSAIDs）或其他头痛药物 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 。

content.en: Notably, a physician reader applied DMSO to a physician colleague with intractable headaches that “none of the neurologists could fix,” resulting in a complete cure with no further treatment needed; their colleague had been considering quitting work because of the headaches.<sup data-ref="852">852</sup>
content.cn: 值得注意的是，一位医生读者曾为一位饱受顽固性头痛困扰的同行医生使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）——这种头痛“没有一位神经科医生能治好”——结果该患者完全痊愈，无需进一步治疗；此前，这位同行医生曾因头痛问题考虑过辞职。 <sup>1</sup>

content.en:
Additional readers reporting (often immense) headache relief include those using DMSO for sinus headaches,<sup data-ref="853">853</sup>, <sup data-ref="854">854</sup> cluster headaches,<sup data-ref="855">855</sup> tension headaches,<sup data-ref="847">847</sup>, <sup data-ref="856">856</sup> post-concussion headaches,<sup data-ref="857">857</sup> and general chronic headaches.<sup data-ref="858">858</sup>, <sup data-ref="859">859</sup>, <sup data-ref="860">860</sup>, <sup data-ref="861">861</sup>, <sup data-ref="862">862</sup>, <sup data-ref="863">863</sup>, <sup data-ref="864">864</sup>, <sup data-ref="864">864</sup>, <sup data-ref="330">330</sup>, <sup data-ref="851">851</sup>, <sup data-ref="503">503</sup>, <sup data-ref="865">865</sup>, <sup data-ref="866">866</sup>, <sup data-ref="867">867</sup>, <sup data-ref="868">868</sup>, <sup data-ref="869">869</sup>, <sup data-ref="870">870</sup>, <sup data-ref="871">871</sup>, <sup data-ref="133">133</sup>, <sup data-ref="872">872</sup>  
另有读者报告称，使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可显著缓解（通常是极度）头痛，包括用于治疗鼻窦性头痛、 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 丛集性头痛、 <sup>1</sup> 紧张性头痛、 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> 脑震荡后头痛、 <sup>1</sup> 以及一般性慢性头痛。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> <sup>5</sup> <sup>6</sup> <sup>7</sup> <sup>8</sup> <sup>9</sup> <sup>10</sup> <sup>11</sup> <sup>12</sup> <sup>13</sup> <sup>14</sup> <sup>15</sup> <sup>16</sup> <sup>17</sup> <sup>18</sup> <sup>19</sup> <sup>20</sup>
content.cn: 注：一位读者尝试了皮下注射二甲基亚砜（浓度为6.25%），并报告称在梯形肌附近注射后，“注射次日出现剧烈头痛，随后一周内头痛消失”，这表明存在一种类似神经疗法的重置机制。 <sup data-ref="858">858</sup>*

content.en: *Note: one reader experimented with subcutaneous DMSO injections (6.25% concentration) and reported that injection near the trapezoid produced “horrible headache the day after the injection, then a week of headache free,” suggesting a neural therapy-like reset mechanism.<sup data-ref="865">865</sup>
Migraines Reports
content.cn: 偏头痛报告

content.en: Migraine responses were more variable but included striking successes. One reader who had lived with chronic migraines since age 7 found that DMSO drops at the onset of aura caused the “aura disappeared and dissolved. No pain within a half hour. I don’t leave home without it now. Changed my life.” <sup data-ref="873">873</sup> A reader’s husband with migraines 2–3 times weekly for 30 years has had only one in 45 days since starting DMSO.<sup data-ref="874">874</sup> Another couple reported that for the wife’s 30+ years of daily migraines, DMSO “at least has an effect,” and “for the first time in many, many years I heard her say, my head is not hurting.” <sup data-ref="875">875</sup> while another reported “I’ve suffered my whole life and this is the first thing to take it away.” <sup data-ref="876">876</sup> A reader’s daughter with a migraine applied the DMSO roll-on to her forehead: “Minutes later she was literally snoring and woke up in the morning pain free.” <sup data-ref="877">877</sup>
content.cn: 针对偏头痛的反馈结果差异较大，但其中不乏令人瞩目的成功案例。一位自7岁起便饱受慢性偏头痛困扰的读者发现，在先兆出现时滴用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）滴剂，能让“先兆消失并消散。半小时内疼痛便消失了。 “现在我出门绝不会忘记带它。这彻底改变了我的生活。” <sup>1</sup> 另一位读者的丈夫曾每周发作2至3次偏头痛，持续30年之久，但在开始使用二甲基亚砜后，45天内仅发作过一次。 <sup>1</sup> 另一对夫妇表示，对于妻子30多年来的每日偏头痛，二甲基亚砜“至少起到了作用”，而且“许多许多年来，我第一次听到她说：‘我的头不疼了。’” <sup>1</sup> 还有一位读者表示：“我一辈子都在受苦，这是第一个能让我摆脱痛苦的方法。” <sup>1</sup> 一位患有偏头痛的读者女儿将二甲基亚砜（DMSO）滚珠涂抹在额头上：“几分钟后，她真的开始打鼾了，早上醒来时已经不再感到疼痛。” <sup>1</sup>

content.en: Multiple readers noted that catching the migraine early was essential for DMSO to work,<sup data-ref="873">873</sup>, <sup data-ref="878">878</sup>, <sup data-ref="879">879</sup> consistent with the clinical observation that migraines respond best to DMSO in the early stages.
content.cn: 多位读者指出，要使二甲基亚砜（DMSO）发挥疗效，及早发现偏头痛至关重要， <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> 这与临床观察结果一致，即偏头痛在早期阶段对二甲基亚砜的反应最佳。

content.en:
Many other readers also reported migraine relief.<sup data-ref="880">880</sup>, <sup data-ref="881">881</sup>, <sup data-ref="878">878</sup>, <sup data-ref="882">882</sup>, <sup data-ref="883">883</sup>, <sup data-ref="884">884</sup>, <sup data-ref="885">885</sup>, <sup data-ref="886">886</sup>, <sup data-ref="887">887</sup>, <sup data-ref="888">888</sup>, <sup data-ref="889">889</sup>, <sup data-ref="890">890</sup>, <sup data-ref="891">891</sup>, <sup data-ref="892">892</sup>, <sup data-ref="891">891</sup>, <sup data-ref="876">876</sup>, <sup data-ref="893">893</sup>, <sup data-ref="885">885</sup>, <sup data-ref="885">885</sup> However, a few readers noted that DMSO at higher oral doses triggered headaches or migraines in them,<sup data-ref="894">894</sup>, <sup data-ref="863">863</sup>, <sup data-ref="895">895</sup> with one identifying a clear dose-response relationship and suspecting interaction with chronic sinus inflammation.<sup data-ref="894">894</sup> This is consistent with the biphasic dose response observed in the research literature.  
许多其他读者也反映偏头痛症状得到了缓解。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> <sup>5</sup> <sup>6</sup> <sup>7</sup> <sup>8</sup> <sup>9</sup> <sup>10</sup> <sup>11</sup> <sup>12</sup> <sup>13</sup> <sup>14</sup> <sup>15</sup> <sup>16</sup> <sup>17</sup> <sup>18</sup> <sup>19</sup> 然而，有少数读者指出，较高剂量的口服二甲基亚砜（DMSO）会引发他们的头痛或偏头痛， <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> 其中一人明确指出存在剂量-反应关系，并怀疑这与慢性鼻窦炎有关。 <sup>1</sup> 这与研究文献中观察到的双相剂量-反应关系一致。

A New Relationship With Pain
content.cn: 与疼痛建立新的关系

content.en: In our society, pain is typically viewed as something to be feared and suppressed. However, I’ve long believed it should instead be seen as a necessary warning, since in many cases it serves as an overt or subtle indicator that something is wrong and an opportunity exists to improve your health.
content.cn: 在我们的社会中，疼痛通常被视为一种值得恐惧且需要压制的感受。然而，我长期以来一直认为，疼痛其实应当被视为一种必要的警示——因为在许多情况下，它会以明显或隐晦的方式提示身体出现了问题，同时也意味着改善健康状况的机会。

content.en: In this article, I’ve tried to touch upon the deep relationship between the health of the nervous system and the pain we experience, and to show that by healing nerves through giving them what they need, you can frequently eliminate pain rather than having to continually suppress it.
content.cn: 在本文中，我试图探讨神经系统健康与我们所经历的疼痛之间的深刻联系，并说明通过为神经提供所需养分来修复神经，往往可以消除疼痛，而无需一味地压制它。

content.en: Likewise, even in cases where full resolution is not possible, DMSO offers a way to dramatically improve these debilitating conditions and give patients a life that is not defined by pain or by the toxic medications they wish they could stop taking. I try very hard throughout these articles to avoid sensationalizing and to instead present the information in a balanced and objective way, but I must emphasize here that the suffering chronic pain patients experience is immense, to the point that many eventually take their own lives, and it is simply unconscionable that solutions like DMSO have been suppressed for over fifty years to protect the pain management industry.
content.cn: 同样，即使在无法完全治愈的情况下，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）也能显著改善这些令人衰弱的病症，让患者的生活不再受疼痛或那些他们渴望停用的有毒药物的束缚。 在撰写这些文章时，我竭力避免耸人听闻，而是以平衡、客观的方式呈现信息，但我必须在此强调：慢性疼痛患者所承受的痛苦是巨大的，甚至导致许多人最终选择结束自己的生命；而像二甲基亚砜（DMSO）这样的解决方案，为了维护疼痛管理产业的利益，竟被压制了五十多年，这简直是令人无法容忍的。

content.en: In the final part of this article, I will provide practical guidance on sourcing DMSO and detailed dosing protocols for each route of use (including intravenous), so that you and your doctor have the tools to use DMSO for the ailments you encounter. Additionally, I will cover:
content.cn: 在本文的最后一部分，我将就如何获取二甲基亚砜（DMSO）提供实用指南，并针对每种给药途径（包括静脉注射）详细说明用药方案，以便您和您的医生能够掌握使用DMSO治疗各类疾病的具体方法。此外，我还将介绍：

content.en:
- Condition-specific treatment protocols for the conditions discussed throughout this article, such as the pain conditions covered here (e.g., headaches and migraines, trigeminal and post-herpetic neuralgia, and other forms of neuropathic pain) and the numerous neuropathies (including nerve palsies and compression neuropathies like carpal tunnel syndrome and sciatica), along with non-DMSO approaches that help these conditions.
- Protocols for the central nervous system conditions covered earlier in this series (e.g., strokes, Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, fatigue, brain fog, chronic stress, cognitive impairment, and developmental delay) and a wide range of spinal conditions (e.g., back or neck pain, disc issues, radiculopathies, and spinal cord injuries).
- Scar treatment and resources for individuals interested in obtaining neural therapy.
- The specific agents that can be combined with DMSO to enhance its efficacy in the conditions detailed throughout this article (e.g., beyond how DMSO is applied for neuropathic pain affecting how well it works, a few agents have proven remarkably effective in combination with DMSO for it).
content.cn:
针对本文所讨论的各类疾病（例如本文涉及的疼痛性疾病——如头痛和偏头痛、三叉神经痛和带状疱疹后神经痛，以及其他形式的神经病理性疼痛——以及多种神经病变，包括神经麻痹和压迫性神经病变，如腕管综合征和坐骨神经痛）的针对性治疗方案，以及有助于改善这些病情的非二甲基亚砜（DMSO）疗法。
